This path may include moving to another city, changing careers, breaking up a relationship, or radically changing your worldview. It will be accompanied by a period of uncertainty and possibly loneliness, but it will lead to a complete renewal of your life. By choosing this path, you will discover previously unknown strengths and abilities that you never even suspected you had.
13.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.4: In the «Second Path» position, Death indicates the possibility of internal transformation while maintaining external circumstances. This path involves deep work on yourself, rethinking your values and priorities, but without radical external changes. Like a tree that changes with each season but remains in the same place, you can undergo significant internal evolution while maintaining stability in the fundamental aspects of your life. On this path, you will gradually let go of outdated beliefs and habits, replacing them with healthier ones that are more in line with your true nature. This choice requires honesty with yourself and a willingness to acknowledge the need for change, even if everything appears to remain the same on the surface.
13.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.5: In the «Third Way» position, the Death card offers a path of conscious transformation through helping others in their processes of transition and renewal. On this path, you not only transform yourself, but also become a conduit for change for those around you. Like an experienced shaman guiding people through rituals of transition, you may find your calling in supporting those who are also undergoing profound life transformations. This path may lead you to work in psychology, coaching, spiritual practices, or any other activity related to accompanying processes of change. By choosing this path, you will turn your own experience of transformation into a valuable resource for others.
13.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.6: In the «Obstacles and Fears» position, Death indicates a deep fear of the unknown and loss of control. An obstacle on your path may be a strong attachment to the past or to a certain image of yourself that no longer corresponds to your true nature. You may fear that by letting go of the old, you will be left empty or lose an important part of your identity. Like a person who cannot bring themselves to let go of a broken object for fear of being left with nothing, you may cling to situations or relationships that have long since outlived their purpose. Death in this position indicates that your resistance to the natural process of completion and renewal is the main obstacle to your growth.
13.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.7: In the «Advice from Higher Powers» position, the Death card recommends that you trust the cycle of completion and renewal. Higher powers urge you to realize that everything in life has a beginning and an end, and that wisdom lies in recognizing these cycles and acting in accordance with them. Like a farmer who knows when it is time to harvest and prepare the soil for new planting, you must learn to recognize when a certain stage of life has come to an end. Do not resist the natural order of things, but work in harmony with it. Let go with gratitude of what has already played its part in your life, and open yourself to new opportunities that will arise in the space that has been freed up.
13.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.8: In the «Possible Outcome» position, Death heralds a period of profound renewal and rebirth after a period of transformation. Whichever path you choose, the result will be a completely new stage in your life, which you will enter free from the burdens of the past. Like nature reborn after winter, your life will be filled with new energy and possibilities. This outcome does not come easily or quickly—the process of transformation takes time and may include a period of uncertainty or even crisis. However, in the end, you will gain a new perspective that will allow you to more fully realize your potential. What now seems like a loss, you will recognize in the future as a necessary step on the path to a more authentic and fulfilling life.
13.advice.upright.choice_crossroad.0: The Death card advises you not to be afraid to let go of what no longer serves your highest good, even if it causes pain or creates a temporary void in your life. Embrace transformation as a natural and necessary part of your journey, like a seasonal cycle that brings renewal after a period of decline. Instead of clinging to the past out of fear of the unknown, try to see the clear space of possibilities ahead of you. Allow yourself to experience any emotions associated with the process of letting go, whether it be sadness, anger, or confusion, but don't let them stop the inevitable process of change. Remember that completion is not only the end, but also the beginning of a new cycle that holds the potential for growth and development that you cannot even imagine right now.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_pyramid.0: Position «Current situation»: Temperance Reversed indicates a state of imbalance that currently prevails in your life. You may feel excessive tension and an inability to find a happy medium in your current circumstances. Perhaps you are too caught up in extremes — either rushing and acting impulsively, or, conversely, falling into a state of stagnation and indecision. This card warns of possible emotional burnout due to an inability to allocate your resources and energy properly. The present moment requires you to recognize this imbalance as the first step toward correcting it.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_pyramid.1: Position «Obstacle or Help»: Temperance Reversed in the obstacle position indicates internal inconsistency that prevents you from moving forward. You are prone to extremes and neglect the need for a harmonious combination of different aspects of life. Your impatience or, conversely, excessive slowness becomes a major obstacle. Paradoxically, awareness of this imbalance can be helpful—understanding that you lack moderation can push you to seek a more balanced approach to problem solving. This obstacle invites you to rethink your methods and pace of movement.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_pyramid.2: The «Unconscious Influence» position: Temperance reversed in this position reveals a deep-seated fear of losing control that unconsciously influences your decisions. On an unconscious level, you may avoid compromise, seeing it as a sign of weakness, or fear fully immersing yourself in a process, worrying about becoming overly involved. This internal struggle between the desire for immediate results and the desire to delay decision-making creates subconscious tension. Perhaps past experiences of seeking balance have been painful for you, and this is now affecting your ability to find the right balance in your current circumstances.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_pyramid.3: The «Past» position: Temperance reversed indicates a period in the past when you acted in an unbalanced way, perhaps giving in to extremes or avoiding necessary compromises. You may have experienced a time of chaos when patience and gradual progress were replaced by haste or, conversely, stagnation. This may have been due to an inability to blend opposing elements of your life into a harmonious whole. Perhaps you were prone to excess in certain areas—spending too much, working too hard, or, conversely, allowing yourself to be overly inactive. This past experience continues to influence your current situation.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_pyramid.4: Future Opportunities Position: Temperance Reversed warns of a potential period of disharmony if you continue to ignore the need for balance. In the future, situations may arise that require you to exercise greater restraint and patience, but there is a risk that you will act impulsively or, conversely, miss the moment for action due to excessive indecision. However, this card also indicates the possibility of recognizing these tendencies and working on them. The future offers you a chance to learn how to blend opposing qualities and find a middle ground between extremes, if you are willing to acknowledge your own imbalance.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_pyramid.5: Position «Attitude toward the situation»: Temperance Reversed reveals your inner impatience and tendency toward extremes in relation to the current situation. You may either rush into decisions or put them off unreasonably, unable to find a happy medium. Your perception is dominated by imbalance: you tend to overestimate some aspects of a situation and underestimate others. Perhaps you view compromise as a sign of weakness or concession rather than a wise approach. Your inner resistance to the idea of gradual progress and mixing different approaches creates tension that prevents you from seeing the situation objectively and finding harmonious solutions.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_pyramid.6: Position «Influence of the environment»: Temperance Reversed indicates a disharmonious atmosphere around you, where extremes may prevail and balance is lacking. The people around you may bring chaos into your life with their impatience or, conversely, excessive passivity. You may be in an environment where quick results are valued without consideration for long-term consequences, or where there is no healthy rhythm of activity. External circumstances may push you to make rash decisions or, conversely, cause you to feel stagnant. People around you may not support your attempts to achieve a more balanced approach, preferring to remain in their usual extremes.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_pyramid.7: The «Hope and Fear» position: Temperance reversed reflects your fears of losing control or not achieving your goals because of the need to compromise. You may fear that a moderate approach will lead to mediocre results, or you may fear that gradual movement means no progress at all. Deep down, you may hope for a quick resolution without the need for a long process of reconciling opposites, but at the same time, you fear that such an approach may lead to imbalance. Your hopes and fears are linked to an internal conflict between the desire for immediate results and the awareness of the need for a patient and balanced approach.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_pyramid.8: The «Result» position: Temperance Reversed in the result position indicates a likely outcome associated with a lack of balance. If you do not recognize the need to find a middle ground, the situation may resolve in a less than optimal way—either through overly hasty actions or through missed opportunities due to excessive slowness. However, this card may also indicate that through the experience of imbalance, you will ultimately come to understand the value of a moderate approach. The result may include realizing the importance of patience and gradually blending different elements of your life to achieve harmony. This experience, even if it is not easy, can be an important lesson in the art of balance.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_pyramid.9: The «Key to the Solution» position: Temperance reversed suggests that the key to the solution is recognizing and correcting the existing imbalance in your approach. You need to rethink your attitude toward patience and gradual progress, and understand what extremes you allow in your behavior or thinking. It is important to learn to mix opposing qualities and find a middle ground between haste and slowness, action and reflection. Instead of striving for instant results or, conversely, putting off decisions, try to establish a rhythm of gradual but consistent movement. Recognizing the need for moderation is the first step toward finding harmony in a situation.
14.advice.reversed.universal_pyramid.0: Temperance reversed advises you to consciously work on restoring balance in your life. Pay attention to areas where you tend to fall into extremes, whether it is excessive activity or, conversely, passivity. Start practicing patience and a gradual approach to problem solving, without expecting instant results, but also without putting off necessary actions indefinitely. Find your own rhythm that will allow you to move forward without burning out. It is especially important to learn to combine opposing qualities—rationality and intuition, action and reflection, work and rest. Remember that true wisdom often lies not in rejecting one extreme in favor of another, but in harmoniously combining them.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_flame.0: Position «Situation in the present»: Temperance Reversed in the present position indicates a period of imbalance in your life. You may feel that you have lost your inner center and are wavering between extremes — either acting too hastily and impulsively or, conversely, falling into a state of paralysis and indecision. You may feel that your energy is unevenly distributed: where there is an excess, it leads to burnout, and where there is a deficiency, it causes stagnation. This card indicates difficulties in integrating opposing aspects of your personality or situation, which prevents you from achieving harmony. The present moment requires awareness of this imbalance as the first step toward restoring lost harmony.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_flame.1: Position «Past Influences»: Temperance Reversed indicates that you have experienced a period in the past when balance was disrupted. Perhaps you were prone to extremes—either rushing into things and acting rashly, or taking too long to make decisions. This may have been a time when you were unable to find a balance between different areas of your life or opposing qualities of your personality. Perhaps you experienced periods of emotional outbursts followed by emotional exhaustion. These past patterns of imbalance are now influencing your current situation, shaping your attitude toward moderation and your ability to find harmony between opposites.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_flame.2: Position «Hidden Influences»: Temperance Reversed reveals an unconscious inner conflict between your desire for quick results and your need for gradual, harmonious development. At a deep level, you may resist the idea of moderation, seeing it as a sign of weakness or lack of determination. You may carry an unresolved fear that a patient and balanced approach will not lead you to your desired goals. A hidden influence may also be your unconscious resistance to integrating opposing aspects of your life. These internal conflicts push you toward imbalance, even when you consciously strive for harmony.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_flame.3: Position «Obstacles and Challenges»: Temperance reversed indicates that the main obstacle in your path is an inability to find balance and the golden mean. You may encounter difficulties when you need to combine opposing qualities or approaches. Your impatience or, conversely, your tendency to procrastinate becomes a serious challenge. Disharmony between different aspects of your life—work and personal relationships, practical needs and spiritual aspirations—creates constant tension. You may find it difficult to distribute your resources and energy evenly, leading to either exhaustion in some areas or excessive effort in others. Overcoming these obstacles requires conscious work to restore the lost balance.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_flame.4: Attitude toward the situation: Temperance Reversed reflects your inner resistance to the idea of balance and compromise. You may perceive the current situation through the prism of extremes, unable to see the nuances and possible compromises. You may be impatient and want immediate results, or, conversely, be prone to excessive caution and procrastination. Your attitude is characterized by an internal conflict between the desire for rapid change and the fear of it. You may perceive moderation as a sign of weakness or indecision, not realizing that the true art of living lies in the ability to harmoniously combine opposites and find a middle ground between extremes.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_flame.5: Position «What you should do»: Temperance reversed indicates the need for a conscious restoration of balance in your life. You should pay attention to areas where you tend to be extreme and start working on finding a happy medium. It is important to learn to distribute your energy more evenly, avoiding both burnout and stagnation. Try to develop patience and the ability to see the process, not just the result. Practice the art of compromise and integration of opposites, finding ways to combine seemingly incompatible qualities or approaches. You need to create your own rhythm that is active enough for progress but not so intense that it leads to exhaustion. Consciously slowing down where you are rushing and gently speeding up where you are stuck will help restore the balance.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_flame.6: Position «External influences»: Temperance reversed indicates that your environment may be contributing to imbalances in your life. You may be under the influence of people or circumstances that encourage extremes—either excessive activity and rushing, or, conversely, passivity and procrastination. Social pressure may push you toward excess in certain areas of your life. You may encounter situations where it is difficult to find a compromise or a middle ground between conflicting demands. External factors may create conditions that make it difficult to maintain a balanced distribution of energy and resources. However, awareness of these external influences can be the first step toward counteracting them and restoring inner balance despite the circumstances.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_flame.7: The «Hope and Fears» position: Temperance reversed reveals your deep-seated fears related to the idea of balance and moderation. You may fear that choosing the middle path will lead to mediocre results or that, in trying to find harmony between opposites, you will miss something important. On the level of hopes, you may strive for a quick resolution of the situation, without having to go through a long process of integration and finding balance. Perhaps you secretly hope that you can bypass the need for patient work on yourself and the situation. At the same time, you may fear the consequences of your own excesses — emotional burnout or missed opportunities due to excessive caution. These internal hopes and fears create additional tension that makes it difficult to achieve true harmony.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_flame.8: The «Result» position: Temperance reversed in the result position indicates that the outcome of the situation will depend on your ability to recognize and correct the existing imbalance. If current tendencies toward excess continue, the outcome may not be optimal—you risk either acting too hastily and making mistakes or missing opportunities due to excessive slowness. However, this card may also indicate that through the experience of disharmony, you will come to a deeper understanding of the value of balance and moderation. Perhaps the result will be an important lesson about the need to find a middle ground between extremes and develop the ability to integrate opposing aspects of your life into a harmonious whole. This path may not be easy, but it leads to deeper wisdom and inner harmony.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_flame.9: Short-term outlook: Temperance reversed warns of likely difficulties in the near future related to a lack of balance in your approach. In the short term, you may face the consequences of your excesses — energy depletion due to overactivity or missed opportunities due to procrastination. You may have to deal with situations that require compromise and integration of opposites, which will cause you internal discomfort. However, these immediate difficulties may serve as a catalyst for realizing the need for change in your approach. In the near future, you may begin experimenting with a more balanced course of action, gradually finding your own rhythm that will allow you to avoid both burnout and stagnation.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_flame.10: Long-term outlook: Temperance reversed in the context of long-term prospects indicates the need for a profound transformation of your attitude toward balance and moderation. In the long term, you face the task of learning the art of integrating opposites—not denying either extreme, but finding ways to harmonize them. This path may not be easy and may include periods of imbalance as well as gradual restoration of harmony. Over time, you may develop a more subtle understanding of the rhythms of life and your own cycles, learning to recognize when it is necessary to act decisively and when it is better to be patient. In the long term, this transformation can lead to a more mature and wise approach to life, based on recognizing the value of balance and gradual but steady progress.
14.meaning.reversed.universal_flame.11: Spiritual Lessons Position: Temperance Reversed in the spiritual lessons position indicates a profound message about the need to seek true harmony in life. This card teaches you that spiritual growth does not come through denying one extreme in favor of another, but through integrating them and finding a happy medium. You have a lesson to learn about the value of patience and gradual development, to understand that true mastery in any area of life requires time and rhythmic effort. This spiritual lesson also applies to the art of being moderate without mediocrity — finding a balance that does not suppress passion and creativity, but channels them into a constructive direction. You learn to see the wisdom in compromise and the middle way, realizing that harmony is often found not in extremes, but at the point where they meet and enrich each other.
14.advice.reversed.universal_flame.0: Temperance reversed advises you to pause and honestly assess the areas of your life where balance is out of whack. Pay attention to your tendency to fall into extremes—perhaps you are too hasty where patience is required, or, conversely, too slow where decisive action is needed. Start consciously practicing the art of the golden mean. Find your own rhythm that is intense enough to make progress but not so intense that it leads to burnout. Learn to distribute your energy more evenly between different areas of your life. Develop the ability to integrate opposing qualities without denying either of them completely. Remember that true wisdom often lies not in choosing between extremes, but in finding the point where they come together in harmony.
16.meaning.reversed.simple_YesNo.0: The Tower reversed in the Yes/No spread indicates that you are too attached to old beliefs and structures that no longer serve your growth. You may intuitively feel that change is necessary, but actively resist it out of fear of the unknown. This card warns that the longer you put off inevitable changes, the more painful they may be in the future.
16.meaning.reversed.simple_YesNo.1: In the reversed position, the Tower in a Yes/No spread indicates that you are going through a period when destructive processes are slowing down or being postponed. This may be a temporary respite from serious upheavals, but it does not mean that they will be prevented entirely. The card suggests that tension is building up within the situation, which will sooner or later need to be released. Perhaps you are being given extra time to prepare for the coming changes.
16.advice.reversed.simple_YesNo.0: The Tower reversed advises you not to be afraid to let go of what has outlived its usefulness. Listen to your inner voice, which will tell you which aspects of your life need to be transformed. Instead of resisting change, try to meet it with an open heart and a flexible mind. Remember that the destruction of the old is often a necessary condition for the creation of something new and better. Look for ways to gradually and consciously transform what is not working, rather than waiting for the situation to reach a critical point.
16.meaning.reversed.simple_daySuggest.0: The Tower reversed in the 'Advice of the Day' spread indicates that today you may encounter a situation where familiar structures and beliefs begin to slowly crumble. This is not a sudden collapse, but rather a gradual realization that some aspects of your life need serious rethinking. The day may bring revelations that you have long avoided noticing or accepting. You may find that some of your beliefs are based on false assumptions, and now is the time to reconsider them.
16.meaning.reversed.simple_daySuggest.1: In the advice position, the Tower reversed suggests that you can avoid a potential crisis today if you are willing to voluntarily let go of what no longer serves your highest good. The card suggests that you intuitively sense what changes are needed, but there may be fear or resistance. Today offers you the opportunity to begin the process of transformation smoothly and consciously, avoiding dramatic and painful upheavals in the future.
16.advice.reversed.simple_daySuggest.0: The Tower reversed advises you to listen carefully to your inner signals and intuition today. Pay attention to areas of your life where you feel growing tension or discomfort—this is where changes may be needed. Instead of ignoring these signals, acknowledge their value and begin a gradual process of review and transformation. Today is a favorable day to gently let go of outdated beliefs or habits that limit you and open yourself up to new experiences and opportunities.
16.meaning.reversed.thematic_relationshi: In the «Your feelings» position, the Tower reversed indicates that you feel internal resistance to changes in your relationship, even if you intuitively understand their necessity. You may feel that your feelings toward your partner are changing, but you are trying to hold on to your previous ideas about your relationship. You may be afraid to admit that some aspects of your feelings or expectations in the relationship need to be reevaluated. A slow reevaluation of the emotional connection is taking place within you, and this is causing some tension.

In the «Partner's Feelings» position, the Tower reversed indicates that your partner is trying to avoid emotional turmoil and maintain the existing order in the relationship, even if it no longer meets their inner needs. They may suppress a growing awareness that their feelings or expectations have changed, out of fear of destroying what has been built between you. This card indicates your partner's inner conflict between the desire for stability and the need for more authentic and deeper emotional connections or space for personal growth.

In the «Your potential in relationships» position, the Tower reversed indicates that your main potential lies in your ability to initiate and guide the process of relationship transformation in the most harmonious way. You have the ability to break destructive patterns and false beliefs that limit the development of your relationships, while preserving what is truly valuable. You are able to see which aspects of your relationships need to change and can facilitate their gradual and conscious transformation without dramatic crises or complete breakdowns.

In the «Partner's Potential in Relationships» position, the Tower reversed shows that your partner has the ability to prevent destructive conflicts and crises in relationships by finding compromise solutions. Their potential lies in their ability to notice growing tensions and address them before they escalate into serious problems. However, this card also warns that your partner may be too eager to maintain stability, which can lead to the suppression of necessary changes. His challenge is to learn to distinguish when it is worth preserving existing structures and when to allow them to transform.

In the «Relationship Advice» position, the Tower reversed recommends that you pay attention to those aspects of your relationship that no longer align with your true needs and values. The card advises you not to wait until tensions reach a critical point, but to begin the process of gradual change now. Instead of clinging to false ideas about your relationship or your partner, try to take an honest look at reality and accept the need for transformation. This may not mean a complete breakdown of the relationship, but rather a renewal and a move to a deeper and more authentic level of interaction.

In the «Future of the Relationship» position, the Tower reversed indicates that a period of transformation and restructuring of the relationship lies ahead, but that this process will be smoother and less dramatic than it could be. Although certain aspects of your relationship need to be reevaluated and changed, it is possible to avoid complete destruction and a painful breakup. The future offers a chance to gradually let go of outdated patterns and expectations in order to create a more lasting and authentic connection. However, this will require your willingness to accept and support the necessary changes rather than resisting them.
16.advice.reversed.thematic_relationship: The Tower reversed advises you not to be afraid to acknowledge and discuss with your partner those aspects of your relationship that cause you discomfort or a feeling of incompatibility. Instead of avoiding difficult topics for fear of disrupting the existing harmony, find the courage to initiate an honest and open dialogue. Remember that sometimes it is necessary to partially dismantle outdated structures in order to build something more durable and in line with your true needs. Look for ways to gently and gradually transform your relationship while maintaining a deep connection and mutual respect.
16.description.reversed.0: The Tower reversed symbolizes a delay or mitigation of destructive processes that, in the normal position of the card, could occur suddenly and dramatically. This card indicates that you are resisting necessary changes and transformations, trying to preserve existing structures and beliefs, even if they no longer serve your highest good. The reversed Tower suggests that destructive energy is building up inside, but so far it has found only partial and less dramatic outlets. This can manifest as internal tension, periodic outbreaks of conflict, or a gradual realization that change is inevitable. In this position, the card often indicates the possibility of avoiding catastrophic upheavals through conscious acceptance of the need for change and a willingness to voluntarily let go of what no longer works. The Tower reversed may also indicate that you are in the process of recovering from a serious crisis or destruction, gradually integrating the lessons learned and building a new foundation for your life. This is a period when chaos begins to take shape and new opportunities and insights sprout from the destruction.
16.advice.reversed.default.0: The Tower reversed advises you to listen closely to your intuition and recognize those aspects of your life that need transformation. Instead of resisting inevitable changes out of fear of the unknown, try to meet them with an open heart and a flexible mind. Remember that by initiating the necessary changes yourself, you gain the opportunity to guide the transformation process and avoid more dramatic and painful upheavals in the future. Look for ways to gradually let go of outdated structures, beliefs, and relationships that no longer serve your true nature and goals. Allow yourself to see destruction not as the end, but as a necessary condition for a new beginning and growth.
16.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.0: In the position 'What I feel towards my partner', the Tower reversed indicates that your feelings are undergoing a profound transformation. You may be experiencing internal resistance to the changes taking place in your perception of your partner and your relationship. You may be trying to hold on to your old ideas about love and romantic feelings, but subconsciously you already understand that they do not correspond to reality. This card may indicate that you are holding back destructive emotions or avoiding confrontation for fear that it will lead to the breakdown of the relationship. Your feelings may be mixed: on the one hand, you feel attachment and a desire to maintain the relationship, and on the other, you have a growing awareness of the need for change.
16.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.1: In the «How my partner feels about me» position, the Tower reversed indicates that your partner is experiencing an internal conflict regarding their feelings for you. They may be trying to suppress a growing awareness that certain aspects of your relationship need serious rethinking. Your partner is likely afraid of potential change and is trying to preserve the existing structure of the relationship, even if it is no longer satisfying. This card may also indicate that your partner is preventing open conflict or avoiding difficult topics out of fear that it will destroy the connection between you.
16.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.2: In the «How to behave» position, the Tower reversed recommends that you not be afraid to initiate gradual changes in your relationship. Instead of waiting for tensions to reach a critical point and lead to an inevitable crisis, begin the process of transformation consciously and smoothly. This card advises you to be honest with yourself and your partner about your needs and expectations. Try not to cling to illusions or outdated ideas about your relationship. Be prepared to reevaluate and, if necessary, dismantle those aspects of the relationship that limit your growth and happiness, while preserving the valuable core of the relationship.
16.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.3: In the «What to Avoid» position, the Tower reversed warns you to avoid excessive resistance to change in your relationship. Do not try to preserve the status quo at all costs if you feel that it no longer aligns with your true needs and values. This card also advises you not to suppress your true feelings and thoughts out of fear of conflict or loss. Avoid letting tension and unresolved issues build up, as this can ultimately lead to a more dramatic and painful breakup. Don't ignore warning signs or put off dealing with issues that need immediate attention.
16.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.4: In the «Where is the relationship going» position, the Tower reversed indicates that your relationship is on the verge of significant changes, but these changes may occur more smoothly and less dramatically than they could. The card predicts a period of transformation during which outdated structures and patterns of interaction will gradually break down, making room for a more authentic and healthy connection. The movement of the relationship will be directed toward overcoming illusions and creating a more solid foundation based on a realistic perception of each other and the situation. This may be a difficult period, but it is necessary for the evolution of your relationship.
16.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.5: In the «Outcome, Relationship Advice» position, the Tower reversed indicates that in order to preserve and renew your relationship, you must consciously go through a process of transformation. The card advises you not to be afraid to let go of those aspects of the relationship that no longer serve your mutual growth and happiness. The result can be a significant renewal and deepening of your relationship if you are both willing to let go of illusions and false expectations. However, if resistance to change is too strong, there is a risk that the accumulated tension will eventually lead to a more dramatic breakup. The key to a positive outcome lies in your willingness to engage in honest dialogue and work together to rebuild your relationship on a healthier foundation.
16.advice.reversed.thematic_love.0: The Tower reversed advises you to find the courage to take an honest look at those aspects of your relationship that cause you discomfort or a feeling of incompatibility. Instead of suppressing your doubts or avoiding difficult conversations, initiate an open and respectful dialogue with your partner about what needs to change. Remember that transformation does not necessarily mean complete destruction—it can be a process of renewal and deepening of connection. Try to let go of your fear of change and trust that any true and valuable aspects of your relationship will withstand the necessary transformation.
15.meaning.upright.thematic_careerFinanc: In the «Current situation at work» position, the Devil indicates a toxic work environment where you may feel trapped. You may be bound by a contract or obligations that limit your freedom of action. There may be manipulation, political games, or unhealthy competition in the workplace. Your attachment to material well-being may cause you to tolerate unfavorable conditions. You may feel that you cannot leave due to financial dependence or fear of change. This card may also indicate that you are too focused on the material aspects of your work, forgetting your true passion and calling.

In the «Obstacles» position, the Devil reveals your own internal limitations and dependencies that are hindering your professional growth. You may have become a hostage to your desires, fears, or material needs. Negative thought patterns, such as fear of failure, impostor syndrome, or perfectionism, may be holding you back. The card indicates that the main obstacle is your own attachment to a comfortable but limiting situation. You may be so dependent on the approval of others, status, or financial stability that it prevents you from making risky but necessary decisions for your career development.

In the «Influence of the Past» position, the Devil refers to past decisions made out of fear or material necessity that continue to influence your career. Perhaps you chose a path that promised financial stability rather than one that brought true satisfaction. The card may also indicate negative professional relationships or commitments from the past that still influence your work. You may have created a pattern where you repeatedly choose unsuitable jobs out of fear of change or self-doubt. These past choices have formed chains that still limit your professional potential.

In the «Likely outcome if no action is taken» position, the Devil warns of a growing sense of entrapment and dependence if you do not take action. The current situation may turn into a golden cage that will become increasingly difficult to escape from over time. The material possessions or stability that keep you in place may become your shackles, and dissatisfaction will grow. You may find yourself even more deeply entangled in office politics or unhealthy working relationships. Your work identity may become so dominant that it overshadows other aspects of your life, creating imbalance and burnout.

In the «Ways of Acting» position, the Devil urges you to recognize and acknowledge your dependencies and limitations in your professional life. The first step toward liberation is understanding the chains that bind you. Consider what exactly is keeping you in an unsatisfactory situation—fear, money, comfort, or habit? The card advises you to reevaluate your material needs and the price you pay to satisfy them. You may need to find a balance between financial well-being and inner satisfaction from your work. The Devil may also indicate the need to resist manipulation or toxic elements in the workplace by openly discussing problems and setting healthy boundaries.

In the «Possible consequences of your actions» position, the Devil warns that the path to freedom from professional shackles will require courage and a willingness to give up illusory security. By acknowledging and working on your dependencies, you may experience temporary discomfort or uncertainty. However, this process will lead to greater awareness in your career decisions and financial matters. Standing up to manipulation in the workplace may cause tension, but it will ultimately create a healthier work environment. Reevaluating your material needs may lead to lifestyle changes, but also to greater financial independence and freedom of choice in your professional life.

In the «Potential of the Situation» position, the Devil contains the possibility of a profound transformation of your relationship with work and money. Behind the dark appearance of this card lies the potential for liberation from illusions and the attainment of true independence. The situation can be a catalyst for reevaluating your true desires and professional goals, separating them from the expectations imposed by society or your environment. Awareness of your dependencies opens the way to overcoming them. Current difficulties can teach you to manage your resources more consciously and effectively, developing financial wisdom. Ultimately, going through the Devil's trials can lead to greater authenticity in your career choices and a healthier relationship with the material world.

In the «Recommendations» position, the Devil advises you to carefully review contracts and commitments before taking on new ones. Be cautious with financial decisions that could create long-term dependency. The card recommends analyzing what exactly makes you feel trapped in your current situation and working to free yourself from these shackles. Pay attention to subtle manipulation in your professional environment and learn to recognize it. You may want to reevaluate your attitude toward material possessions and status—are they really necessary, or do they simply create an illusion of security? The Devil recommends seeking a balance between practical needs and spiritual fulfillment in your work.

In the «Outcome» position, the Devil indicates that the final result will be freedom from professional illusions and dependencies, although this process may not be easy. Once you overcome your initial resistance to change, you will be able to create a healthier relationship with money and work. The card predicts that you will learn to recognize situations where material gain comes at the expense of your freedom or values. Ultimately, you will be able to develop a more conscious approach to your career, based on a balance between financial needs and inner satisfaction. The Devil in this position may also indicate that you will find a way to use your material resources and professional skills to create greater independence rather than dependence.
15.advice.upright.thematic_careerFinance: In financial and career matters, the Devil advises caution against the temptation to compromise your values for material gain. Carefully read the fine print in contracts and agreements—what seems like an attractive offer may contain hidden obligations or restrictions. Recognize your professional dependencies and work to overcome them: these may include dependence on the approval of colleagues, status, or a certain level of income. Try to distinguish between true needs and desires that are based on fear or feelings of inadequacy. Remember that financial stability should serve your freedom, not limit it. Invest time in developing skills that will make you a more independent and valuable professional, capable of determining your own career path.
15.meaning.upright.universal_celticCross: In the «Situation» position, the Devil indicates that there is some form of dependency, limitation, or attachment at the center of your current situation. You may feel trapped by circumstances, relationships, or your own destructive habits. This card indicates a situation where there is a temptation to take the easy but potentially harmful path. You may be influenced by material desires or passions that overshadow deeper values. The Devil may also indicate that you feel powerless to change your circumstances, even though the keys to your chains are in your hands. The situation may involve elements of manipulation, codependency, or illusions of well-being that mask deeper problems.

In the «Situation Development» position, the Devil indicates that the current situation is developing in the direction of even greater dependence or limitation unless conscious steps are taken toward liberation. Attachments that now seem manageable may become stronger and more dominant in your life. The card warns of the growing influence of materialism, sensual pleasures, or destructive relationships that may overshadow other aspects of your life. You may be moving toward a moment when the price of apparent security or pleasure becomes clear. The Devil in this position may also indicate an increase in manipulative tactics from those around you, or that your own fears and desires are becoming increasingly controlling factors in your decision-making.

In the «Hint» position, the Devil offers unexpected advice: pay attention to your shadow sides and dependencies instead of denying their existence. This card suggests that the key to solving the problem lies in acknowledging and accepting your desires and fears, rather than trying to suppress them. The Devil reminds you that no chains can hold you if you are truly determined to break free—chains are often illusory and exist only because you believe in their power. The hint may also lie in the need for a more sober and realistic view of the situation, discarding rose-colored glasses and illusions. The card suggests exploring what exactly gives you a feeling of dependence or limitation and asking yourself whether these limitations are real or only exist in your perception.

In the «Origins of the Situation» position, the Devil indicates that the roots of the current problem lie in past decisions made under the influence of fear, material desires, or sensual pleasures. Perhaps you made choices based on short-term gain rather than long-term well-being. The card may also indicate that the situation arose from unconscious patterns of behavior or beliefs that have developed over the years. The Devil in this position often points to moments when you gave up personal power or freedom in exchange for security, comfort, or approval. The roots may also be related to external manipulation that you succumbed to or the temptation to take the path of least resistance, which ultimately led to your current limitations.

In the «Past» position, the Devil refers to a significant period in your history when you were under the influence of strong material or sensual desires, possibly even addictions. This time may have been marked by relationships that involved elements of control, manipulation, or codependency. The card suggests that in the past, you may have made choices based more on fear or desire than on inner wisdom. Perhaps you created a situation that was difficult to get out of, or willingly accepted limitations that seemed safe or beneficial at the time. The Devil in this position may also indicate a period when you felt deprived of choice or power, although freedom was always available if you decided to take responsibility for your life.

In the Future position, the Devil foretells a period when you will have to confront your shadow sides and addictions. You may find yourself tempted or in a situation that requires you to choose between immediate gratification and long-term freedom. This card warns of potential relationships or circumstances that may offer apparent security or pleasure at the cost of your independence. However, the Devil also holds the potential for deep awareness and transformation—confronting your own demons can lead to liberation from their power. The future may bring a moment of truth when illusions dissipate and you clearly see the chains that bind you, giving you the opportunity to break free.

In the «What lies ahead» position, the Devil signals an upcoming encounter with a situation that will require you to acknowledge and overcome your addictions, fears, or limiting beliefs. You will face temptations that will test your ability to distinguish between true needs and destructive desires. The card may also indicate a period when the consequences of past choices made under the influence of materialism or fear will become apparent. However, this is not necessarily a negative prediction—the Devil also heralds the possibility of liberation from the shackles you have placed on yourself. You will gain a deep understanding of the mechanisms that keep you in undesirable situations, and this awareness will be the first step toward gaining true freedom of choice.

In the «External Influence» position, the Devil indicates the presence of people or circumstances in your environment that may have a manipulative or limiting influence on you. This could be a person who exploits your vulnerability or desires to achieve their own goals, or a social environment that encourages materialism and superficial values. The card may also refer to external pressure to conform to certain standards or expectations, even if they conflict with your true needs. The Devil in this position warns you to carefully evaluate advice and influences from others, especially if they appeal to your fears or promise easy solutions to complex problems. External influences can be subtle, masquerading as concern or rational arguments, but at their core is a desire to limit your freedom of choice.

In the «Hope» position, the Devil reveals the complex dynamics of your desires and fears. The card may indicate that deep down you hope for a quick or easy solution to your problems, even though you rationally understand that such an approach may come at a price. Perhaps you crave freedom from responsibility or dream of a situation where you can reap the benefits without having to sacrifice anything in return. The Devil may also reflect the ambivalence of your hopes—on the one hand, the desire to break free from limitations, and on the other, the fear of the unknown that follows such freedom. The card may indicate a hope that material well-being or sensual pleasures will fill an inner void or compensate for emotional needs, although subconsciously you may understand the illusory nature of such expectations.

In the «Outcome» position, the Devil indicates a final confrontation with your addictions and limitations, which will lead either to liberation or to a deeper descent into illusion. The final outcome depends largely on your willingness to acknowledge the true nature of the chains that bind you. This card predicts a moment of truth when it becomes impossible to ignore the price you pay for comfort, security, or pleasure. The Devil in the final position often indicates a transformative experience through which you will realize that the keys to your shackles have always been within you. The end result may be a new level of self-awareness, where you learn to distinguish between your true needs and artificial desires imposed by society or fear. The outcome can be liberating, even if the path to it involves temporary discomfort or the need to give up apparent benefits.
In the context of the Celtic Cross spread, the Devil advises you to carefully analyze your attachments and dependencies to determine which ones truly serve your highest good and which ones are merely illusory chains. Realize that your feelings of being trapped or powerless often come from within—real limitations are rarely as insurmountable as they seem. The card recommends being honest with yourself about your motives and desires: are you acting out of genuine needs or out of fear, greed, or a desire for power? The Devil advises seeking a balance between material needs and spiritual growth, without denying either dimension of life. Remember that acknowledging a problem is the first step toward solving it, so don't be afraid to look into your shadow and name your demons. Set boundaries in relationships where there are elements of control or manipulation, and practice mindfulness in situations where you feel tempted or pressured to compromise your values.
15.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.0: In the «Past» position, the Devil card indicates a period in your life when you were under the influence of destructive habits or unhealthy attachments. Perhaps you were involved in toxic relationships that drained your energy, or you fell into the trap of material desires, sacrificing your true values. This may have been a time when you felt constrained by circumstances and unable to see a way out. These experiences, though painful, have become important lessons, showing you the darker sides of your nature and teaching you to recognize situations where outward appeal hides inner emptiness or danger.
15.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.1: In the «What is happening now» position, the Devil indicates that you are in a situation where you feel enslaved. This may be related to material dependence, unhealthy relationships, or your own destructive habits. You may feel that the chains binding you are too strong to break. You may know that certain aspects of your life are harmful to you, but you find it difficult to let them go. The card warns that you may not be fully aware of how deeply you are stuck in this situation, because often the most dangerous traps are the ones we create for ourselves.
15.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.2: In the «How events will unfold» position, the Devil heralds a period when you will have to face your own dark sides and temptations. Events will unfold in such a way that you will be faced with a choice: continue living in illusions and dependencies, or find the strength within yourself to break these chains. This can be a painful process that requires deep self-analysis and recognition of the true motives behind your actions. You may go through a period of self-doubt and questioning your values, but it is precisely this test that will give you the chance to free yourself from your inner demons and find true freedom, based not on denying your dark side, but on accepting and transforming it.
15.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.3: In the «Hint» position, the Devil card advises you to carefully examine the areas of your life where you feel powerless or enslaved. The key to liberation lies not in external circumstances, but in the realization that the chains that bind you are largely illusory and created by your own fears and attachments. Face the truth: what is keeping you in situations that do not satisfy you? What shadow aspects of your personality do you refuse to acknowledge? Often, the most destructive patterns of behavior have their roots in deep unmet needs. Find healthy ways to satisfy them.
15.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.4: In the «External Influences» position, the Devil points to the presence of people or circumstances in your environment that may contribute to your self-deception or addictive behavior. Perhaps someone is intentionally or unconsciously pushing you toward materialism, indulging base desires, or choosing easy but destructive paths. Social pressure and collective values may cause you to strive for things that will not truly satisfy you. Be especially attentive to situations where you are attracted to something solely because of the promise of quick pleasure or temporary relief from pain, as it is in these moments that the Devil's influence is strongest.
15.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.5: In the «Obstacles» position, the Devil symbolizes internal blocks that are hindering your progress. The main obstacle is the illusion of helplessness — the belief that you cannot change your situation. You may feel trapped by your own desires, addictions, or material needs. Fear of the unknown and the comfort of the familiar, even if it is harmful, keep you from changing. Another obstacle may be the denial of your shadow side — those aspects of your personality that you consider unworthy or shameful. Until you acknowledge their existence and integrate them into your personality in a healthy way, they will continue to sabotage your efforts from afar.
15.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.6: In the «What awaits you» position, the Devil card foretells a moment of truth when you will be forced to look at your shadows and dependencies. You will gain a deep awareness of those aspects of your life that have long been hidden or ignored. This can be a painful but transformative experience. If you accept this challenge with courage and honesty, you will gain a new level of freedom and self-knowledge. However, if you continue to deny your shadow side or indulge in destructive habits, these chains will become even heavier. Remember that true liberation comes through acknowledging your dark side, not running away from it.
15.advice.upright.universal_horseshoe.0: The Devil card advises you to take an honest look at the areas of your life where you feel enslaved or dependent, and to recognize that the keys to these chains are in your hands. Start small: identify one habit or pattern of behavior that is harmful to you and work on changing it. Look for the true causes of your addictions—they are often rooted in unmet emotional needs. Learn to distinguish between healthy desires and destructive obsessions. Remember that freeing yourself from the Devil's power does not mean completely renouncing material pleasures or suppressing your desires — it is more about finding balance and awareness in your relationship with them. Practice being present in the moment and mindful of your thoughts to recognize moments of self-deception.
15.meaning.upright.selfDevelopment_shado: In the position «What qualities of mine remain in the shadows», the Devil card reveals your suppressed desires, instincts, and aspirations that you consider unacceptable or dangerous. Your unbridled sexuality, thirst for power or material possessions, which you are ashamed to admit, may be hidden in the shadows. Perhaps you are suppressing your desire for freedom from social restrictions and conventions. This card also points to shadow traits—selfishness, greed, jealousy—that you refuse to acknowledge as part of yourself. It is these qualities, when left unacknowledged, that can take control in moments of weakness, causing you to act impulsively and then regret your actions.

In the position «What makes me hide them», the Devil points to deep fears and social programming that force you to suppress certain aspects of your personality. Fear of rejection by society or loved ones causes you to hide those parts of yourself that do not conform to generally accepted moral or ethical norms. Perhaps you had a traumatic experience in childhood when expressing these qualities led to punishment or condemnation. Religious or cultural beliefs may make you feel guilty about natural human desires, causing you to consider them sinful or base. You may also hide these qualities out of fear of losing control—the fear that if you allow your desires to manifest, they will completely take over your life.

In the «Where will this lead» position, the Devil card warns that the uncontrolled release of shadow aspects can initially lead to chaos and extremes. Long-suppressed desires have a tendency to erupt with destructive force. However, if you approach this process consciously, acknowledging your shadow can lead to profound psychological transformation. You may discover new sources of creative energy and a deeper understanding of yourself and those around you. Integrating your shadow qualities will make you a more whole person. Instead of expending enormous amounts of mental energy suppressing these aspects, you will be able to channel that energy toward constructive goals, gaining greater inner freedom and strength.

In the position «What will help me make friends with my shadow», the Devil advises you to start by accepting all aspects of your personality without judgment. Understanding that there are dark sides to every person will help you treat your shadow with greater compassion. Working with an experienced psychologist or psychotherapist can provide a safe space to explore repressed parts of yourself. Mindfulness and meditation practices allow you to observe your thoughts and desires without immediately reacting to them. Keeping a journal, especially a dream journal, can help reveal symbols and images of your shadow. Creative self-expression—through art, dance, writing—is also a powerful tool for safely exploring and transforming shadow aspects.

In the position «What resources can my shadow side open up for me?», the Devil card reveals that your shadow contains enormous untapped potential. Integrating your shadow aspects will release creative energy that was previously spent on suppressing them. Accepting your «dark» desires and instincts will give you access to your primal life force, passion, and depth of emotional experience. Your shadow holds valuable qualities necessary for survival and prosperity: healthy aggression to defend your boundaries, passion to pursue your goals, and cunning to maneuver in complex social situations. By acknowledging your shadow, you will gain greater psychological integrity, authenticity, and the ability to form deeper, more honest relationships with others.
15.advice.upright.selfDevelopment_shadow: The devil is calling you on a courageous journey into the depths of your own subconscious to come face to face with your demons. Start small — observe your reactions and triggers, especially when you experience disproportionately strong emotions. These moments often indicate the activation of shadow aspects. Find safe ways to express the suppressed parts of yourself, such as through creativity or role-playing. Keep a shadow journal, writing down thoughts and desires that you usually suppress. Remember that the goal of shadow work is not to indulge all impulses, but to become aware of them and transform them. Look for constructive ways to satisfy the needs behind destructive desires. Be patient with yourself—shadow integration is a long process that requires constant practice of mindfulness and self-compassion.
16.meaning.reversed.thematic_careerFinan: Position «Current situation at work»: The Tower reversed indicates a period when you are avoiding inevitable changes in your professional life. You are clinging to old ways of working or a position that no longer brings you satisfaction. Financially, this may mean that you are putting off dealing with budget or investment issues that require your attention. You may intuitively sense a crisis looming, but you prefer to ignore it, which only exacerbates the situation. It is important to understand that some structures in your career need to be reevaluated.

The «Obstacles» position: The Tower reversed in this position indicates that your main obstacle is fear of inevitable change. You are resisting necessary transformation, thereby creating internal tension that prevents you from moving forward. In financial terms, this may manifest as an unwillingness to admit your mistakes in managing money or investments. You may be stubbornly clinging to an unprofitable project or an ineffective financial strategy because of emotional attachment or fear of the unknown. This card warns that resisting the inevitable only prolongs your agony.

The «Influence of the Past» position: The Tower reversed indicates that you have experienced a serious upheaval in your professional or financial life in the past, but you have managed to mitigate its effects or even prevent complete collapse. Perhaps you have already faced a situation where your career stability was threatened, but somehow managed to stay afloat. This experience has taught you to be more cautious and attentive to warning signs. However, there is a risk that you are now too cautious and this is preventing you from taking the necessary risks for career growth or financial success.

Position «Likely outcome if no action is taken»: The Tower reversed warns that if you continue to avoid necessary changes, you will gradually become mired in a situation that drains your energy and resources. Unlike the instant collapse symbolized by the upright Tower, you will face a slow but steady deterioration of your financial situation or career prospects. It's like a slow leak in a tire—not a disaster, but over time it makes it impossible to move forward. Inaction will cause you to miss opportunities for growth and development that could arise after the necessary transformation.

Action Position: The Tower reversed recommends that you take a proactive approach to changes in your career and finances, rather than waiting for them to happen on their own. Consider the structures and beliefs that no longer serve your growth. It may be time to rethink your approach to work, learn new skills, or change your financial habits. It is important to remember that controlled destruction of the old and ineffective will free up space for the new and productive. Identify aspects of your career or financial situation that need updating and develop a step-by-step plan for their transformation.

Position «Possible consequences of your actions»: The Tower reversed in this position promises that if you decide to make the necessary changes, you will be able to avoid sudden collapse and undergo a smoother and more controlled transformation. Instead of experiencing a shocking collapse of your career or finances, you will have the opportunity to gradually rebuild your professional life on a more solid foundation. Your willingness to let go of outdated work methods or financial strategies will open the door to new, more suitable opportunities. Although the process of change may be uncomfortable, it will not be as disruptive as if you continue to ignore the warning signs.

The 'Potential of the Situation' position: The Tower reversed indicates that the current situation has the potential for controlled transformation rather than complete collapse. You can use this time to systematically eliminate inefficient aspects of your work or financial strategy. Unlike the sudden destruction symbolized by the upright Tower, the reversed card offers you the opportunity to dismantle unstable structures brick by brick and use the materials to build a more solid foundation. This process may open up new professional horizons or more stable financial opportunities that were previously hidden behind outdated structures.

Recommendations: The Tower reversed advises you not to fear change, but to embrace it as a necessary part of your professional and financial development. Instead of waiting for change to be imposed from outside, take the initiative into your own hands. Conduct an audit of your career and financial situation, identify weaknesses, and develop a plan to strengthen or transform them. Remember that controlled destruction of the old and ineffective is always preferable to sudden collapse. Use this period to gradually free yourself from practices that no longer serve your well-being and create space for new, more promising opportunities.

The «Outcome» position: The Tower reversed in the outcome position indicates that the result of your journey will be the prevention of disaster and a smoother transition to a new stage in your career or financial life. Instead of the painful and sudden destruction that could have occurred, you will be able to make the necessary changes with minimal loss. Your ability to recognize warning signs and take action in advance will allow you to avoid serious problems. Ultimately, you will discover that what you were so afraid to give up was actually holding you back, and now that you are free of these limitations, you can move toward greater prosperity and success.
16.advice.reversed.thematic_careerFinanc: The Reversed Tower strongly advises you not to ignore warning signs in your career or financial situation. Instead of waiting for the situation to reach a critical point, start taking action now while you still have time to make controlled changes. Conduct an honest assessment of your professional path: what aspects of your work or business are built on shaky ground? What financial habits or decisions could lead to problems in the future? Once you have identified these areas, develop a step-by-step plan to transform them. Remember that voluntarily dismantling outdated structures is always less painful than being forced to do so. Allow yourself to let go of what no longer serves your growth and create space for new opportunities.
16.meaning.reversed.universal_celticCros: Position «Situation»: The Tower reversed in the center of the spread indicates that you are in a period when significant upheavals and disruptions that could occur in your life are temporarily postponed or manifest in a milder form. You may intuitively sense an impending crisis and are taking steps to mitigate its effects. In the current situation, you are trying to avoid sudden changes and hold on to existing structures, even if they no longer serve your highest good. This can create internal tension, as part of you understands the need for change, but fear of the unknown causes you to cling to the familiar.

Position «Development of the situation»: The Tower reversed in this position indicates that in the near future you may avoid a sudden disaster or crisis thanks to your actions and awareness. The energy of change will be present, but instead of sudden destruction, you will be able to channel it into gradual transformation. You may begin to recognize false beliefs and outdated structures in your life and start to reevaluate them. This process may be uncomfortable, but it will be much less traumatic than a sudden collapse. The reversed Tower here offers you the opportunity to dismantle what is not working, brick by brick, rather than waiting for it to collapse on its own.

The «Hint» position: The Tower reversed in this position is an important piece of advice to pay attention to those areas of your life where you are stubbornly resisting necessary changes. The card suggests that you consider voluntarily letting go of outdated beliefs, relationships, or situations that no longer serve your growth. The Tower reversed suggests that you now have the opportunity to make these changes gradually and with minimal loss, but if you continue to ignore the need for change, the universe may intervene in a more dramatic way. Pay attention to areas where you feel hidden tension or dissonance—that is where your attention is needed.

The «Origins of the Situation» position: The Tower reversed indicates that the roots of your current situation lie in a past experience where you were able to avoid or mitigate a significant crisis. Perhaps you have already faced a situation that could have led to the complete collapse of an important area of your life, but you managed to prevent the worst-case scenario. This experience has taught you to be more cautious and attentive to warning signs, but it may also have made you afraid of any serious changes. The roots of the current situation may also be related to the fact that you have been putting off necessary changes for a long time due to fear of chaos and uncertainty, which has led to a build-up of tension.

The «Past» position: The Tower reversed in the past position indicates that you have recently gone through a period when you could have faced serious upheaval or the destruction of familiar structures, but somehow managed to soften the blow. Perhaps you saw warning signs and took steps to prevent a complete collapse. This card may also indicate that in the past you avoided necessary changes and postponed dealing with problems, which led to the accumulation of tension in the present. Your desire to maintain stability and avoid the pain and chaos associated with transformation may have temporarily delayed the inevitable, but it has not eliminated the need for change.

The Future Position: The Tower reversed in the future position foretells a period when you will be able to avoid sudden crisis or destruction thanks to your awareness and readiness for gradual change. Instead of a dramatic collapse, you will be able to carry out the necessary transformation in a gentler and more controlled manner. This does not mean that the changes will be easy or comfortable, but you will be able to maintain control over the process and minimize losses. You may realize the need to let go of certain beliefs, relationships, or situations that no longer serve your highest good, and you will do so voluntarily, without waiting for life to force you to do so through a crisis.

Position «What to expect»: The Tower reversed in this position indicates that in the near future you will find yourself in a situation where you will be able to prevent or mitigate a significant crisis through timely action. You may notice the first signs of impending problems in your relationships, work, or other important areas of your life and take action before the situation gets out of hand. This card may also indicate a period when you will finally decide to let go of what has not been working in your life for a long time, but you will do so consciously and gradually, rather than through a painful crisis. A time of purposeful dismantling of outdated structures and beliefs awaits you, which will free up energy for new growth.

Position «External Influence»: The Tower reversed in the position of external influence indicates that the people or circumstances around you may help prevent or mitigate a potential crisis in your life. Perhaps someone in your circle will notice warning signs and bring them to your attention, or external events will create conditions for a gradual rather than abrupt transformation. This card may also indicate that there are people in your environment who, like you, are trying to avoid necessary changes and are supporting you in maintaining the status quo, even if it is not in your best interest. Pay attention to whose influence is really helping you grow and whose is keeping you in your comfort zone.

The Hope Position: The Tower reversed in the hopes and fears position indicates that you subconsciously hope to avoid painful changes and upheavals in your life. You strive for stability and predictability, even if you intuitively understand that some aspects of your life need to be transformed. You may fear the chaos and uncertainty that may follow the destruction of familiar structures, and hope to find a way to make the necessary changes as gently and painlessly as possible. This card may also indicate your hidden hope that problems will somehow resolve themselves without the need for active action on your part.

The «Outcome» position: The Tower reversed in the outcome position indicates that the result of your journey will be the ability to avoid or significantly mitigate a potential crisis thanks to your awareness and readiness for gradual change. Instead of a sudden and painful destruction of old structures, you will undergo the necessary transformation with minimal losses. This does not mean that the process will be easy—you will need courage to take an honest look at aspects of your life that no longer serve your growth and willingly let them go. However, the result is worth the effort—by freeing yourself from false beliefs and outdated patterns, you will create space to build a more authentic and sustainable reality.
16.advice.reversed.universal_celticCross: The reversed Tower urges you not to ignore internal or external signals that change is needed. Instead of waiting for the situation to reach a critical point and destruction to become inevitable, begin the process of transformation now, while you still have the ability to control its course. Take an honest look at the aspects of your life that are based on false beliefs or outdated patterns: relationships, career, value system, or self-perception. Where do you feel dissonance or tension? What are you holding on to out of fear of change, rather than because it truly serves your best interests? Begin to gradually dismantle these structures, freeing up energy and space for the new. Remember that voluntary release is always less traumatic than forced release.
In the «Past» position, the Reversed Tower indicates that you have recently avoided serious upheavals or destructive changes that could have completely transformed your life. Perhaps you have consciously or subconsciously resisted necessary changes, leading to a build-up of tension. This is a card of postponed crisis — you have temporarily prevented the inevitable collapse of outdated structures in your life. In the past, you clung to the illusion of stability and security, even when the situation called for change. This may have manifested as an unwillingness to acknowledge problems in your relationships, work, or personal growth, a refusal to let go of outdated beliefs, or a fear of the unknown.

In the «What is happening now» position, the Tower reversed indicates that you are in the process of consciously preventing a disaster or mitigating the consequences of changes that have already occurred. Right now, you may feel like you are balancing on a tightrope, trying to maintain control over a situation that threatens to spiral out of control. You may intuitively sense that radical changes are coming and are trying to prepare for them or mitigate their impact. At the moment, you may be experiencing internal resistance to the changes that are necessary for your development. This card may also indicate that you are beginning to gradually free yourself from old limiting beliefs and structures, but you are doing so slowly and cautiously, rather than through a dramatic crisis.

In the «How will events unfold» position, the Tower reversed indicates a gradual, rather than sudden, breakdown of outdated structures and beliefs in your life. Events will unfold in such a way that the transformation will be smoother than it might have been. This does not mean that there will be no change—change is inevitable—but your conscious participation in the process will help you avoid total destruction. In the future, you will have the opportunity to control the process of change and steer it in a constructive direction. Instead of sudden, shocking events that completely knock you off your feet, you will experience a series of less dramatic but significant changes that will ultimately lead to the necessary transformation of your life. This is a gentler but no less profound path to renewal.

In the «Hint» position, the Tower reversed advises you not to resist necessary changes, but to learn to manage them. This card invites you to take a close look at those aspects of your life that seem unshakable but may actually be sources of limitation and stagnation. The hint is that you should initiate the process of renewal yourself, rather than waiting for circumstances to force you to do so. Listen to your intuition, which will tell you which structures in your life have outlived their usefulness. Gradual, conscious dismantling of the outdated will free up space for the new and more authentic. Remember that controlled dismantling is always preferable to unexpected collapse.

In the «External Influences» position, the Tower reversed indicates that processes are taking place around you that could lead to serious upheavals, but their destructive force is somehow being held back or redirected. Perhaps those around you are trying to maintain the appearance of stability and order, even when the foundations have already cracked. The external environment may seem deceptively calm, hiding the transformative processes taking place beneath the surface. It may also mean that someone in your circle is helping you soften the blow of inevitable change by providing support or resources.
