This card may also indicate that circumstances are coming together to create conditions for your healing and growth. The influence of the stars and cosmic energies is particularly favorable for your development and transformation at this time.
17.meaning.upright.universal_flame.7: In the «Hopes and Fears» position, the Star reveals your deep desire for healing and inner harmony. You hope to find your true purpose and live in accordance with the highest values that resonate with your soul. At the same time, you may fear that your hopes and dreams are too idealistic and unattainable in the material world. There is a fear of disappointment or loss of faith if reality does not live up to your expectations. The star in this position encourages you to find a balance between high aspirations and acceptance that not everything in life can be controlled or predicted.
17.meaning.upright.universal_flame.8: In the «Result» position, the Star foretells a favorable outcome that will bring you a sense of deep satisfaction and inner harmony. After a period of uncertainty or difficulties, you will find new hope and clarity regarding your path. This card promises healing of old wounds and restoration of energy balance, allowing you to move forward with renewed strength. The result may also be significant spiritual growth or a creative breakthrough that will open up new horizons for you. The Star indicates that your faith and patience will be rewarded, and the inner light you carry will become a beacon for others.
17.meaning.upright.universal_flame.9: In the «Short-term prospects» position, the Star indicates a period of inspiration and creative uplift that will come in the near future. New opportunities for self-expression and the realization of your ideas will open up before you. This is a favorable time to start projects related to art, healing, or spiritual practices. In the short term, you can expect an improvement in your emotional state and greater clarity regarding issues that are troubling you. The Star also heralds encounters with people who will inspire you or share valuable knowledge that will contribute to your growth and development.
17.meaning.upright.universal_flame.10: In the «Long-Term Prospects» position, the Star promises a period of harmony and balance, when various aspects of your life will come into equilibrium. In the long term, you can expect significant spiritual growth and the development of intuitive abilities that will become your reliable guides. This card indicates the possibility of finding your true calling or realizing a long-held dream that previously seemed unattainable. The Star also heralds the formation of deep and meaningful connections with like-minded people who will support you on your spiritual journey. Ultimately, you will become a source of inspiration and hope for others.
17.meaning.upright.universal_flame.11: In the «Spiritual Lessons» position, the Star teaches you the importance of faith, hope, and trust in the process of life. This card encourages you to learn the balance between active action and passive acceptance, between control and letting go. One of the key spiritual lessons of the Star is understanding the cyclical nature of existence: after darkness always comes light, after trials come renewal and growth. This card also teaches the value of authenticity and staying true to your true nature, reminding you that each of us carries a unique light within us that we are meant to share with the world. The Star shows that the path of healing and integration of the shadow aspects of the personality leads to the attainment of inner wholeness and harmony.
17.advice.upright.universal_flame.0: The Star card advises you to open yourself to the flow of inspiration and intuitive knowledge that is now available to you in abundance. Practice visualization and affirmation techniques to strengthen your belief in a favorable outcome. Find time for silence and contemplation to hear the voice of your soul and receive answers to questions that concern you. Pay attention to signs and synchronicities that appear in your life—they may contain important clues from the universe. Be generous with those around you, sharing your gifts and talents without expecting immediate rewards. Remember that true transformation takes time and patience, like a seed that must pass through the darkness of the earth before it can sprout into the light. Trust your inner compass and don't let doubts dim the light of your star.
17.meaning.upright.thematic_careerFinanc: In the «Current Situation at Work» position, the Star card indicates a period of inspiration and new opportunities in your professional life. You are at a stage where new horizons and prospects are opening up for you. Perhaps you have recently gone through a difficult period at work, and now is the time for recovery and renewal. The Star brings hope and faith in the future. This is a favorable time for creative projects, innovation, and finding your true professional path. You may discover new talents or find ways to apply your skills in unusual areas. People around you notice your potential and may offer interesting opportunities for growth.

In the «Obstacles» position, the Star indicates that your own idealism or unrealistic expectations may be the main obstacle. You may have your head in the clouds, making grandiose plans, but not taking concrete steps to implement them. Another aspect of this obstacle is excessive openness and trust in business relationships, which can make you vulnerable to manipulation by colleagues or partners. The Star may also indicate that you are waiting too long for ideal conditions instead of acting with what you have now. Your desire for perfection may slow down progress and prevent you from seeing real opportunities for growth.

In the «Influence of the Past» position, the Star card indicates that you may have experienced a period of deep disappointment or professional crisis in the past, after which you were able to recover and find new hope. This experience has taught you to value your talents and believe in yourself even in the most difficult times. Perhaps you have learned an important lesson in the past that after the darkest periods, there is always light. The Star may also indicate that you have followed your intuition or creative calling in the past, which has led you to your current position. These past decisions, based on belief in yourself and your dreams, are now having a beneficial effect on your career.

In the «Likely outcome if no action is taken» position, the Star warns that if you do not take advantage of current opportunities and inspiration, you risk missing out on a period of significant professional growth and self-fulfillment. Without active action, your talents may remain undiscovered and your creative potential unrealized. You will continue to feel that you are not working to your full potential or that you are not in the right place. The Star also says that inaction can lead to a gradual fading of the hope and optimism that now fill you. Intuitive insights and creative ideas that are not put into practice will eventually lose their power and relevance, leaving you with a feeling of missed opportunities.

In the «Ways of Acting» position, the Star recommends that you follow your intuition and inner voice when making career decisions. Now it is important to be open to new opportunities and not be afraid to experiment, even if it seems risky. The card advises you to use your unique talents and creativity that set you apart from others. The Star also suggests being generous with your knowledge and experience—share it with your colleagues, and this will create a positive working atmosphere and strengthen your reputation. It is important to remain optimistic and believe in yourself, even if the results are not immediately apparent. Plan for the future, but don't forget to enjoy the process and find inspiration in everyday tasks.

In the «Possible consequences of your actions» position, the Star predicts that your efforts, based on sincerity and belief in your calling, will bring not only material rewards but also deep satisfaction from your work. Your creative approach and optimism can inspire those around you, creating a network of support and new opportunities. The Star promises a period of recovery and renewal after any professional difficulties. Your actions may lead to recognition and acclaim in your professional community, especially if you work in a creative field or in a field that helps people. In addition, by following your true calling, you may discover new sources of income that you previously did not consider possible or significant.

In the «Potential of the Situation» position, the Star card reveals exceptionally favorable prospects for your professional development and financial situation. The current situation has the potential for a significant creative breakthrough that could take your career to a whole new level. The Star symbolizes a time of renewal and healing after difficulties—you may be able to not only regain your former position, but surpass it. There is also potential for establishing important professional connections with people who share your values and vision. These contacts may prove invaluable in the long run. The Star also indicates the possibility of finding your true calling, which will bring not only financial well-being but also deep emotional satisfaction from your work.

In the «Recommendations» position, the Star advises you to remain optimistic and believe in your abilities, even when results are not immediately apparent. It is important to follow your intuition and inner voice when making career decisions. The card recommends openly sharing your ideas and vision with colleagues and management—your enthusiasm can be contagious and open new doors. The Star also advises not to be afraid to dream big and set ambitious goals for yourself, but to break them down into realistic steps. It reminds you of the importance of work-life balance — find time to recharge and fuel your inspiration through art, nature, or spiritual practices. Be open to new approaches and unconventional solutions — now is the time for creative experimentation.

In the «Outcome» position, the Star card heralds a period of professional renewal and growth that will come after overcoming current difficulties or a period of stagnation. You will find new inspiration and a clear vision of your career path, which will allow you to move forward with confidence and optimism. Your creative ideas and sincere approach to work will be noticed and appreciated by both colleagues and management. The star also promises financial stability after a period of uncertainty — perhaps not a sudden leap in wealth, but a gradual improvement in your financial situation. Ultimately, you will be able to find harmony between material well-being and work that brings emotional satisfaction. You will feel that you are finally in the right place and doing what truly corresponds to your inner calling.
17.advice.upright.thematic_careerFinance: The Star card advises you not to be afraid to follow your dreams and intuition in your professional life, even if it requires you to step outside your comfort zone or seems risky. Right now, it is important to believe in your unique talents and not compare your path to others. The Star reminds you that after difficulties always comes a period of renewal and growth—if you have recently experienced professional disappointment or failure, accept it as part of the journey, not as the final outcome. Be open and generous with your knowledge and ideas—by sharing with others, you not only build a positive reputation, but also attract new opportunities. Plan your finances with optimism but realism—the Star promises improvement but requires action and patience on your part. Find time for creativity and inspiration outside of work—this will help you maintain enthusiasm and a fresh perspective on your professional goals.
17.meaning.upright.universal_celticCross: In the «Situation» position, the Star card indicates a period of recovery and renewal after difficult trials. You are at a point where you are beginning to see the light at the end of the tunnel and gaining new hope for the future. The current situation is characterized by growing optimism and faith that everything will work out. You may have just overcome a serious crisis or period of transformation and are now beginning to feel inner peace and clarity. The Star brings healing of emotional wounds and a new sense of meaning. You feel more open to the world, ready to share your gifts and accept help from others. This is a time when you begin to believe in your dreams and see ways to make them a reality.

In the «Situation Development» position, the Star indicates that in the near future, the situation will develop in the direction of greater harmony and balance. Obstacles that now seem insurmountable will gradually lose their power, giving way to new opportunities and prospects. You will feel increasingly confident in your abilities and capacity to overcome difficulties. The Star in this position also indicates that you will experience a period of creative inspiration and intuitive insights that will help you find solutions to long-standing problems. You may feel a surge of energy and enthusiasm associated with new ideas and projects. Relationships with those around you will develop in an atmosphere of mutual trust and openness, creating a supportive environment for your endeavors.

In the «Hint» position, the Star card recommends listening to your intuition and inner voice. Right now, your intuitive insights are particularly accurate and can lead to important discoveries. The Star suggests that restoring your strength and emotional balance is a necessary condition for moving forward. Find time for self-healing and practices that nourish your soul, whether it's creativity, meditation, or simply spending time in nature. The card also advises you to be open and sincere in your intentions and actions—purity of thought will attract the right people and situations to you. Don't be afraid to dream big and believe in the seemingly unattainable. The Star reminds you that even small steps taken with faith and optimism will ultimately lead to significant results.

In the «Origins of the Situation» position, the Star indicates that the roots of the current situation lie in a period of profound transformational crisis that you have recently experienced. You may have gone through serious trials, losses, or disappointments that have caused you to reevaluate your values and priorities. This experience, though painful, has been a catalyst for spiritual growth and renewal. Another source of the current situation may be a moment of insight or inspiration when you clearly saw your purpose or goal. This inner clarity laid the foundation for the current changes in your life. The Star in this position may also indicate that the origins of the situation are linked to your innate ability to maintain hope and faith even in the most difficult times.

In the «Past» position, the Star card indicates a recent period of healing and renewal after difficult trials. In the recent past, you may have found new hope and faith in the future after a time of doubt and uncertainty. This may have been related to a significant event or an inner realization that helped you see the light at the end of the tunnel. The Star in this position may also indicate that you have been open to new ideas and opportunities in the past, which has led to positive changes in your life. Perhaps you followed your intuition or a dream, and it began to bear fruit. The card may also indicate that you have recently experienced a period of peace and harmony, which has laid the foundation for your current state.

In the «Future» position, the Star heralds a period of hope, inspiration, and renewal that awaits you in the near future. Soon you will feel the difficulties recede, giving way to new opportunities and prospects. The future brings emotional and spiritual renewal, a return of faith in yourself and in life. The Star promises that a time of creative uplift and clarity of thought lies ahead, when you will be able to see your path in a new light. You may discover new talents or abilities that you never knew you had. The card may also indicate a meeting with someone who will be a source of inspiration and support for you, or an event that will help you regain hope if you begin to lose faith in yourself or the future.

In the «What awaits you» position, the Star card heralds a period of healing and recovery after difficult trials. A time awaits you when you can finally breathe freely and feel that the worst is behind you. The Star promises renewed vitality and new opportunities that previously seemed unattainable. In the near future, you may experience a surge of inspiration and creative energy that will allow you to realize long-cherished projects or find new ways of self-expression. This card in this position also indicates that a period of greater clarity and understanding of your path awaits you, when the fog of doubt dissipates and you can see clearly where to go next. You may find a spiritual mentor or source of wisdom who will help you develop your talents and realize your potential.

In the «External Influence» position, the Star indicates that a favorable atmosphere of support and positive influences is developing around you. Perhaps there is someone in your environment who inspires you with their faith and optimism, or you are influenced by ideas and values that nourish your hope and faith in the future. The Star in this position may also indicate that social trends or changes in the collective consciousness are favorable to your endeavors and plans. Your actions and decisions are met with understanding and acceptance from those around you. Your external environment provides you with space to recover and heal after difficulties. The card may also indicate that you are influenced by spiritual teachings or practices that help you find inner peace and clarity of vision.

In the «Hope» position, the Star card symbolizes your deep desire for inner peace, harmony, and renewal after difficult experiences. You hope for emotional healing and a revival of the joy of life that may have been lost during a period of hardship. The Star in this position also speaks of your belief that in the future you will be able to realize your creative abilities and find your true calling. You dream of a time when the fog of uncertainty will lift and the path will become clear and understandable. This card may also reflect your hope of meeting a spiritual mentor or like-minded people who share your values and will help you realize your ideas. You may also hope to restore your lost faith in people and be able to openly share your thoughts and feelings without fear of rejection.

In the «Outcome» position, the Star heralds a period of deep emotional and spiritual renewal after trials and tribulations. The outcome of the current situation will be the attainment of inner peace, clarity, and confidence in your path. You will be able to regain the strength and enthusiasm necessary to move forward toward new horizons. The Star promises that after a period of doubt and uncertainty, you will find your place in the world and realize your purpose with new clarity. This card in the outcome position also indicates that you will gain the ability to see the bigger picture of life and understand the deeper meaning of the trials you have experienced. The difficulties you have gone through will be transformed into wisdom and strength. You will become a source of inspiration and hope for those around you by sharing your experience and inner light.
The Star card advises you to keep your faith and optimism, even if the current situation seems difficult. Remember that after the darkest night, dawn always comes, and the period of trials you are going through will soon be replaced by a time of renewal and rebirth. Trust your intuition and inner voice—they are especially strong right now and can lead you to important discoveries. The Star recommends that you regularly find time for spiritual practices and contemplation, which will help you restore inner harmony and clarity. Try to be open and sincere in your relationships with the world—purity of intention and action will attract the right people and situations to you. Don't be afraid to dream big and see potential where others see only obstacles. Remember that healing is a process that takes time and patience, so be kind to yourself along the way.
17.meaning.upright.selfDevelopment_mirro: In the «How I see myself» position, the Star card reflects your perception of yourself as a person with unlimited potential and hope for a better future. You see yourself as someone capable of overcoming any difficulties and rising again after difficult trials. Right now, you feel inner harmony and confidence in your abilities, which allows you to dream of great achievements. You see yourself as a source of inspiration and light, capable of illuminating the path not only for yourself but also for those around you. The Star in this position indicates that you are aware of your connection to higher powers and believe in divine guidance in your destiny.

In the «How others see me» position, the Star card indicates that those around you perceive you as a source of inspiration and hope. You radiate a special glow that attracts people seeking support and guidance. Others see you as a person with pure intentions and an open heart, ready to share your gifts selflessly. Those around you appreciate your sincerity, spiritual depth, and ability to remain optimistic even in the most difficult situations. For many, you are an example of inner strength and faith, a beacon of light in the darkness of everyday difficulties. Your vulnerability and openness are perceived not as weakness, but as a manifestation of true wisdom and inner freedom.

In the «My Hidden Qualities» position, the Star indicates a deep spiritual wisdom that lies dormant in your subconscious. Within you lies incredible healing potential that you may not even be aware of. This card speaks of your hidden ability to intuitively understand cosmic patterns and perceive the subtle energy flows of the universe. Deep down, you possess the rare gift of seeing divine guidance in the most ordinary events and phenomena. The Star also indicates a hidden talent for meditative practices and a natural connection to higher dimensions of consciousness that are waiting to be revealed. Your soul holds the memory of its divine origin, which is a source of inexhaustible inner strength.

In the «My obvious qualities» position, the Star card reflects your obvious ability to maintain hope and faith even in the most difficult circumstances. Those around you notice your openness, sincerity, and natural behavior. You are not afraid to be vulnerable and show your true feelings, which creates an atmosphere of trust and security around you. Your generosity of spirit and willingness to share your gifts selflessly inspire those around you. You possess a special calmness and inner harmony that are clearly evident in your behavior and decisions. People turn to you for comfort and wise advice, intuitively sensing your connection to higher powers and your ability to see light where others see only darkness.

In the position «My potential for growth», the Star portends the possibility of profound spiritual renewal and transformation. You are on the threshold of a period when you will be able to fully realize your creative and spiritual talents, which you may not even be aware of. The card indicates the potential to become a conduit of healing energy for yourself and those around you. In the future, you may develop an amazing ability to inspire others by your example and restore faith in goodness and justice among the desperate. The Star also speaks of the possibility of finding deep inner peace and harmony that will allow you to overcome any obstacles with grace and dignity. Your potential includes the ability to become a beacon of hope for many people seeking light in dark times.

In the «What is holding me back» position, the Star card paradoxically points to an excessive focus on ideals that may be unattainable in the material world. You may become so immersed in dreams of a bright future and spiritual experiences that you lose sight of the practical aspects of life that require attention in the here and now. Sometimes your openness and trustfulness make you vulnerable to those who may abuse your belief in the best in people. The card also warns of a tendency toward escapism—running away from reality into a world of fantasy and illusions. Your inability to structure your spiritual insights and turn them into concrete actions may hinder you. The Star reminds you that even the most lofty dreams need practical implementation.

In the «My Fears» position, the Star card reveals your deep fear of losing hope and faith in a better future. You are afraid that one day your inner light will be extinguished and you will be left in the darkness of despair. There is a fear that your openness and vulnerability may be used against you, which sometimes makes you doubt your intuitive desire to trust people. You may also experience fear of disappointment—the fear that your most cherished dreams and hopes will never come true, that life will not live up to your expectations. Deep down, you are afraid of losing touch with the higher powers and spiritual guidance that nourish your soul and give you the strength to move forward despite the difficulties of the earthly path.

In the «My Strength» position, the Star card indicates your unshakeable faith and ability to see the light even in the darkest times. Your true strength lies in your ability to remain hopeful and optimistic when everything around you is giving way to despair. You have a natural gift for healing—both yourself and those around you—through your presence, words, and actions. Your openness and vulnerability, which may seem like weaknesses, are actually manifestations of deep inner strength and confidence. The Star emphasizes your ability to renew and revive yourself after difficulties—like a phoenix, you are able to rise from the ashes and shine even brighter. Your strength is also evident in your ability to connect with higher aspects of consciousness, which gives you access to a source of infinite cosmic wisdom and energy.

In the «My weakness» position, the Star card indicates your tendency toward unjustified idealism and detachment from reality. You can become so focused on your visionary view of the future that you neglect the practical steps needed to achieve it. Your excessive belief in the best sometimes leads to naivety and an inability to critically assess situations and people. The card also indicates a possible tendency toward passivity—you may wait too long for divine intervention instead of taking action. Your emotional openness, while a strength, makes you vulnerable to energy vampires and manipulators. Sometimes you waste your energy trying to save those who are not ready or willing to be saved, which leads to emotional exhaustion.

In the «My Path of Development» position, the Star card indicates the need to deepen your spiritual practice and strengthen your connection with higher aspects of consciousness. Your path lies through integrating spiritual insights into your daily life, turning inspiration into concrete actions. The Star invites you to become a conduit of healing energy for yourself and the world around you, developing your healing abilities. You will need to learn to find a balance between lofty ideals and practical implementation, between openness and healthy boundaries. The card also speaks of the importance of serving others without self-sacrifice, of developing the ability to inspire people by your example. On this path, you will gradually become the embodiment of the spiritual light that you now see as something external to yourself.
17.advice.upright.selfDevelopment_mirror: The Star card advises you to trust your inner voice and the intuitive insights that come in moments of silence and contemplation. Allow yourself to be open and vulnerable, but maintain healthy boundaries in your interactions with others. Don't be afraid to dream big, but remember that even the brightest star requires practical steps to achieve. Find time for regular meditation or prayer to help you stay connected to the higher aspects of consciousness. The star reminds us of the need for periodic renewal—allow yourself to let go of old thought patterns and emotional blocks that prevent you from shining. Be patient with yourself and others, remembering that true healing and transformation take time, just like the growth of any star in the universe.
17.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.0: Position «Present Situation»: The Star in this position indicates a period of deep healing and renewal that you are currently experiencing. You are on the path to a brighter future, and although this path may seem long, the stars have already lit your way. The current moment is characterized by a revival of hope and faith after a difficult period. You are beginning to see opportunities where there were only obstacles before. This is a time of spiritual awakening and restoration of inner balance. You are gaining clarity of thought and the ability to look at the situation with optimism that was previously lost. The star reminds you that even in the darkest times, there is always a light of hope.
17.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.1: Possible cause of the situation: The Star in this position reveals that the root of your current situation lies in your desire for something higher, more spiritual, and more meaningful. You have long felt an inner need to follow your true calling or dream, and it is this inner desire that has led you to your current crossroads. Perhaps you have recently gone through a period of transformation or purification that has opened the way to new opportunities. Intuition and your inner voice have been your guides, even if you have not always been aware of it. Your openness to inspiration and willingness to believe in the best have led to your current favorable circumstances or, conversely, the need to choose a new direction.
17.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.2: Position «First Path»: The Star on the first path invites you to follow your dreams and intuition, trusting the natural flow of life. This path requires openness, vulnerability, and a willingness to let go of control over every aspect of your life. Like the water that the maiden pours from the jugs on the Star card, you need to allow your talents and gifts to flow freely, nourishing both yourself and the world around you. This path leads to deep inner renewal and healing of old wounds. It may seem less predictable, but it promises true satisfaction and harmony. It is the path of creativity, inspiration, and authenticity. By choosing this path, you place your spiritual well-being above material achievements.
17.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.3: The Second Path: The Star on the second path offers you the role of a beacon for others. This is a path of service, where your light and wisdom become a source of inspiration and hope for those around you. You will use your gifts and talents to help others find their own paths through the darkness to the light. This path requires generosity of spirit and openness of heart. You will share your knowledge and experience without expecting immediate reward. This may involve teaching, healing, volunteering, or any other form of helping those who need guidance. The Star in this position reminds you that by helping others find their own inner star, you strengthen your own light.
17.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.4: The «Result of the First Path» position: The star in the result of the first path position heralds a period of deep inner peace and harmony. By choosing the path of intuition and authenticity, you will come to a state of mental balance that few achieve. Your life will be filled with meaning and beauty, and your inner light will become so bright that it will illuminate the path not only for you but also for those around you. You will find a deep connection with your higher self and be able to draw inspiration from an inexhaustible inner source. This path will not only bring you spiritual satisfaction, but will also help attract people and situations into your life that resonate with your true desires and values. Material well-being will come as a natural consequence of living in harmony with yourself.
17.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.5: The «Result of the Second Path» position: The Star in the Result of the Second Path position indicates that by choosing to serve others, you will become a source of light and hope for many people. Your name will be associated with healing, inspiration, and transformation. You will create a community of like-minded people around you, united by common values and the pursuit of the greater good. Your influence will spread like ripples on water, touching the lives of people you have never met in person. Although this path may require certain sacrifices and self-denial, the joy of seeing the growth and prosperity of those you have helped will compensate for all the difficulties. The star promises that in the process of serving others, you will also find a deep source of personal satisfaction and happiness.
17.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.6: The «Final Outcome» position: The Star in the final outcome position symbolizes the achievement of harmony between your inner desires and external reality. Regardless of the path you choose, you will arrive at a state of deep satisfaction and inner peace. Your life will become a living example of how following your true nature and highest ideals can transform an ordinary existence into something meaningful and beautiful. The star promises that the period of suffering and trials will finally be behind you, and you will enter a new phase of life filled with light and possibilities. You will look back on the path you have traveled with gratitude, realizing that each trial was a necessary step toward your transformation. Your story will inspire others and become a beacon of hope for those who are now going through their own dark night of the soul.
17.advice.upright.choice_twoPaths.0: The stars advise you now, more than ever, to trust the universe and your intuition. You are in a period of rebirth and renewal, and it is important to allow this process to unfold naturally. Do not try to force events or control every aspect of your life. Like the maiden on the Star card, who pours water onto the ground and into a pond, find a balance between giving and receiving, between action and contemplation. Take time for quiet reflection and daily practices that nourish your soul—meditation, spending time in nature, creativity, or activities that fill you with a sense of peace. Remember that hope is not just a feeling, but an active force that can transform your reality. Let the light of the Star guide you in moments of doubt, and believe that you are moving toward a better future, even if the path sometimes seems unclear.
17.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.0: Past Influence Position: The Star in the Past Influence position indicates a period of inspiration and hope that played a key role in shaping your current situation. Perhaps in the recent past you experienced a spiritual awakening or a moment of clarity that set you on your current path. It may have been a period of healing after difficult trials, when you regained your faith in life and its possibilities. The influence of the Star in the past suggests that you have already navigated the darkest waters and have begun to restore your inner balance. The seeds of hope and optimism sown during this period are now beginning to sprout, although you may not yet be fully aware of their significance. It is this restored faith in yourself and in the future that has brought you to this moment of choice.
17.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.1: Current Situation Position: The Star in the current situation position reflects a period of profound renewal and renewed hope in your life. You are in a healing phase after a difficult period of transformation. Like a night sky studded with stars, your life is now filled with new possibilities and perspectives. You are beginning to see glimmers of light where there was only darkness before. This card indicates that a channel of inspiration and spiritual guidance is now open to you. You may feel more connected to your higher self and intuition. The current moment is characterized by a calm confidence that everything is happening as it should and that you are moving in the right direction, even if the final destination is not yet visible.
17.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.2: Position «Hidden Influences»: The Star in the position of hidden influences reveals your soul's deep need for healing and reconnection with your true nature. Behind your visible circumstances and decisions lies your unconscious desire for authenticity and self-expression. You are guided by an inner light that you may not always notice, but which steadily guides you toward your true purpose. The star also indicates the presence of spiritual support and protection working behind the scenes of your life. You may be assisted by higher powers or spiritual guides that you are not aware of. Your intuition is particularly strong right now, and many of your so-called «random» thoughts or flashes of insight are actually important messages from your higher self or the universe.
17.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.3: The First Path: The Star on the first path suggests following the inner light of your intuition and creative expression. This path is associated with developing your unique talents and gifts, which can be a source of inspiration and healing for both yourself and those around you. Here, the Star encourages you to be open and vulnerable, sharing your inner light with the world without fear or doubt. This is the path of the artist, the healer, the teacher, or anyone who uses their gifts to make the world a better place. By choosing this path, you connect with your higher purpose and begin to live an authentic life true to your deepest values and aspirations. This may require you to give up some material possessions or social recognition in the short term, but it will bring deep satisfaction and harmony in the long run.
17.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.4: The Second Path: The Star on the second path invites you to deep inner healing and spiritual renewal. This path may be less focused on external achievements and more focused on restoring balance and harmony within yourself. Like the maiden on the Star card, who is bathing in sacred waters, you are invited to immerse yourself in a process of self-purification and transformation. This may include accepting past traumas, forgiving yourself and others, and letting go of outdated beliefs and behavior patterns. By choosing this path, you are choosing to fill your own cup first before sharing water with others. This is a time for meditation, reflection, therapy, spiritual practices, or other forms of inner work. The star promises that through this process of inner healing, you will ultimately achieve a state of deep peace and clarity that will shine from you naturally.
17.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.5: The Third Path: The Star on the third path leads you to serve the greater good through compassion and humanitarian efforts. This path involves using your light to illuminate the way for others who are in difficult situations. Like a star in the night sky, you become a beacon of hope and inspiration for those in darkness. This choice may lead you to volunteer, charity work, social work, environmental initiatives, or other forms of service that align with your values and vision for a better world. The star in this position reminds you that by bringing hope and healing to others, you also heal yourself. It is a path of unconditional love and acceptance that requires an open heart and a willingness to be vulnerable. By choosing this path, you become part of a larger whole and contribute to the collective healing and evolution of humanity.
17.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.6: The «Obstacles and Fears» position: The Star in the position of obstacles and fears reveals the paradoxical nature of your inner blocks. The main obstacle may be your fear of trusting the process of life and letting go of control. You may be afraid of being too open and vulnerable, fearing that your hopes will be dashed again. After a period of hardship, you have learned to protect your heart, and now you find it difficult to believe that healing and renewal are truly possible. Perhaps you fear that your inner light is not bright enough, or that you are not worthy of the beauty and harmony that the Star symbolizes. There may be a fear of disappointing others or yourself if you fully reveal your true dreams and aspirations. Sometimes it is our deepest hopes that become the source of our deepest fears, because they make us most vulnerable.
17.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.7: The position of the «Advice of Higher Powers»: The Star in the position of the advice of higher powers reminds you of the importance of unconditional faith and trust in the process of life. The higher powers advise you to remain optimistic and hopeful even in the most difficult moments, knowing that every dark night is followed by dawn. Like the stars that are always present in the sky, even when they are not visible in the daylight, your higher guidance is always with you, even when you do not feel its presence. Now is the time to be open and receptive to the signs and synchronicities that the universe is sending you. Pay attention to your dreams, intuitive insights, and coincidences—they contain important messages for you. The star also advises you to find a balance between action and passivity, between giving and receiving. Remember that you are a channel for divine energy, and your role is to allow this energy to flow freely through you, without resistance and without trying to control its direction.
17.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.8: Possible outcome position: The Star in the possible outcome position heralds a period of deep healing, inspiration, and spiritual renewal. Regardless of the path you choose, you are moving toward a state of inner harmony and peace that will radiate into all areas of your life. The Star promises that after a period of difficulties and trials, you will finally emerge into the light and begin a new chapter filled with hope and possibilities. You will find a deeper connection with your true nature and purpose. Your intuition will grow stronger, and you will see your path more clearly. Relationships will become more authentic and filled with unconditional love. Material circumstances will also improve, although this may happen in unexpected and unusual ways. The Star does not guarantee that there will be no difficulties in the future, but it promises that you will find the inner strength and wisdom to meet any challenges with an open heart and a clear mind.
17.advice.upright.choice_crossroad.0: The Star advises you to believe in the power of hope and healing, especially when the path seems unclear. Right now, it is critical to trust your intuition and inner voice, which will guide you to the right decision. Like the maiden on the Star card, who stands naked under the night sky, you need to be open and vulnerable to the universe, trusting that you will receive the support and guidance you need. Make time for regular practices that connect you to your higher self—meditation, time in nature, creative expression, or anything else that resonates with your soul. Remember that you are not alone on your journey—support is available from both visible and invisible sources. Like the Virgo jugs that water both the earth and the water, find a balance between caring for the practical aspects of life and nourishing your spiritual nature. Let the light of the Star illuminate your path, and trust that even in moments of uncertainty, you are moving in the right direction.
17.meaning.reversed.simple_YesNo.0: The Star card reversed in a 'Yes/No' spread indicates the need to reconsider your expectations of the situation. You may experience disappointment or a loss of faith in a positive outcome. The energy of the card suggests that there is currently a blockage in the flow of positive energy, and your hopes may not be fulfilled in the way you imagine. Perhaps you are idealizing the situation or unrealistically assessing your chances.
17.meaning.reversed.simple_YesNo.1: The reversed Star warns of possible obstacles on the way to the desired result. In the context of a 'Yes/No' question, it indicates stagnation of energy and loss of inspiration. You may feel drained and disappointed. The situation requires reassessment and possibly a temporary retreat. Your current actions may not bring the expected results, and your hopes may seem illusory and unattainable.
17.advice.reversed.simple_YesNo.0: The Star reversed advises you not to let disappointment completely take over your mind. Yes, the situation does not look very favorable right now, but this is a temporary state. Use this period to work on yourself internally, reevaluate your goals and aspirations. You may need to shift your focus or change your approach to solving the problem. Don't give up on your hopes completely, but be prepared for the outcome to be different than expected. Develop patience and inner resilience.
17.meaning.reversed.simple_daySuggest.0: Today, the Star card warns of a possible feeling of emptiness and emotional imbalance. You may feel that your energy is depleted and that your hopes and aspirations have temporarily left you. The day may be marked by some pessimism or disappointment in certain aspects of your life. You may encounter situations that cause you to question the correctness of your chosen path or the realism of your goals. Your inner source of inspiration may seem to have dried up at this time.
17.meaning.reversed.simple_daySuggest.1: The Star reversed in the 'Advice of the Day' spread indicates a period when you should be especially attentive to your emotional state. Today, you may experience difficulties with self-expression, creative blocks, and a feeling that those around you do not understand you. You may feel an inner emptiness or a temporary loss of meaning in your usual activities. The card warns of a possible tendency toward self-deception or excessive idealization of situations, which could lead to further disappointment.
17.advice.reversed.simple_daySuggest.0: Today, the Reversed Star advises you to find time to restore your inner balance and peace of mind. Do not make important decisions if you feel emotionally drained or pessimistic. Try not to dwell on negative thoughts or give in to excessive doubt. Instead, take time to care for yourself and restore your physical and mental well-being. Look for ways to regain inspiration through simple pleasures and small achievements. Remember that a period of decline is always followed by a period of growth.
17.meaning.reversed.thematic_relationshi: In the «Your feelings» position, the Star reversed indicates inner insecurity and disappointment in relationships. You may feel emotionally empty or feel that your hopes for this relationship are not being fulfilled. Perhaps the initial inspiration and admiration you felt for your partner has faded, and you are beginning to see reality more clearly, which is causing you sadness or disappointment. You may feel that your emotional investment is not being reciprocated, and this is gradually draining your inner resources.

In the «Partner's Feelings» position, the reversed Star indicates that your partner may be going through a period of disillusionment and emotional burnout. They may be experiencing disappointment in the relationship or feel that their expectations are not being met. Your partner may be suffering from inner emptiness, a lack of inspiration, or a feeling that something important has been lost. The emotional connection with you may seem weakened, and hopes for a harmonious relationship may be fading. He or she may not believe that the former closeness can be restored.

In the «Your potential in relationships» position, the Reversed Star warns of the need to reevaluate your expectations and role in the relationship. Your potential is currently limited by internal imbalance and a loss of faith in the possibility of harmony. You may have difficulty expressing your emotions and being open, which prevents genuine closeness. The card indicates that your desire to idealize relationships may lead to subsequent disappointment. However, this situation also holds the potential for a more realistic and healthy approach to relationships if you can overcome this period of emotional decline.

In the «Partner's Potential in Relationships» position, the reversed Star indicates that your partner is currently unable to realize their full emotional potential in the relationship. They may be going through a period of disappointment or loss of inspiration, which is preventing them from showing their best qualities. Internal blocks and emotional exhaustion may limit their ability to be open and truly intimate. Your partner may have difficulty expressing their true feelings or may see the relationship in a distorted, overly negative light, which reduces their potential for creating a harmonious connection.

In the «Relationship Advice» position, the Star reversed indicates the need to let go of unrealistic expectations and illusions about your relationship. You should take a more sober look at the situation, acknowledging both the strengths and weaknesses of the relationship. The card advises you not to sink into despair and disappointment, but instead to work on restoring your emotional balance. Perhaps you both need time and space to reevaluate your feelings and expectations. Avoid dramatizing problems and don't let temporary difficulties destroy what is valuable between you.

In the «Future of the Relationship» position, the reversed Star warns of a possible period of trials and disappointments. The relationship may face a phase of emotional cooling or loss of former illusions. You may have to go through a crisis related to a divergence between expectations and reality. However, this card does not necessarily mean a negative outcome — rather, it indicates the need to transform the relationship, abandon idealization, and build a more realistic and stable connection. If you can both overcome this period of disappointment and find the strength to renew your relationship, it may be possible to revive it on a more mature level.
17.advice.reversed.thematic_relationship: The Star reversed advises you not to give in to feelings of disappointment and despair in your relationship. Right now, it is important to accept reality as it is, without overly idealizing your partner or the relationship as a whole. Work on restoring emotional balance and inner harmony before making any final conclusions about the future of your relationship. Learn to distinguish between temporary difficulties and fundamental problems. Give yourself and your partner space to rethink your expectations and create a more realistic vision of your future together. Remember that a period of decline can be a starting point for profound transformation and renewal of the relationship.
17.description.reversed.0: The reversed Star symbolizes a period of disappointment, loss of hope and faith in a favorable outcome. This card indicates emotional exhaustion, inner imbalance and temporary loss of direction. A person may feel empty, as if their inner source of inspiration and energy has dried up. The reversed Star often appears at times when reality contrasts sharply with expectations, leading to disappointment and pessimism. You may feel immersed in darkness and doubt, having lost faith in your strengths and abilities. In this state, it is easy to fall into despondency or cynicism, perceiving the world in shades of gray. The card may indicate a period of depression when joy seems unattainable and the future seems foggy and uncertain. Often, the Reversed Star speaks of a crisis of faith—not only in a spiritual sense, but also in oneself, in other people, and in the possibility of a happy outcome. It is a state where hopes seem illusory and dreams seem unattainable. In the professional sphere, the card may indicate creative blocks, a lack of inspiration, or a loss of interest in previously meaningful projects. In financial terms, it often warns of unrealistic expectations or investments based more on dreams than on sober calculation. In relationships, the Star reversed often appears when romantic illusions are dispelled, revealing the discrepancy between the idealized image of a partner and reality.
17.advice.reversed.default.0: The Star reversed advises you to accept this period of emotional decline as temporary but necessary. Don't fight the feeling of disappointment—listen to it and try to understand its underlying causes. Right now, it's important to be especially gentle with yourself and your emotional state. Acknowledge that you may have had unrealistic expectations and allow yourself to reevaluate your goals and aspirations. Avoid making important decisions when you are emotionally drained—give yourself time to restore your inner balance. Look for small sources of joy and inspiration in everyday things, gradually regaining a sense of hope. Remember that periods of decline and disappointment often precede profound transformation and renewal. Use this time for inner work and rethinking your true values and aspirations.
17.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.0: In the «What I feel towards my partner» position, the Star reversed card indicates that your feelings are currently in a state of emotional decline or disappointment. The initial admiration and idealization of your partner has given way to a more sober and sometimes critical view. You may feel a loss of inspiration that this relationship once gave you. You may feel emotionally drained or disappointed because your expectations do not match reality. This does not necessarily mean that your feelings have disappeared; rather, they are transforming, becoming less idealized but potentially more mature.
17.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.1: In the «How my partner feels about me» position, the reversed Star indicates that your partner may be experiencing some disappointment or disillusionment regarding your relationship. Perhaps the initial inspiration and emotional high associated with you have been replaced by a more critical perception. Your partner may feel emotionally drained or temporarily lose faith in the harmonious development of the relationship. This does not mean that there are no feelings, but it does indicate a period of reevaluation and transformation of the emotional connection. Your partner may need space to rethink their expectations and feelings.
17.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.2: In the «How to behave» position, the Reversed Star advises you to give up illusions and excessive expectations of your partner and the relationship. It is important now to look at the situation realistically, without idealizing yourself or your partner. Avoid dramatizing problems and don't sink into pessimism, even if you encounter disappointments. Instead, focus on restoring your emotional balance and inner harmony. Give your relationship and your partner space to grow without trying to control every aspect. Be patient and remember that a period of emotional decline can be followed by renewal and a deepening of the connection.
17.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.3: In the «What to avoid» position, the reversed Star warns of the danger of sinking into despondency and despair. Avoid cynicism toward your partner and relationships in general, even if you are currently experiencing a period of disappointment. Don't give in to the temptation to idealize past relationships or make unrealistic plans for the future while ignoring current problems. Beware of emotional blackmail or manipulation that may arise in the wake of disappointment. Do not make important decisions when you are emotionally drained, and do not blame your partner for all the problems without analyzing your own contribution to the situation.
17.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.4: In the «Where is the relationship going?» position, the reversed Star card indicates that the relationship is going through a period of trials associated with the destruction of illusions and a collision with reality. You may be facing a phase of emotional cooling or the need to experience disappointment in order to reach a new level of understanding. The relationship may temporarily lose its sparkle and inspirational power. However, if you are both willing to work on yourselves and the relationship, this period can be a springboard for transforming the connection into a more mature and stable one. In some cases, the card may warn of the possibility of a breakup if the disappointment proves too deep and the differences insurmountable.
17.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.5: In the «Conclusion, relationship advice» position, the reversed Star advises accepting a period of disappointment as a necessary part of the evolution of the relationship. Don't cling to illusions and idealized images—allow the relationship to reveal itself as it truly is. This is a time to reevaluate expectations and aspirations, to gain a deeper understanding of yourself and your partner. Work on restoring emotional balance and finding new sources of inspiration in the relationship. Remember that true intimacy is only possible when we accept ourselves and our partner with all our imperfections. If you can get through this period with wisdom and patience, your relationship has a chance to be reborn on a deeper and more conscious level.
17.advice.reversed.thematic_love.0: The Star reversed in the «New Love» spread advises you to be more realistic in your expectations of new relationships. Don't rush to idealize your partner or project your fantasies and unfulfilled desires onto them. Right now, it's important to move slowly, carefully observing the development of the relationship and your reactions. Give yourself time to get to know the person as they are, not as you would like them to be. Work on your emotional state, restoring your inner balance and ability to see the situation clearly, without distortion. Remember that healthy relationships are built on a real foundation, not on illusions, no matter how beautiful they may seem.
17.meaning.reversed.thematic_careerFinan: In the «Current situation at work» position, the Star reversed indicates a period of disappointment and loss of faith in your professional path. You may feel that your talents are not recognized and that your hopes for career advancement are fading with each passing day. You may be putting in a lot of effort but not seeing the results you expect, which leads to emotional exhaustion. Your creative potential is blocked by routine or a negative atmosphere in the workplace. The Star reversed advises you to reevaluate your expectations and goals to see how realistic they are in your current circumstances.

In the «Obstacles» position, the Star reversed indicates that the main obstacle in your career path is a loss of inspiration and inner compass. You may feel lost in the professional world, without a clear vision of where to go next. This card also points to possible self-esteem issues that are preventing you from fully expressing your talents and abilities. Another significant obstacle may be a toxic work environment where your ideas are systematically devalued or ignored. You may have encountered cynicism from colleagues or management that undermines your belief in the possibility of positive change.

In the «Influence of the Past» position, the Star reversed indicates past disappointments that still influence your attitude toward work and career opportunities. Perhaps you have experienced professional burnout in the past or a situation where your hopes were cruelly dashed by circumstances or the actions of others. This card may also indicate that you were previously too idealistic about your profession, failing to take into account the realities of the job market or the specifics of your industry. Unsuccessful attempts to implement ambitious projects in the past may have undermined your confidence in your own strengths and abilities.

In the «Probable outcome if no action is taken» position, the Star reversed warns of a gradual deepening of the professional crisis and a growing sense of hopelessness. If you continue to move forward by inertia, without taking active steps to change the situation, you risk completely losing your motivation and interest in your work. Your financial situation may gradually deteriorate due to a lack of enthusiasm and creative approach to solving work tasks. The card also indicates the possibility of missing important opportunities for professional growth due to pessimism and lack of self-confidence. In the worst case, inaction can lead to emotional burnout and the need for radical changes in the future.

In the «Ways of Action» position, the Reversed Star recommends starting with restoring your inner balance and self-confidence before taking specific steps in your career. It is important to find sources of inspiration that will help you rediscover your professional potential. Try to temporarily step away from routine tasks and spend time reflecting on what truly brings you satisfaction in your work. It is also helpful to review your financial goals, making them more realistic and achievable in your current circumstances. The Star card advises you to gradually regain control of your professional life, starting with small but consistent steps.

In the «Possible consequences of your actions» section, the Star reversed warns that regaining professional confidence and inspiration will be a gradual process, with possible periods of doubt and temporary setbacks. If you start actively working on changing your attitude toward your career, the first results may not be very noticeable to those around you, but internally you will feel a sense of purpose and direction returning. In financial terms, you should not expect immediate improvements either – recovery may take time. However, persistence and a gradual return of self-confidence will ultimately lead to more informed career decisions and a more stable financial situation.

In the «Potential of the Situation» position, the Star reversed indicates that the current professional crisis, despite its painfulness, contains the seeds of profound transformation. This situation could be a turning point, after which you will stop setting unrealistic expectations and learn to appreciate your achievements, no matter how modest they may seem. Potentially, once you overcome this period of disappointment, you can develop a more pragmatic and sustainable approach to your career and finances. The Star reversed also hints at the possibility of discovering new talents and abilities that you never knew you had, precisely because of the need to overcome your current difficulties.

In the «Recommendations» position, the Star reversed advises you to temporarily lower your ambitions and focus on restoring your inner balance and inspiration. It is important to learn to find joy in small professional victories without demanding immediate grand achievements from yourself. It is also recommended to take time to analyze your true professional desires and motivations, separating them from externally imposed expectations. In financial terms, the card recommends caution and pragmatism, avoiding risky investments and ill-considered spending. It will also be helpful to find a mentor who can help you regain confidence in your professional abilities and see new perspectives.

In the «Outcome» position, the Reversed Star indicates that overcoming the current period of disappointment and professional despair will lead to the formation of a more mature and realistic attitude toward your career and finances. You will learn not to place too much hope in external circumstances and to rely more on your own resources and inner motivation. Your financial situation will gradually stabilize, although perhaps not to the level you originally dreamed of. However, more importantly, you will gain inner peace and confidence in your ability to cope with professional challenges, which in the long run will lay the foundation for more sustainable success and job satisfaction.
17.advice.reversed.thematic_careerFinanc: In the current situation of professional crisis, the Reversed Star advises you to remember that losing inspiration and faith in your career path is a temporary phenomenon, not a final sentence. It is important not to give in to the temptation to abandon your professional dreams altogether, but to learn to adapt them to reality. Try breaking your big career plan down into small, achievable steps to gradually rebuild your confidence in your abilities. Take the time to look for new sources of inspiration—these could be professional communities, training courses, or even a temporary change of activity. Remember that periods of doubt and disappointment are an integral part of professional growth, and it is often through them that we come to a deeper understanding of our true calling.
17.meaning.reversed.universal_celticCros: In the «Situation» position, the Reversed Star indicates a period of deep disappointment and loss of hope in your life. You may feel that you have lost touch with your inner source of inspiration and spirituality. This card suggests that you are currently experiencing an existential crisis, a feeling that life is meaningless, or a lack of clear purpose. Perhaps recent events have undermined your belief in a better future or in your ability to change the situation for the better. The Star reversed may also indicate a feeling that the universe is not supporting you and that life seems like a series of disappointments and missed opportunities.

In the «Situation Development» position, the Star reversed warns that your current disappointment and pessimism may intensify if you do not take steps to restore your inner balance and hope. The situation is developing in the direction of an even greater loss of faith in yourself and your abilities. You risk sinking into a state of apathy or cynicism, where any positive prospects will be perceived as unattainable or illusory. This can lead to a self-fulfilling prophecy, where your negative expectations actually begin to shape your reality. There is also a danger of making decisions out of fear or despair rather than from a place of inner wisdom and knowledge of your true purpose.

In the «Hint» position, the Star reversed recommends paying attention to those areas of your life where you still have at least a spark of hope or interest. This card invites you to acknowledge and accept your disappointments and pain, rather than suppressing them or pretending that everything is fine. The message of the Star reversed is that the path to restoring hope begins with honestly acknowledging your current despair. This card also advises you to temporarily lower your expectations and learn to appreciate the small moments of beauty and joy in your everyday life. You may need to reevaluate your goals and dreams to understand which ones truly resonate with your true self and which ones are external standards of success or happiness that have been imposed on you.

In the «Origins of the Situation» position, the Reversed Star indicates that the roots of your current disappointment and loss of faith lie in past events when your hopes were cruelly shattered by reality. Perhaps you have experienced a serious betrayal, failure, or loss that has undermined your belief in the goodness of the world and the possibility of a bright future. This card may also indicate that in the past you had unrealistic expectations or idealized certain situations, people, or opportunities, which inevitably led to disappointment. Another possible reason is prolonged exposure to a toxic environment where your optimism and belief in the best were systematically mocked or devalued, gradually depleting your inner source of hope.

In the «Past» position, the Reversed Star card refers to a period in the recent past when you experienced serious disappointment or a collapse of your hopes. Perhaps you invested a lot of energy and emotion in a particular project, relationship, or dream, only to see it fall apart or turn out to be something different than you expected. This card may also indicate that you have struggled in the past to find your true calling or purpose, leading to feelings of meaninglessness and emptiness. It is also likely that you have recently experienced a spiritual crisis or a period when your connection to the higher aspects of life was disrupted, leaving a deep mark on your soul and worldview.

In the «Future» position, the Star reversed warns of a possible continuation of a period of disappointment and lack of clear direction in the near future. This card suggests that the path to restoring faith and hope will be gradual and may require a great deal of inner work and rethinking of your values and expectations. At the same time, consciously living through this period can lead to deep insights and a more authentic understanding of your true path. The Star reversed may also indicate that in the future you will need to overcome a tendency toward self-deception or excessive idealism in order to develop a more mature and realistic outlook on life, while remaining open to wonder and beauty.

In the «What awaits you» position, the Star reversed heralds a period when you will have to face your own disappointments and learn to transform them into a more mature form of hope and faith. A time awaits you when illusions and unrealistic expectations will dissipate, making room for a deeper and more authentic understanding of life. This process can be painful, but it will ultimately lead to greater inner integrity and wisdom. The Star reversed may also indicate a period of temporary retreat from active pursuits, necessary to restore your inner resources and reevaluate your goals and priorities. During this period, it is important not to make hasty decisions or draw definitive conclusions about your life or future.

In the «External Influence» position, the Star reversed may indicate that there are people or circumstances in your environment that undermine your belief in yourself and your abilities. Perhaps you are in an environment where cynicism, skepticism, or denial of spiritual values prevail, making it difficult to maintain your own hope and optimism. This card may also indicate that the social expectations or standards of success you are trying to live up to do not actually resonate with your true nature and calling. External influences may also manifest in the form of disappointing news or world events that reinforce your sense of powerlessness and the futility of individual efforts.

In the «Hope» position, the Star reversed paradoxically indicates that your secret hope lies in restoring your very ability to hope and believe. Deep down, you long to regain the sense of possibility and potential that seems to have been lost. This card may also indicate that you are afraid to hope, fearing further disappointment, yet desperately want to overcome this fear. Your hope may also be connected to a desire to find deeper meaning in your trials and to understand how they fit into the bigger picture of your life and spiritual journey. Another aspect may be a quiet longing to heal emotional wounds and restore inner peace and balance.

In the Outcome position, the Star reversed predicts that as a result of the current process, you will come to a more mature and realistic understanding of hope and faith. Instead of naive optimism or blind faith in the best, you will develop a deeper form of trust in life that includes accepting both the light and the shadows. This outcome will not be like a triumphant overcoming of all difficulties, but rather a quiet reconciliation with the imperfections of the world and your own life. The Star reversed may also indicate that you will eventually learn to find beauty and meaning even in times of disappointment and uncertainty, which is a sign of true spiritual maturity. An important aspect of the outcome will also be the development of the ability to discern which hopes and dreams are truly worth pursuing and which are better to let go.
17.advice.reversed.universal_celticCross: The Star reversed in the Celtic Cross spread advises you to acknowledge and accept your current feelings of disappointment and loss of hope without trying to suppress or ignore them. Allow yourself to experience this spiritual crisis in all its fullness, understanding that it is an important part of your journey and can lead to a deeper and more authentic understanding of yourself and the world. At the same time, don't let temporary pessimism dictate all your decisions and actions. Look for small sources of light and inspiration in your daily life, even if they seem insignificant compared to your former dreams and expectations. Use this period to reevaluate your values and priorities, separating what is truly important to your soul from what has been imposed by external standards of success or happiness. Remember that even an inverted Star is still a Star—a source of light, only now that light is directed inward rather than outward, inviting you to deep inner exploration and transformation.
In the «Past» position, the Reversed Star indicates a period of disappointment and lost hopes that you have recently experienced. Perhaps you had big plans or placed excessive expectations on a situation that did not work out. This time may have been characterized by a feeling of spiritual emptiness, when it seemed that higher powers had turned away from you. You may have experienced a crisis of faith in yourself and your abilities, leading to a period of emotional exhaustion. This experience, although painful, has laid the foundation for your current understanding of reality and taught you to assess situations more soberly.

In the «What is happening now» position, the Reversed Star indicates a current period of pessimism and distrust of what is happening. Right now, you may feel like you are moving blindly, without a clear direction or inspiration. Your inner state is characterized by uncertainty and fear of the future. Instead of seeing opportunities, you notice obstacles and limitations. This is a temporary eclipse of your usual ability to see the light at the end of the tunnel. Your inner source of hope has temporarily dried up, and you feel as if you are on autopilot, without a genuine connection to what is happening around you.

In the «How events will unfold» position, the Reversed Star warns of a possible period of disappointment and unfulfilled expectations. Events may not unfold as you planned, requiring you to be flexible and willing to rethink your goals. You may have to face a reality that is significantly different from your dreams. This period may be characterized by a feeling that you are going against the tide and that the results do not match the effort you put in. However, it is through this trial that you will be able to gain a more realistic view of your capabilities and adjust your course to achieve more sustainable results in the future.

In the «Hint» position, the Reversed Star advises you not to rely solely on hope and faith, but to take concrete, practical steps to improve your situation. Now is not the time for passive waiting—active action is needed. Pay attention to your inner dialogue: you may be too critical of yourself or, conversely, allowing unrealistic expectations to cloud your perception. The card suggests that restoring your inner harmony will only begin when you accept reality as it is and start working with what you have now, rather than what might be in an ideal world.

In the «External Influences» position, the Reversed Star indicates an environment that may undermine your belief in yourself and your abilities. You may find yourself in an environment where pessimism, cynicism, or distrust prevail. Perhaps there are people around you who, without realizing it, dampen your enthusiasm with their doubts or negative predictions. External circumstances may seem unfavorable, creating the impression that luck has turned its back on you. In such an atmosphere, it is difficult to maintain optimism and faith in a positive outcome, but it is precisely now that it is important to learn to separate constructive criticism from toxic influences and create your own safe space to restore your inner resources.

In the «Obstacles» position, the Reversed Star symbolizes an internal crisis of faith and hope as the main obstacle in your path. Your own pessimism and disappointment in past failures create a barrier that prevents you from seeing new opportunities. You may be experiencing creative block or spiritual exhaustion that is preventing you from moving forward with a clear vision of your goal. Emotional fatigue and a loss of connection to your inner source of inspiration make each step harder than it needs to be. This card may also indicate a tendency to compare yourself to others, which leads to feelings of inadequacy and undermines your belief in your own unique talents and path.

In the «What's Ahead» position, the Star reversed foretells a period when you will have to face a reality that may differ from your expectations and dreams. An important lesson awaits you about the difference between healthy hope and unrealistic fantasies. This card indicates the need to reevaluate your goals and how you plan to achieve them, possibly with compromises or alternative solutions. You will probably have to go through a process of disappointment in order to reach a new level of understanding of your true desires and possibilities. However, remember that this period is temporary and its main purpose is to teach you a more realistic approach to life, which will ultimately lead to more sustainable results and genuine satisfaction.
17.advice.reversed.universal_horseshoe.0: The reversed Star advises you to seek a balance between faith in the best and a realistic assessment of the situation. Now is not the time for blind optimism, but complete disappointment will not lead to positive changes either. Pay attention to your unrealistic expectations and reevaluate them: perhaps you are setting unattainable goals or expecting immediate results where time and patience are required. It is important to learn to find sources of inspiration even in everyday life, without putting off happiness until later. Develop a practice of gratitude for the little things and gradually reconnect with your inner source of hope. Remember that periods of disappointment often precede important discoveries about yourself and a reevaluation of values that ultimately lead to a more authentic and harmonious life.
