This card reminds you that even when you are not aware of it, you are supported and guided by an inner light of wisdom and love that helps you follow the path of your highest purpose.
19.meaning.upright.universal_flame.3: Obstacles and Challenges Position: The Sun in the Obstacles position creates an interesting paradox—your main challenge may be to accept your own light and allow yourself to shine in all your glory. You may be afraid of your potential or that success will change your life and your relationships with those around you. Excess energy and enthusiasm can also be an obstacle if not channeled correctly, leading to burnout or unrealistic expectations. The Sun may indicate that you find it difficult to be in the shadows or to accept periods of rest and recovery, which are necessary for sustainable growth. The challenge is to find a balance between shining and resting, between individual expression and harmonious interaction with those around you.
19.meaning.upright.universal_flame.4: Position «Attitude toward the situation»: The Sun in the attitude position indicates that you approach your current circumstances with optimism, enthusiasm, and an open heart. You see the situation in a positive light, which helps you notice opportunities and favorable signs where others might only see problems. Your attitude is filled with vitality and faith in a favorable outcome, which creates a powerful creative force that transforms the reality around you. The Sun indicates that you intuitively feel that you are on the right path and are ready to share your inner light with those around you. This sunny attitude becomes a self-fulfilling prophecy, attracting corresponding circumstances and opportunities to you.
19.meaning.upright.universal_flame.5: What you should do: The Sun in this position encourages you to boldly express your talents and uniqueness without fear of standing out or being noticed. You should step out of the shadows and let the world see your true potential and the beauty of your soul. This card advises you to act with confidence and enthusiasm, investing your energy in projects and relationships that bring you genuine joy and satisfaction. The Sun also indicates the need to find time for play, creativity, and celebration of life, which will help you maintain high levels of energy. Follow what makes you feel warm and light, and don't be afraid to shine brightly and powerfully.
19.meaning.upright.universal_flame.6: Position «External influences»: The Sun in the position of external influences indicates that you are surrounded by a favorable atmosphere of support, recognition, and opportunities for growth. There are people in your environment who see your true value and potential and are ready to support you on your path to success. External circumstances are aligned in such a way as to facilitate the unfolding of your talents and the achievement of your goals. The Sun can also indicate the influence of a significant figure—a mentor, sponsor, or spiritual leader who illuminates your path with their wisdom and experience. The energy around you is life-affirming and inspiring, creating ideal conditions for creativity, growth, and self-expression.
19.meaning.upright.universal_flame.7: The «Hopes and Fears» position: The Sun in the area of hopes and fears reflects your deep desire for self-realization, recognition, and a sense of fulfillment in life. You hope to achieve a state of inner harmony and outer success when your talents and efforts are appreciated. At the same time, there may be a fear that you are not worthy of such bright light or that, once you achieve success, you will not be able to hold on to it. Perhaps you fear that by drawing attention to yourself, you will become a target for criticism or envy from those around you. The Sun indicates a paradoxical fear of your own greatness — a fear of fully realizing your potential and taking responsibility for your power and talent.
19.meaning.upright.universal_flame.8: The «Result» position: The Sun in the result position portends an exceptionally favorable outcome, filled with success, recognition, and a deep sense of satisfaction. You will achieve a state of inner wholeness and outer fulfillment when your talents are fully revealed and appreciated. This card promises a period of prosperity and abundance in all areas of life, from material well-being to spiritual enlightenment. The Sun indicates that the result of your journey will be not only personal success, but also the ability to inspire and support others with your example and energy. You will shine like the sun, lighting the way for those who follow you and enjoying the warmth of mutual love and respect.
19.meaning.upright.universal_flame.9: Short-term prospects: The Sun in the short-term prospects position promises a bright and dynamic period filled with opportunities for growth and self-expression. In the near future, you can expect a surge of energy, inspiration, and creativity that will help you overcome any obstacles in your path. You may receive important recognition, promotion, or public exposure that draws attention to your talents and achievements. The Sun may also indicate a short but intense journey or experience that will broaden your horizons and enrich your perception of the world. This is a time to take action and use the flow of positive energy to realize your plans and desires.
19.meaning.upright.universal_flame.10: Position «Long-term prospects»: The Sun in the position of long-term prospects heralds a period of sustained prosperity and deep satisfaction, which will be the result of your current efforts and choices. Over time, the seeds you sow now will bear abundant fruit, bringing not only material well-being but also peace of mind. You will achieve mastery in your chosen field and become a source of inspiration for others, naturally assuming the position of a leader or mentor. The Sun also speaks of a long-term life trajectory filled with light, joy, and creative self-realization. You will gain a deep understanding of your purpose and follow it with ease and grace, finding satisfaction in every moment of your journey.
19.meaning.upright.universal_flame.11: Spiritual Lessons Position: The Sun in the Spiritual Lessons position indicates the importance of finding inner wholeness and authenticity as a key aspect of your spiritual journey. This card teaches you the value of self-expression, joy, and the ability to shine your unique light without dimming the light of others. The Sun invites you to explore a spiritual path of joy and abundance, understanding that true prosperity begins with an inner state of gratitude and openness. An important lesson is also the balance between individuality and unity—the ability to express your uniqueness while remaining aware of your connection to all living things. The Sun teaches you that your true nature is light and divine, and your task is to allow that light to shine freely for the benefit of all beings.
19.advice.upright.universal_flame.0: Follow what fills you with energy and joy, even if it seems frivolous or frivolous. The Sun reminds us that play and creative expression are not just entertainment, but powerful tools for spiritual growth and transformation of reality. Spend more time in nature, allowing sunlight to nourish your body and soul, both literally and metaphorically. Let go of the excessive seriousness and self-criticism that dim your natural brilliance. Remember that you have the right to be happy and successful—it is your birthright, not a privilege to be earned. Become a source of light for those around you, generously sharing your energy and talents, but don't forget the importance of rest and recovery. Just as the sun regularly sets in order to rise again, you need to alternate periods of intense activity with periods of quiet recovery.
19.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.0: Position «Present Situation»: The Sun in this position shines brightly on your current situation, illuminating all the dark corners and bringing clarity. You are now entering a period of incredible clarity of thought, when everything is seen in its true light. You feel a sense of joy and optimism, even if you encounter some difficulties. Your energy is on the rise, and you are full of vitality and enthusiasm. This is a favorable time for new beginnings, as you feel free from past limitations and ready to move forward with an open heart. Perhaps you have recently overcome some serious obstacles and are now enjoying a well-deserved period of happiness and satisfaction.
19.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.1: Possible cause of the situation: The cause of your current situation is a period of inner enlightenment or an important discovery you have made relatively recently. The Sun indicates that you have reached a new level of self-awareness and spiritual growth that has led you to your current state. You may have overcome internal fears and limitations that previously held you back. This breakthrough has given you a new perspective and understanding of life. Freeing yourself from old thought patterns and emotional blocks has allowed you to attract more positive circumstances and opportunities. Your openness to joy and happiness has created a favorable atmosphere around you, attracting bright events and people into your life.
19.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.2: Position «First Path»: On this path, the Sun illuminates the road to personal growth and self-realization. By choosing it, you open up the opportunity to fully realize your potential and talents, allowing your inner light to shine in all its glory. This path requires you to be open, sincere, and willing to be seen by the world as you are. Here you will find recognition of your merits and talents, the opportunity to share your gifts with others and inspire them with your example. This is a path of self-expression and creative fulfillment, where you can realize your boldest ideas and dreams. Although this path is full of light, it also requires you to be courageous enough to be vulnerable and open to others.
19.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.3: The Second Path: The Sun in the second path indicates the possibility of finding harmony through establishing deep and sincere connections with those around you. This path highlights collective interaction, cooperation, and the creation of a community of like-minded people. By choosing it, you will focus on building relationships based on mutual respect, support, and authenticity. Here you will find joy in shared achievements, mutual enrichment, and the exchange of energy. It is a path where personal happiness is multiplied by sharing it with others. You will discover that your own joy becomes fuller and more intense when you contribute to the happiness of those around you. On this path, you can become a source of light and inspiration for many people.
19.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.4: Position «Result of the first path»: The result of the first path, illuminated by the Sun, will be a deep inner satisfaction from self-realization and the discovery of your talents. You will achieve a state of inner wholeness and harmony where your external achievements are a natural extension of your inner being. Those around you will see you as a source of inspiration and a role model. You will gain not only financial success and recognition, but also a deep understanding of your unique place in the world. This result includes gaining true freedom — the freedom to be yourself and live according to your true values and desires. Here, the Sun symbolizes absolute authenticity and loyalty to oneself.
19.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.5: The «Second Path Result» position: The Sun in the second path result position heralds the creation of a thriving community or circle of close relationships where each member feels supported and inspired. You will become the center of this network of relationships, a person who unites people with your energy and zest for life. This result will bring you not only personal happiness, but also satisfaction from the positive influence you have on the lives of others. You will be bathed in an atmosphere of mutual love, respect, and support. The Sun here indicates that your life will take on new meaning through serving others and creating a space where everyone can reveal their best qualities.
19.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.6: The «Final Outcome» position: The Sun in the final outcome position symbolizes the achievement of the highest harmony between your inner world and your outer manifestations. Regardless of the path you choose, you will come to a state of deep satisfaction and enlightenment. All the difficulties and trials you have had to go through will take on meaning and be perceived as necessary stages of your growth. You will achieve a degree of inner freedom and joy that is independent of external circumstances. The sun here does not mean temporary success or fleeting happiness, but a stable state of mental balance, optimism, and faith in life. You will become the living embodiment of the wisdom that even after the darkest night, the sun always rises.
19.advice.upright.choice_twoPaths.0: The Sun advises you to unconditionally accept your inner light and allow it to shine in all its glory. Don't be afraid to be seen, don't hide your talents and gifts for fear of judgment or criticism. Now is the time to cast aside all doubts and insecurities that may dim your radiance. Remember that your authenticity and openness are what the world values most in you. Strive for the simple joys of life, find pleasure in the little things, and cultivate gratitude for everything you have. Trust your intuition and inner voice; they will guide you in the right direction. Don't let the opinions of others or social expectations cloud your own vision of happiness.
19.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.0: Past Influence Position: The Sun in the past influence position indicates a period of significant personal growth and enlightenment that you have recently experienced. This experience has laid an important foundation for your current situation. You may have overcome serious difficulties or emerged from a dark period in your life with new understanding and wisdom. The Sun indicates that you have experienced a moment of true joy and freedom in the past that has permanently changed your perception of the world. This may have been related to a creative breakthrough, a gain in self-confidence, or an experience that helped you unlock your true potential. These bright moments continue to fuel you with energy and optimism even now.
19.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.1: Current Situation Position: The Sun in the current situation position illuminates a period of extraordinary clarity and optimism in your life. You are now at a point where the shadows of the past are dissipating and new horizons full of possibilities are opening up before you. You feel a surge of vitality, enthusiasm, and confidence in your abilities. The Sun indicates that you currently have all the resources and support you need to succeed. Your inner state is harmonious, and your perception of the world is positive and open. Perhaps you have just overcome some difficulties and are now enjoying a well-deserved period of well-being and joy. This energy from the Sun gives you a chance to see your situation in its true light.
19.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.2: Hidden Influences Position: The Sun in the hidden influences position indicates a subconscious desire for self-realization and expression of your true self, which drives you even if you are not fully aware of it. Deep within you burns a desire to be seen, recognized, and appreciated for who you are. This influence pushes you toward situations where you can reveal your potential and shine in all your uniqueness. Perhaps you are subtly influenced by a long-standing positive experience or memory associated with a feeling of complete freedom and joy. The Sun also indicates hidden support from higher powers or a favorable destiny that, even in difficult moments, guides you toward light and harmony.
19.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.3: Position «First Path»: The Sun at the first crossroads points the way to bright self-expression and creative fulfillment. By choosing this path, you will devote yourself fully to your talents and passions, allowing your inner light to illuminate everything around you. This direction is associated with art, creativity, and any activity where you can authentically express yourself. Here you will find joy in the process of creation and self-expression. The Sun promises you recognition, success, and material well-being if you remain true to your nature and do not hide your unique gifts. This path will require you to have the courage to be visible and stand out from others, but it will reward you with deep satisfaction from living in accordance with your true self.
19.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.4: Position «Second Path»: At the second crossroads, the Sun illuminates the path of deep and sincere human connections. This direction leads to the creation and strengthening of meaningful relationships based on authenticity, mutual respect, and love. By choosing this path, you will focus on building bridges between people, creating communities, and sharing your warmth with those around you. Here, the Sun symbolizes mutual enrichment and growth through communication and joint efforts. You will discover that your personal happiness multiplies when you share it with others. This path can lead to starting a family, developing existing relationships to a new level, or forming a circle of like-minded people where each member supports and inspires one another.
19.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.5: The Third Path: The Sun at the third crossroads illuminates the path of inner development and spiritual enlightenment. By choosing this direction, you will devote yourself to the search for higher truth and harmony, striving to understand the deeper aspects of existence. This path is associated with meditative practices, spiritual teachings, and philosophical studies. The sun indicates that through inner work, you will achieve a state of deep peace, joy, and enlightenment that will radiate into all aspects of your life. Here you can become a teacher or guide for others, helping them find their inner light. This path requires a certain amount of solitude and self-analysis, but it rewards you with inner freedom and independence from external circumstances.
19.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.6: Obstacles and Fears Position: The Sun in the Obstacles position paradoxically indicates a fear of your own light and greatness. You may be afraid to fully reveal your potential and be visible, fearing that you will not live up to the expectations of others or your own. This fear may be related to experiences where your achievements have caused envy or rejection from those around you. Another obstacle may be a tendency toward excessive optimism and ignoring real problems—as if the bright sun is blinding you, preventing you from seeing the pitfalls in your path. You may also fear that your period of happiness and prosperity will quickly come to an end, which prevents you from fully enjoying the present moment and getting the most out of it.
19.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.7: The position of the «Council of Higher Powers»: The Sun, as the council of higher powers, urges you to unconditionally accept your uniqueness and allow yourself to shine. The universe wants you to realize that each of us is born with an inner light, and your task is not to hide it, but to share it with the world. The higher powers remind you of the importance of joy and playfulness in your life. Not everything has to be serious and complicated — sometimes the deepest truths are revealed through simple pleasures and moments of pure happiness. The Sun advises you to remain open and sincere in all your expressions, and not to be afraid of being vulnerable. It is in this openness that you will find true strength and protection. Trust in life and remember: after any darkness, there is always a dawn.
19.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.8: Possible outcome position: The Sun in the possible outcome position heralds a period of incredible prosperity and well-being in all areas of your life. Regardless of the path you choose, you will achieve inner harmony and outer success. Your life will be filled with joy, energy, and new opportunities. The Sun indicates that all the shadows of the past will be completely dispelled by the light of new understanding and wisdom. You will gain clarity about your place in the world and your purpose in life. Material prosperity will be a natural consequence of your inner state of abundance and optimism. Those around you will be drawn to you, attracted by your energy and zest for life. This result is not just a period of temporary happiness, but a lasting state of prosperity and joy.
19.advice.upright.choice_crossroad.0: The Sun at the Crossroads advises you to unconditionally accept the light within yourself and allow it to shine freely in all directions. Don't try to conform to other people's expectations or social norms — your uniqueness is your strength. Now is the time to cultivate joy and gratitude for every moment, even if circumstances don't seem ideal. Look for the bright side in every situation, but don't deny the existence of shadows — they are necessary for the light to be more visible. Trust the process of life and remember that every challenge leads you to greater expansion and growth. Be generous in your expressions — share your warmth, knowledge, resources, and time. The more you give from a place of abundance, the more you will receive in return.
19.meaning.reversed.simple_YesNo.0: The Sun card reversed in the Yes/No spread indicates temporary difficulties and a lack of clarity in the situation. You may feel uncertain and lack the energy to solve current problems. Internal blocks and doubts prevent you from seeing the whole picture. The Sun reversed indicates that now is not the best time to make important decisions, as you do not have all the necessary information.
19.meaning.reversed.simple_YesNo.1: In the context of a Yes/No reading, the Sun reversed symbolizes delays and obstacles on the path to achieving the desired result. Your expectations may be too high, and reality may not be as rosy as you had hoped. The card warns of possible disappointment and indicates the need to reconsider your approach to the situation. A temporary setback does not mean complete defeat, but requires you to be more cautious and patient.
19.advice.reversed.simple_YesNo.0: The reversed Sun advises you not to rush to conclusions or actions. Now is the time to pay close attention to details and not let your emotions cloud your judgment. Review your goals and expectations—they may be unrealistic or need adjustment. Give yourself time to restore your energy and clarity of thought. Work on overcoming internal blocks and doubts that are preventing you from moving forward. Remember that after every shadow there is always light—this is only a temporary eclipse of your inner sun.
19.meaning.reversed.simple_daySuggest.0: Today, the Sun reversed card warns of a possible decline in energy and enthusiasm. You may feel depressed or deprived of the joy you usually experience from everyday activities. Internal doubts and self-doubt may cloud your usually bright perception of the world. The day may bring some disappointments or delays in the plans you intended to carry out. Be prepared for the fact that not everything will go as smoothly and successfully as you expected.
19.meaning.reversed.simple_daySuggest.1: The reversed Sun in the advice of the day indicates the need to pay attention to your physical and emotional state. You may be experiencing a period of burnout or simply need rest and recovery. Today, it may be difficult to see the positive side of the situations you are facing. A temporary lack of clarity may lead to misunderstandings. Today may require more patience and persistence than usual.
19.advice.reversed.simple_daySuggest.0: The Sun reversed advises you to slow down today and not demand too much of yourself. Give yourself permission to rest and recover—sometimes pauses are just as productive as action. Pay attention to your physical condition; your body may need more care. Don't make important decisions if you feel uncertain or depressed. Look for small joys in everyday things to gradually restore your inner light. Remember that this period is temporary and your energy and optimism will return soon.
19.meaning.reversed.thematic_relationshi: In the «Your feelings» position, the reversed Sun indicates a certain cooling of your emotions towards your partner. You may be going through a period of disappointment or have lost your initial enthusiasm in the relationship. Your feelings may be clouded by doubts and uncertainty. You tend to see more flaws than strengths, and this prevents you from enjoying your partner's company. Your inner dissatisfaction with yourself may be projected onto the relationship, creating additional tension.

In the «Partner's Feelings» position, the Sun Reversed indicates that your partner may be experiencing a decline in the emotional high that was characteristic of your relationship earlier. He may feel tired, disappointed, or lacking in enthusiasm. His feelings for you have not faded, but are temporarily overshadowed by other emotions or external circumstances. Your partner may be experiencing inner conflict or uncertainty about his feelings, which is creating distance between you. He may find it difficult to express his emotions openly and sincerely.

In the «Your Potential in Relationships» position, the Sun reversed indicates that you may have difficulty expressing your true self in relationships. Your natural brightness and individuality are temporarily overshadowed, perhaps due to a fear of rejection or misunderstanding. You have the potential to bring more joy and warmth to your relationship, but right now you are holding yourself back due to internal blocks or negative experiences. It is important to work on restoring your confidence and ability to share positive energy with your partner.

In the position «Partner's potential in relationships», the Sun reversed indicates that your partner has hidden potential that cannot be fully realized at this time. Perhaps certain fears, doubts, or past traumas are preventing them from showing their best qualities in the relationship. Your partner is capable of bringing more joy, optimism, and support to your union, but right now their inner light is dimmed by external circumstances or internal conflicts. With your support and understanding, this potential can gradually unfold.

In the «Relationship Advice» position, the Sun Reversed recommends that you acknowledge the existence of certain difficulties or disappointments in your relationship, rather than pretending that everything is perfect. Right now, it is important to work on restoring sincerity and openness between you and your partner. Don't let minor misunderstandings overshadow the truly valuable and joyful moments you share. The card advises you to be more tolerant of each other and remember that all relationships go through periods of darkness, which are always followed by a new dawn.

In the «Future of the Relationship» position, the Sun reversed indicates that your relationship will have to go through a period of trials before you can achieve true harmony. You may need to overcome certain illusions or unrealistic expectations of each other. The card does not predict a breakup, but it does indicate the need for a more realistic view of your union. In the future, you will need to work on restoring the joy and spontaneity that may have been lost in your relationship. With effort on both sides, your relationship has a chance to become deeper and more meaningful.
19.advice.reversed.thematic_relationship: The Sun reversed advises you not to demand too much from yourself and your partner. Accept the fact that relationships, like life, cannot always be at the peak of happiness and harmony. Learn to appreciate the moments when you go through difficulties together. Now it is important to talk openly about your feelings and expectations without fear of appearing vulnerable. Work on restoring trust and sincerity if they have been undermined. Do not let external circumstances or temporary disappointments overshadow the true value of your relationship. Remember that every eclipse is always followed by a new sunrise.
19.description.reversed.0: The Sun reversed symbolizes a temporary eclipse of light and joy in life. This card indicates a period when your usual energy and optimism are in decline, and your inner light is clouded by doubts and uncertainty. Like a solar eclipse, this period is temporary but can feel like a serious challenge. The reversed Sun often speaks of disappointment when reality does not match expectations, or a feeling that success is within sight but constantly eludes you. In your professional life, this card may indicate a lack of recognition, difficulty in demonstrating your talents, or a temporary decline in enthusiasm for your work. In your personal relationships, the Sun reversed may indicate a cooling of feelings, a period of despondency, or that joy and spontaneity have temporarily left your union. Physically, this card may indicate low energy, a weakened immune system, or a feeling of exhaustion. However, it is important to remember that even when reversed, the Sun remains one of the most positive cards in the deck. Its appearance in a reading is a reminder that behind every cloud there is always sunshine, and that a period of darkness will inevitably be followed by a new dawn. This card calls for patience and faith that light and joy will return to your life, perhaps with even greater force than before.
19.advice.reversed.default.0: The Sun reversed advises you to acknowledge your current difficulties and disappointments instead of denying them or pretending that everything is fine. Right now, it is important to give yourself space and time to restore your energy and vitality. Do not rush the natural healing process—sometimes we need to spend time in the shadows in order to appreciate the brightness of the sunlight again. Pay attention to your unrealistic expectations and your desire for perfection, which may be the source of your disappointment. Practice gratitude for the small joys that are present in your life even during the darkest times. Remember that temporary difficulties are an opportunity for inner growth and reevaluation of your true priorities. Trust in the cyclical nature of life: every sunset is always followed by a sunrise.
19.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.0: In the position 'What I feel towards my partner', the Sun reversed indicates that your feelings towards your partner are going through a period of eclipse. Perhaps the initial brightness and joy of communicating with this person has temporarily faded. You may feel disappointed or uncertain about your emotions. This does not mean that you no longer feel affection, but right now your feelings may be clouded by doubts, fatigue, or external circumstances. You may be unconsciously comparing your real relationship with an idealized image in your imagination, which leads to a certain disappointment.
19.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.1: In the «How my partner treats me» position, the Sun reversed indicates that your partner may be going through a period of emotional cooling or reduced enthusiasm in the relationship. This is not necessarily related to you personally — perhaps he is going through a difficult period in other areas of his life that is affecting his overall emotional state. Your partner may be feeling some disappointment due to unrealistic expectations or idealization of your relationship. Their feelings for you have not disappeared, but have temporarily lost their intensity and immediacy due to internal doubts or external factors.
19.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.2: In the «How to behave» position, the Sun Reversed recommends showing patience and understanding towards yourself and your partner. Now is not the time for dramatic gestures or radical decisions. Instead, focus on small but sincere expressions of care and attention. Be more realistic in your expectations of the relationship and don't demand constant euphoria. The card advises temporarily reducing the intensity of your interactions if you feel emotionally drained. It is important to remain open and honest in your communication, even if you have nothing positive to say—sincerity is more valuable than false optimism right now.
19.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.3: In the «What to avoid» position, the Sun Reversed warns against excessive drama and exaggeration of existing problems. Don't take a temporary cooling in your relationship as a final verdict on your union. Avoid constantly comparing your current relationship with past ones or with idealized notions of «perfect love». The card advises you not to withdraw into yourself and hide your true feelings behind a mask of false happiness. It is also worth avoiding excessive control over your partner or the situation — attempts to force a relationship to be happy usually lead to the opposite result.
19.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.4: In the «Where is the relationship going» position, the Sun reversed indicates that your relationship is about to go through a period of trials and reevaluation. Illusions and unrealistic expectations may be shattered, causing temporary disappointment. However, this is a necessary step toward building a more mature and stable relationship based on a realistic perception of each other. The relationship is moving toward greater sincerity and authenticity, even if the path to this lies through a period of doubt and uncertainty. If both parties show patience and a willingness to work on the relationship, this period of eclipse may be replaced by a new, deeper, and more conscious union.
19.meaning.reversed.thematic_love.5: In the «Conclusion, relationship advice» position, the Sun reversed advises you to accept the current difficulties as a necessary part of the development of your relationship. Love, like life, moves in cycles, and periods of brightness are followed by times when the light dims a little. This does not mean that the sun has disappeared—it has only temporarily hidden behind the clouds. The card recommends using this period to reevaluate your expectations of the relationship and your partner. Perhaps you have idealized each other or the relationship as a whole. Now it is important to learn to appreciate imperfection and find beauty in reality, not in illusions. This experience can make your union more mature and stable if you are both willing to learn and grow together.
19.advice.reversed.thematic_love.0: The Sun reversed advises you not to panic over a temporary cooling of feelings or a decrease in emotional intensity in your relationship. Accept this period as a natural part of the journey of love, rather than a sign of failure. Allow yourself and your partner to experience the full range of emotions, including disappointment and doubt. Use this time for deeper self-discovery and understanding of your true desires in the relationship. Be patient and don't demand immediate solutions to all problems. Try to introduce new elements into the relationship that could refresh your connection, but do so gradually, without pressure. Remember that true love is not only evident in moments of joy, but also in the ability to overcome periods of darkness together.
20.name: Judgment
20.meaning.upright.simple_YesNo.0: The Judgment card in a Yes/No reading symbolizes awakening, enlightenment, and realization of the truth. It indicates that you are on the threshold of an important stage in your life, when the past is being evaluated and rethought, and the new is emerging from the old. This is a period of spiritual renewal and purification, when you are ready to leave the past behind and face the future with a new understanding. This is an important decision or turning point that requires deep awareness and readiness for change.
20.meaning.upright.simple_YesNo.1: In the context of a Yes/No spread, the Judgment card indicates that it is time for you to hear the call of your true destiny. It is a resounding call to action that cannot be ignored. It requires you to be honest with yourself and willing to accept the truth, whatever it may be. You are ready to move to a new level of consciousness and existence, where old problems will be resolved and new opportunities will open up for you as a result of your inner awakening.
20.advice.upright.simple_YesNo.0: The Judgment card advises you to accept the inevitability of change and not to fear it. The time has come for a profound inner transformation and reevaluation of past experiences. Listen to your inner voice and intuition; they will guide you on the right path. Be prepared to leave behind old grudges, misconceptions, and mistakes so that you can move forward with a clear conscience and an open heart. Remember that every ending is also a new beginning. Trust the process of transformation that is taking place in your life and accept it as a necessary part of your spiritual growth.
20.meaning.upright.simple_daySuggest.0: In the «Advice of the Day» spread, the Judgment card indicates that today is a moment of truth and insight for you. It is a day when you can gain important revelations about yourself and your life and see the situation in a new light. Recent events may prompt you to deeply rethink and reevaluate your values, goals, and priorities. Today, you may feel a call to action, hear an inner voice that has been trying to reach you for a long time but has been drowned out by the hustle and bustle of everyday life.
20.meaning.upright.simple_daySuggest.1: Today, the Judgment card advises you to be open to important messages and signs that may come to you throughout the day. This is a favorable time to restore justice, correct past mistakes, and reconcile with those with whom you have been in conflict. The day may bring you purification and liberation from the burdens of the past, allowing you to start with a clean slate. Pay attention to your dreams and intuitive insights—they may contain important clues for your further development and growth.
20.advice.upright.simple_daySuggest.0: Today, the Judgment card advises you to be honest with yourself and open to inner revelations. Don't ignore the signals from your subconscious and intuition—they point to important truths that you need to realize. Use this day to take stock, analyze your progress, and plan for the future with the lessons you have learned. Be prepared to let go of outdated beliefs and behavior patterns that no longer serve your highest good. Remember that admitting your mistakes is not a sign of weakness, but a sign of spiritual maturity and strength.
20.meaning.upright.thematic_relationship: In the «Your Feelings» position, the Judgment card indicates that you are in the process of deeply rethinking your emotions and your relationship with your partner. You feel an inner awakening and a readiness to look at your relationship from a new, more mature perspective. Perhaps you are experiencing a moment of realization about the true nature of your feelings, freeing yourself from illusions and self-deception. This could be a moment of understanding the depth of your love, or a realization that your feelings have changed. Either way, it is an honest and transformative experience.

In the «Partner's Feelings» position, the Judgment card indicates that your partner is also going through a period of inner awakening and reevaluation of the relationship. Perhaps recent events have caused him/her to take a fresh look at you and your union. Your partner strives for honesty and transparency, is willing to admit their mistakes, and learn from past experiences. Their feelings are going through a process of purification and renewal, which may lead to a deeper and more conscious relationship with you and your life together.

In the «Your potential in relationships» position, the Judgment card indicates your ability to undergo profound renewal and transformation. You have a rare gift for rethinking the past and learning valuable lessons from it, which allows you to constantly grow and develop in your relationships. Your potential lies in your ability to hear the call of your heart and follow it, even if it requires courage and a willingness to change. You are capable of taking responsibility for your actions and feelings, which creates the foundation for healthy and mature relationships.

In the «Partner's Potential in Relationships» position, the Judgment card indicates that your partner has great potential for personal growth and spiritual development in the context of your relationship. He/she is capable of deep self-analysis and honest assessment of his/her contribution to the relationship. Your partner can be a source of renewal and a fresh perspective on familiar problems. His/her ability to acknowledge his/her mistakes and change for the better is an important resource for the development and strengthening of your union.

In the «Relationship Advice» position, the Judgment card recommends that both partners be open to their inner call for change and renewal. It is time for honest conversation and taking stock of the path you have traveled. Don't be afraid to admit your mistakes and learn from past experiences. Be ready to let go of old grudges and disagreements to make room for a new phase in your relationship. Listen to your intuition and your higher self, which will guide you in the right direction.

In the «Future of the Relationship» position, the Judgment card heralds an important turning point that will lead to renewal and transformation of your union. A period of awakening and realization awaits you, when many things will fall into place. This may be related to an important decision or choice that will determine the future of your relationship. However, regardless of external circumstances, this period will contribute to your spiritual growth and development. Your relationship can take on a new quality and depth if you are ready for internal changes.
The Judgment card advises you to treat your relationship as a path of spiritual growth and development. Don't be afraid to admit your mistakes and learn from them. Be open to change and willing to let go of outdated patterns of behavior and thinking. Regularly analyze the path you have taken and learn from past experiences. Remember that true love requires constant renewal and growth from both partners. Strive for honesty and transparency in your relationship, even if the truth may be painful. Only through a deep understanding of yourself and your partner can you achieve true closeness and harmony.
20.description.upright.0: Judgment is one of the most significant cards in the Major Arcana, symbolizing a moment of spiritual awakening, realization, and transformation. In the classic image of the card, we see the archangel Gabriel blowing a trumpet and people rising from their coffins in response to this call. This card speaks of a turning point in a person's life, when they reevaluate the past and realize their future path. The Judgment represents a moment of truth when all masks fall away and a person stands before themselves as they truly are. It is a card of liberation from the burdens of the past, forgiveness of oneself and others, and gaining a new understanding of one's purpose. In a spiritual sense, Judgment indicates the awakening of higher consciousness, when a person hears the call of their soul and is ready to follow it, even if it requires radical changes in their life. The Judgment card often appears at a time when a person is on the threshold of an important stage in their life and must make a decision that will determine their future path. This may be related to the end of a long period of life and the beginning of a new one, a profound inner transformation, or the realization of one's true calling. Judgment calls for honesty with oneself, a willingness to acknowledge one's mistakes and learn from them in order to move forward with a clear conscience and an open heart.In a practical sense, the Judgment card can indicate important life events: graduation, a change of job or career, the beginning or end of a long-term relationship, or moving to another city or country. It can also be related to important internal processes: realizing your true desires and goals, reevaluating your values and priorities, and letting go of outdated beliefs and behavior patterns.
20.advice.upright.default.0: The Judgment card advises you to be attentive to the signs and signals that life sends you. Listen to your inner voice and intuition—they point to your true purpose. Don't be afraid of change and transformation, even if they seem scary or painful. Remember that every ending is also a new beginning. Be ready to let go of the past, forgive yourself and others to make room for new experiences and opportunities. Be honest with yourself and don't avoid tough questions and decisions. Take responsibility for your life and your choices, knowing that you are the creator of your own destiny.
20.meaning.upright.thematic_love.0: In the position «What I feel towards my partner», the Judgement card indicates that you are experiencing a deep awareness and re-evaluation of your feelings. Perhaps recent events have caused you to take a fresh look at your partner and your relationship as a whole. You feel an inner awakening and a willingness to acknowledge the truth about your emotions, whatever they may be. This could be a moment of realizing the depth of your love and attachment, or an understanding that your feelings have changed or run their course. Either way, it is an honest and liberating experience that leads to personal growth.
20.meaning.upright.thematic_love.1: In the «How my partner feels about me» position, the Judgment card indicates that your partner is also going through a process of deep reflection and reevaluation of their relationship with you. He/she strives for honesty and sincerity, is ready to admit his/her mistakes and learn from the past. Your partner's feelings are undergoing a kind of «test of time», cleansing themselves of everything superficial and illusory. This may be a period of emotional awakening for him/her, when true feelings come to the surface. Your partner may see you as someone who contributes to his/her spiritual growth and development.
20.meaning.upright.thematic_love.2: In the «How to behave» position, the Judgment card advises you to be open and honest with yourself and your partner. Don't be afraid to admit your mistakes and take responsibility for your actions. Be ready for deep and sincere communication, even if it requires vulnerability and courage. Don't hold on to past hurts and disagreements—learn to forgive and let go. Listen to your inner voice and intuition; they will guide you in the right direction. Strive for constant renewal and growth in your relationship, not allowing it to become routine or stagnant.
20.meaning.upright.thematic_love.3: In the «What to avoid» position, the Judgment card warns against ignoring the signs and signals that your relationship is sending you. Don't hide from the truth, whatever it may be, or put off important decisions. Avoid self-deception and illusions about your partner or the nature of your relationship. Don't be afraid of change and transformation—they are necessary for growth and development. Beware of clinging to the past out of fear of the future or a false sense of security. Don't judge yourself or your partner too harshly—remember that we all learn and grow through our mistakes.
20.meaning.upright.thematic_love.4: In the «Where is the relationship going» position, the Judgment card heralds a period of profound transformation and renewal. Your relationship is on the threshold of a new stage that will require both partners to be ready for change and personal growth. You may have to go through an important turning point or make a decision that will determine the future of your union. This may be related to moving to a new level of intimacy and understanding or to the completion of a certain cycle in your relationship. In any case, this period will contribute to your spiritual awakening and development.
20.meaning.upright.thematic_love.5: In the «Conclusion, relationship advice» position, the Judgement card indicates the need to take stock honestly and learn lessons from the past. Your relationship needs renewal and transformation based on mutual growth and development. This may be a time for important conversations and decisions that will determine the future of your union. The card advises you to be open to inner revelations and ready for change, even if it seems scary or difficult. Remember that true love requires constant renewal and growth from both partners.
20.advice.upright.thematic_love.0: The Judgment card advises you to treat romantic relationships as an opportunity for spiritual growth and self-discovery. Be open to inner insights and ready to transform your views on love and partnership. Don't be afraid to admit your mistakes and learn from them—it's a sign of strength, not weakness. Trust your inner voice and intuition, especially when it comes to important decisions in your love life. Remember that every relationship is a unique experience that helps you better understand yourself and your true desires. Strive for honesty and authenticity in expressing your feelings and expectations.
20.meaning.upright.thematic_careerFinanc: Position «Current situation at work»: The Judgment card indicates a period of significant professional change. You are on the verge of an important career transformation, when your past achievements and skills are being reevaluated. Perhaps your company is undergoing restructuring, or you yourself are rethinking your professional path. This is a time when your talents and abilities may be noticed by management, leading to a promotion or new responsibilities. Judgment urges you to be prepared for public recognition of your achievements and to be open to a new professional calling.

The «Obstacles» position: The Court in the obstacles position indicates difficulties associated with accepting change and transformation in your career. You may be afraid of harsh evaluation of your professional qualities or avoid taking responsibility for past mistakes. The obstacle may also be an unwillingness to hear constructive criticism or a fear that you do not meet new requirements and expectations. Judgment reminds you that excessive attachment to past experiences and unwillingness to change can seriously hinder your career growth and financial well-being.

The «Influence of the Past» position: The Judgment card in this position indicates that your past professional decisions and actions are currently being reevaluated and reinterpreted. Perhaps you gained important experience or education in the past that is only now beginning to bear fruit. Your previous efforts and hard work have not been in vain—they have laid the foundation for your current opportunities. Or perhaps you made mistakes that now need to be corrected in order to move forward. Judgment speaks of a karmic cycle in your career, where past actions return in the form of consequences—both positive and requiring self-improvement.

Position «Probable outcome if no action is taken»: The Judgment warns that if you decide to remain passive and do not respond to the call for change, the consequences may be unfavorable. Without your active participation in your career transformation, you risk missing out on significant opportunities for professional growth and financial advancement. Inaction may result in others taking the positions that were meant for you, and your talents remaining unfulfilled. The Judgment card in this position also indicates the possibility of forced change—if you do not initiate change yourself, it may be imposed from outside, and the process of adaptation will be more painful.

Position «Ways of Action»: Judgement recommends acting honestly, openly, and with a willingness to change. The key to success will be your ability to objectively assess your professional qualities, acknowledge past mistakes, and demonstrate a willingness to change. It is important not to be afraid of publicity and external evaluation—present the results of your work to your colleagues and management. Actively seek feedback and accept criticism as a tool for growth. The card also advises you to pay attention to learning new skills, especially in areas where technological or conceptual revolutions are taking place in your industry.

Position «Possible consequences of your actions»: Following the energy of the Judgement card, your actions may lead to a significant professional awakening and renewal. A willingness to change and take on new challenges will open doors to career advancement and financial well-being. This may result in public recognition of your achievements, increased status and authority in your professional environment. You may be offered a new position that better suits your true talents and calling. The card also indicates the possibility of a complete professional rebirth – a change not only of job, but also of field of activity to one more in line with your true nature.

Position «Potential of the situation»: The Judgment card in this position reveals the exceptional potential of the current situation to transform your career and financial situation. You have the opportunity not only to improve your performance, but to qualitatively change the level of your professional fulfillment. This potential includes broadening your horizons, entering new markets or audiences, and gaining inner confidence in your calling. The Judgment card also indicates the possibility of redeeming past professional failures and mistakes—you may get a chance to fix what seemed irreparable and prove your professional competence.

Recommendations: The Judgement card recommends viewing the current period as a time of purification and renewal in your professional life. Be prepared to honestly and objectively assess your achievements and failures, strengths and weaknesses. Don't cling to outdated work methods or career strategies — what worked before may not be effective in new circumstances. Listen to feedback from colleagues and management, even if it seems critical. The card also advises you to be more open in your communication and not to hide your ideas and suggestions. You should be prepared to present your projects publicly and have your work evaluated by others.

The «Outcome» position: The court in the outcome position heralds profound and favorable changes in your career and financial situation. The result of the current processes will be your professional rebirth—finding new meaning in your work and a deeper understanding of your calling and talents. You will be able to free yourself from past professional mistakes and limitations, opening a new chapter in your career. Your financial situation will improve thanks to a more conscious approach to work and greater harmony between your inner values and professional activities. The Judgment card indicates that the result will be not only material well-being, but also a sense of duty fulfilled, inner righteousness, and alignment with your higher calling.
20.advice.upright.thematic_careerFinance: The Judgment card advises you to take an active role in the process of career change, rather than waiting for decisions to be made for you. It is now critical to honestly assess your professional achievements and failures, acknowledge your mistakes, and learn from them. Don't be afraid of publicity and external evaluation—present the results of your work openly and be willing to accept constructive criticism. Pay attention to signals that indicate the need for professional transformation—this could be a change in market demands, the emergence of new technologies, or your inner feeling that it's time for a change. Remember that the Judgment card symbolizes not only external evaluation but also internal judgment—listen to your conscience and intuition about the right career path.
20.meaning.upright.universal_celticCross: Position «Situation»: The Judgment card in the center of the spread indicates that you are at a turning point in your life that requires deep rethinking and transformation. The current situation is characterized by an awakening of consciousness, an awareness of the true state of affairs, and the need for an honest assessment of the past. You seem to hear an inner call for renewal, to leave behind outdated patterns of thinking and behavior. Perhaps recent events have caused you to reevaluate your values or your life path. Judgment speaks of a moment of insight when the veil of illusion falls away and you begin to see the situation in its true light, with all its possibilities and challenges.

Position «Development of the situation»: Judgment as the development of a situation heralds the imminent arrival of a period of significant change and transformation. In the near future, you may be faced with the need to publicly present the results of your activities or undergo an important test of your qualities and achievements. The situation is developing in the direction of spiritual and personal renewal, when the past will be analyzed and reinterpreted from a new perspective. You may receive a clear signal or call indicating the need for change. It is also possible that important news or announcements will change your understanding of the current situation and open up new prospects for further development.

Position «Hint»: The Judgment card in the hint position advises you to listen to the voice of your intuition and higher consciousness. You may already be receiving signals and signs indicating the need for transformation and renewal in your life. This card calls you to honest self-assessment and a willingness to hear the truth about yourself and your actions, even if that truth may be uncomfortable. The Judgment card's advice is that true change begins with deep inner awareness and recognition of the need for change. Pay attention to dreams, synchronicities, and recurring themes in your life—they may contain key messages for your spiritual awakening and transition to a new level of existence.

The «Origins of the Situation» position: Judgment in this position indicates that the roots of the current situation lie in the need to deeply rethink past experiences and learn important lessons from them. Perhaps you have been moving forward by inertia for a long time, following familiar patterns and not thinking about the deeper meaning of your actions. The roots may also be related to the karmic return of past actions, which now require awareness and integration. Judgment indicates that you have long been ready for transformation and renewal, but may have postponed this process until it became inevitable. Now is the time to awaken and take an honest look at the situation from a higher perspective.

The Past Position: The Judgment card in the past position indicates a recent period of significant transformation or an important life transition that has influenced the current situation. Perhaps you have experienced a moment of awakening, when many illusions have been dispelled and you have seen reality in a new light. In the recent past, you may have received important feedback or gone through an evaluation of your actions and achievements, both external and internal. Judgment may also indicate that you have recently completed an important life stage and are in the process of transitioning to something new. This experience has shaped your current understanding of the situation and your readiness for further change.

The Future Position: Judgment in the immediate future position heralds a period of significant change and transformation that will occur in your life over the next few weeks or months. You are about to experience a moment of awakening when many things will become clear and obvious. You may receive important news or information that will change your perception of the situation. Judgment may also indicate an upcoming public presentation, exam, or other form of evaluation of your achievements and qualities. This will be a time to take stock of a certain stage of your life and prepare for a new cycle. Be prepared for events that will require you to be honest with yourself and willing to let go of the past for the sake of renewal and rebirth.

Position «What awaits you»: The Judgment card in this position indicates that a profound process of inner transformation and rebirth awaits you. In the near future, you will be able to review many aspects of your life from a more mature and conscious perspective. You may receive news that will prompt you to take action or change course. Judgment heralds a period when many hidden aspects of a situation will come to light, allowing you to see the full picture. You can expect to be freed from the burden of past mistakes and misconceptions, as well as the opportunity to start a new phase of your life with a renewed consciousness and a deeper understanding of your true path and purpose.

Position «External Influence»: Judgment in the position of external influence indicates that the processes of collective renewal and awakening taking place in society or in social groups that are important to you are having a significant impact on your situation. Perhaps general trends of transformation in your professional field or changes in the worldview of those around you are creating the context for your personal changes. Judgment may also indicate the presence in your life of a person or group of people who are acting as a catalyst for awakening, calling you to be honest with yourself and recognize the need for change. Public opinion or the expectations of significant others may push you to reevaluate your values and choices.

The Hope Position: The Judgment card in the hopes and fears position reflects your deep desire for renewal, transformation, and spiritual awakening. You hope for the opportunity to start a new chapter in your life, leaving behind the limitations and mistakes of the past. Deep down, you crave clarity and a clear understanding of your path, freedom from doubt and uncertainty. Judgment may also indicate a hope for recognition of your achievements and a fair assessment of your efforts. At the same time, you may fear harsh judgment of your actions, fear of not meeting high standards, or fear of having to completely change your lifestyle and way of thinking.

The «Outcome» position: Judgment in the outcome position portends a profound transformation and rebirth at a new level of awareness and understanding. The end result of the current processes will be your awakening to a more authentic and holistic existence. You will be able to integrate your past experiences, learn valuable lessons from them, and move forward with a renewed consciousness. The card indicates that events will lead to a significant turning point, after which a new life cycle will begin. Judgment also speaks of the possibility of redeeming past mistakes, freeing yourself from the burden of guilt or wrong decisions. The result will be not only an external change in circumstances, but also a profound inner transformation, leading to greater harmony between your actions and your true nature.
The Judgment card calls you to be honest with yourself and ready to go through a process of deep transformation. Do not resist the changes that are currently taking place in your life—they lead to necessary renewal and rebirth. Listen to your inner voice, which is becoming increasingly clear and guiding you toward a more authentic existence. Do not be afraid to let go of the past—freedom from outdated patterns of thinking and behavior will open the way to new opportunities and greater self-fulfillment. Be prepared to honestly evaluate your past actions, acknowledge your mistakes, and learn valuable lessons from them. Remember that true awakening requires the courage to face the truth, no matter how uncomfortable it may be.
20.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.0: Position 'Past': The Judgment card in the past position indicates an important turning point in your life that has already occurred. Perhaps you have gone through a period of profound transformation that has changed your view of the world. It was a time of awakening, when you heard a call demanding your attention and action. Past decisions were final, bringing a certain stage of your life to a close. Judgment indicates that you have already gone through a spiritual renewal that has allowed you to leave behind outdated patterns of behavior and beliefs. It was a time when you were able to recognize your mistakes, accept them, and move forward, enriched by new experiences.
20.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.1: The «What is happening now» position: In the present, Judgment indicates a period of profound transformation and spiritual awakening. You are currently going through a period when life is calling you to a higher level of existence. You may feel the need to honestly evaluate your actions and thoughts and conduct an internal review. The Judgment in this position indicates the need to take responsibility for your past and present. This is a time when you realize the deep truth about yourself and your life. Current events require you to be completely honest with yourself and ready for serious change. You are on the verge of significant personal growth.
20.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.2: Position «How events will unfold»: The Judgment card in the position of future developments heralds a period when you will be called to a higher level of self-awareness and action. Events will unfold in such a way that you will have to let go of the old and accept the new. A spiritual awakening awaits you that will change your perception of reality. Judgment indicates that the time is coming when you will have the opportunity to cleanse yourself of past mistakes and start life anew. This may be related to public recognition of your achievements or overcoming significant obstacles. Serious work lies ahead to integrate your past experiences into your new self.
20.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.3: The «Hint» position: The Judgment card in the hint position urges you to listen to your inner voice, which is calling out to you especially loudly right now. This is a hint about the need for honest self-assessment and readiness for change. Judgment invites you to free yourself from feelings of guilt and fear of judgment so that you can move toward new horizons. The universe is telling you that now is the time for spiritual renewal and a reevaluation of your values. Don't be afraid to judge yourself fairly, but with compassion. Remember that true transformation is only possible when you fully accept your past and are ready to be reborn into a new life.
20.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.4: Position «External influences»: Judgment in the position of external influences indicates that you are surrounded by an atmosphere of change and renewal. Perhaps society or those close to you expect certain actions or decisions from you. External circumstances are creating conditions for your spiritual awakening and transformation. Judgment indicates that the collective consciousness or significant figures in your environment are passing a kind of verdict on your actions. This may be related to public recognition or criticism. External forces are calling you to be responsible and honest with yourself and others. You may feel pressure from people who expect you to change or make progress.
20.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.5: The Obstacles Position: In the Obstacles position, the Judgment card points to difficulties related to your resistance to inevitable change. You may fear the judgment of others or your own judgment of yourself. Fear of exposure or of having to admit your mistakes may be holding you back. Judgment indicates that you are finding it difficult to let go of the past and complete a certain stage of your life. An obstacle may also be an unwillingness to undergo spiritual renewal or a fear of radical change. You may be afraid that after the transformation, your life will become unrecognizable, and this prevents you from making the necessary decisions.
20.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.6: Position «What awaits you»: The Judgment card in the final outcome position portends a profound renewal of all aspects of your life. A period of rebirth and rethinking awaits you, which will lead to a completely new stage. Judgement indicates that you will ultimately be held accountable for your actions, but this will contribute to your liberation from past mistakes. Forgiveness and reconciliation await you—both with others and with yourself. This period will bring a deep awareness of your true path and purpose. You will have the opportunity to start over with a clean slate, but enriched by the wisdom of past experiences.
20.advice.upright.universal_horseshoe.0: The advice of the Judgment card is to be ready to hear the call of your soul and respond to it. It is time for honest self-assessment and acknowledgment of your mistakes without excessive self-flagellation. Accept your past as a necessary experience for moving on to a new level. Don't be afraid to pass judgment on those aspects of your life that need change. Judgment advises you to be open to spiritual awakening and transformation. Prepare yourself to let go of old patterns of behavior and beliefs in order to make room for the new. Remember that true rebirth is only possible through taking responsibility for your actions.
20.meaning.upright.selfDevelopment_shado: Position 'What qualities of mine remain in the shadows': The Judgment card in the shadow qualities position indicates a suppressed ability to assess yourself fairly and to renew yourself spiritually. Your deep need to purify yourself from past mistakes and start a new life may remain in the shadows. Judgment indicates that you are hiding your ability for radical transformation and spiritual awakening from yourself. Perhaps your inner wisdom, capable of making fair judgments without excessive criticism or excuses, remains in the shadows. This may also be related to a suppressed sense of self-worth and the right to new beginnings. You may not be aware of your ability to forgive yourself and take responsibility for your actions at the same time.

The position «What makes me hide them»: The Judgment card in the position of the reasons for hiding shadow qualities indicates a deep fear of judgment, both external and internal. You may be afraid to face the truth and see your mistakes and shortcomings. The card suggests that you may be frightened by the scale of the changes that are necessary and the responsibility that will come with awakening. Perhaps you fear that if you begin the process of self-evaluation and transformation, you will not be able to stop and will be forced to completely change your life. Fear of the unknown and the possible consequences of spiritual awakening forces you to keep your true qualities in the shadows. Another reason may be an unwillingness to let go of the past and start all over again.

Position «What will their manifestation lead to»: Judgment in the position of the results of the manifestation of shadow qualities portends a profound transformation of all aspects of your life. If you allow yourself to reveal your hidden ability for honest self-assessment and spiritual renewal, it will lead to the rebirth of your true self. The card suggests that revealing these qualities will start a process of liberation from past mistakes and fears. You will finally be able to hear the call of your soul and respond to it. This will lead to forgiveness of yourself and others, as well as deep reconciliation with the parts of yourself that you have rejected. As a result, you will gain inner wholeness and clarity about your life path.

Position «What will help me make friends with my shadow»: The Judgment card in the position of helping to integrate the shadow indicates the need to develop an inner observer who is able to impartially evaluate your actions and thoughts. To befriend your shadow aspects, you need to learn to listen to your inner voice, which often manifests itself through intuitive insights or dreams. The card suggests that spiritual renewal practices—meditation, prayer, transition rituals—can help you accept and integrate the parts of yourself that you reject. It is also important to learn to forgive yourself without denying responsibility for your actions. It may be helpful to create your own ritual of forgiveness and letting go of the past, symbolizing your rebirth into a new life.

Position «What resources can my shadow side open up for me»: The Judgment card in the shadow side resource position indicates the enormous potential for spiritual growth and transformation that is hidden in your shadow. By integrating your shadow aspects, you will unlock access to deep wisdom and the ability to assess situations fairly. The card suggests that your shadow contains a resource of inner renewal and rebirth that can be activated through acceptance and integration. It is also a resource for forgiveness—both of yourself and others—that will allow you to free yourself from the burdens of the past. Hidden in your shadow is the ability to hear the true call of your soul and respond to it, which will lead you to your true purpose and meaning in life.
20.advice.upright.selfDevelopment_shadow: The advice of the Judgment card for working with your shadow side is not to be afraid to face your hidden qualities and potential. It is time for deep inner work aimed at integrating the rejected aspects of yourself. Create your own ritual of awakening and rebirth that will help you symbolically let go of the past and welcome the new. Practice honest self-assessment regularly, without excessive criticism or excuses. Judgment advises you to listen to your inner voice and intuition, which can guide you in the process of working with your shadow. Be prepared for profound transformation and do not resist necessary changes. Remember that true liberation is only possible through the acceptance of all aspects of yourself.
20.meaning.upright.selfDevelopment_mirro: In the «How I see myself» position, the Judgment card indicates that you perceive yourself as a person on the threshold of an important life transformation. You feel an inner call to awakening, ready to hear the truth about yourself and your path. In your self-perception, there is a feeling that it is time to take stock of your past experiences and learn from them. You feel that you are ready to reject outdated ideas about yourself and be reborn into a new life, aware of your true desires and needs. Your self-perception is attuned to profound change and transformation.

In the «How others see me» position, the Judgment card reveals that those around you perceive you as a person undergoing a profound transformation. They notice an awakening in you, as if you have heard an important call and responded to it. To others, you appear as a person who is ready for honest self-assessment and rethinking of life values. They see your desire for justice, recognition of truth, and ability to make objective judgments. Those around you feel that you are on the threshold of a new stage, ready for rebirth and spiritual renewal.

In the position «My hidden qualities», the Judgment card points to a deep capacity for self-analysis and honest self-assessment that you do not always display. Within you lives a strong desire for spiritual rebirth and transformation, although this may not be apparent on the outside. A hidden resource is the ability to hear the true call of your soul, casting aside conventions and the expectations of others. Deep down, you possess the rare gift of forgiveness—both of yourself and others—which can be the key to healing old wounds. Your unexpressed capacity for transformation and renewal is much stronger than even you realize.

In the «My obvious qualities» position, the Judgment card indicates your obvious ability to honestly assess situations and people. Those around you value your objectivity and fairness in judgment, your ability to see the big picture. You openly demonstrate a willingness to change and renew yourself without clinging to the past. A clear trait of your character is a desire for truth and authenticity in all aspects of life. People notice your tendency to take stock, analyze the path you have traveled, and learn from experience, which makes you a wise conversationalist and advisor to many.

In the «My Growth Potential» position, Judgment symbolizes enormous opportunities for spiritual awakening and personal transformation. Your potential lies in your ability to hear your true calling and follow it no matter what. You have hidden resources for completely renewing your life by letting go of old resentments, fears, and limiting beliefs. The card indicates the potential to become a catalyst for change not only in your own life, but also for those around you. By developing your intuition and inner voice, you will be able to make higher-order decisions based on deep wisdom and an understanding of cause and effect.

In the «What is holding me back» position, the Judgment card indicates resistance to inevitable change and fear of profound transformation. You are hindered by an unwillingness to honestly assess your past mistakes and learn from them. The obstacle is your refusal to hear the true call of your soul, preferring to remain in your comfort zone. You may have difficulty forgiving yourself and others, which prevents you from completely freeing yourself from the burden of the past. Excessive concern about the opinions of others and fear of public condemnation also prevent you from responding to the call for spiritual awakening and personal rebirth.

In the «My Fears» position, the Judgment card reveals a deep fear of a final and irreversible change in your entire life. You fear that after spiritual awakening, you will not be able to return to your usual way of life and thinking. There is an anxiety within you that, upon hearing the true call of your soul, you will be forced to abandon many familiar patterns and relationships. The fear of a fair assessment of your past actions, the fear of seeing yourself in a true light without illusions and self-deception, paralyzes your movement forward. Deep inside you, the thought that rebirth will require a complete immersion into the unknown and a loss of control over the usual course of events is frightening.

In the «My Strength» position, the Judgment card indicates your amazing ability to revive and renew yourself even after the most difficult life trials. Your strength lies in your ability to hear the deep call of your soul and follow it, even if it requires radical changes. You possess the rare gift of objective self-assessment without excessive criticism or self-praise. Your strengths include an innate sense of justice and the ability to forgive past grievances, freeing yourself from their burden.
