This position indicates that your negative emotions are preventing you from seeing the positive aspects of the relationship.

In the «Partner's Feelings» position, the Five of Cups indicates that your partner is experiencing deep disappointment in the relationship. He or she may feel that something important has been lost or missed and is having difficulty accepting the current situation. Perhaps your partner is fixated on past hurts or mistakes and cannot stop thinking about what went wrong. This card may also indicate that your partner is going through a period of emotional withdrawal, where he or she is psychologically distancing himself or herself from the relationship and retreating into his or her own sadness or disappointment.

In the «Your Potential in Relationships» position, the Five of Cups indicates the need to learn to overcome disappointment and move on. Your potential growth in this relationship is linked to developing emotional stability and the ability to see opportunities even after losses. You can learn to appreciate what remains intact rather than focusing on what has been lost. This card suggests that by working through feelings of loss and disappointment, you will be able to achieve greater emotional maturity and depth. Your ability to forgive and accept the imperfections of the relationship will be a key factor in its development.

In the «Partner's Potential in the Relationship» position, the Five of Cups shows that your partner needs to learn to let go of past hurts and disappointments. His/her growth in the relationship is linked to the ability to not dwell on the negative aspects of the situation. Your partner has the potential for deep emotional healing through this relationship if they can redirect their attention from the three spilled cups to the two remaining ones. This card indicates that your partner may become more compassionate and understanding after working through their own emotional trauma. In the process of overcoming disappointments, your partner may develop a deeper understanding of emotional needs — both their own and yours.

In the «Relationship Advice» position, the Five of Cups indicates the need to openly discuss disappointments and unfulfilled expectations in your relationship. This card advises you not to avoid difficult emotions, but to acknowledge them and work through them together. Perhaps you both need to let go of some idealized notions about the relationship and accept reality as it is. The card points to a need for emotional honesty and openness, even if it is painful. You should find a balance between acknowledging losses and focusing on the remaining opportunities for growth and development in the relationship.

In the «Future of the Relationship» position, the Five of Cups warns of a possible period of disappointment and emotional difficulties. You may face a situation that does not meet your expectations or the loss of something important in the relationship. However, this card also indicates the possibility of overcoming these difficulties and transformation. If you can both shift your focus from what has been lost to what remains and move forward, your relationship may become deeper and more meaningful. This card suggests that the path to a happy relationship lies in accepting imperfection and seeing value even after loss.
The Five of Cups advises you and your partner not to be afraid to acknowledge your disappointments and talk about them openly. Avoid blame, but be honest in expressing your feelings. It is important to learn to mourn what has been lost together and then consciously shift your attention to what remains intact and can become the foundation for the future. Practice gratitude for what you have and try to see opportunities for growth even in difficult situations. Remember that no relationship is perfect, and accepting its imperfections can be a source of depth and maturity. Give each other space to experience your emotions, but don't let sadness and disappointment become a permanent state of your relationship.
40.description.upright.0: The Five of Cups depicts a figure in a black cloak standing in a mournful pose in front of three overturned cups from which liquid has spilled out. The person is so consumed by grief and focused on their losses that they do not notice the two cups remaining intact behind them. In the distance, a bridge can be seen across the river, leading to a castle or settlement — a symbol of new opportunities and a future that awaits when the person is ready to move on. The Five of Cups symbolizes disappointment, grief, and emotional loss. This card speaks of a situation where we are stuck in a feeling of loss, unable to see what remains intact and valuable. It points to a period of mourning that must be lived through in order to ultimately let go of the past and move toward new horizons. The Five of Cups can also indicate regret about decisions made or opportunities missed, feelings of guilt, or an unwillingness to accept reality as it is. This is a time when emotions cloud rational thinking and the future seems bleak. However, the card itself contains a reminder that all is not lost—the two remaining cups and the path to the bridge symbolize hope and the possibilities that open up when we are ready to let go of the past and move forward.
40.advice.upright.default.0: The Five of Cups advises you to acknowledge your feelings of loss and disappointment, but not to let them define your future. Allow yourself time to grieve—it is a natural and important part of the healing process. However, remember that in any situation, even the most painful, there is always something that remains intact and valuable. Practice consciously shifting your attention from what has been lost to what remains. Use this experience as an opportunity for growth and wisdom. Learn lessons from the past, but don't let it hold you captive. Gradually turn toward the bridge and prepare for the journey to new horizons. Remember that accepting reality as it is is the first step toward true emotional healing and inner peace.
40.meaning.upright.thematic_love.0: In the position «What I feel towards my partner», the Five of Cups indicates that your feelings are tinged with disappointment and a sense of loss. You may be feeling sad because the relationship does not live up to your expectations or ideals. You may feel that something important in your feelings or in the relationship has been lost over time. This card suggests that you tend to focus on the negative aspects of the relationship and overlook the positive ones. Your emotions may be mixed: on the one hand, you still cherish your partner, but on the other hand, you feel pain from unfulfilled hopes or disappointments.
40.meaning.upright.thematic_love.1: In the position «How my partner feels about me», the Five of Cups indicates that your partner is experiencing feelings of disappointment or loss in your relationship. Perhaps he or she is comparing your current reality with what he or she expected or hoped for at the beginning. Your partner may feel that something important has been lost in your relationship and is having difficulty accepting the new reality. This card may also indicate that your partner is emotionally stuck in the past, perhaps in a previous relationship or an earlier stage of your relationship, and this is preventing him/her from being fully present in the moment with you.
40.meaning.upright.thematic_love.2: In the «How to behave» position, the Five of Cups advises you to acknowledge your disappointments and talk about them openly but gently with your partner. Don't suppress your feelings, but don't let them completely define your perception of the relationship. You are encouraged to practice consciously shifting your attention from what is upsetting you to what is still working well in your relationship. Be prepared to let go of idealized notions and accept your partner and your relationship as they are. This card invites you to show emotional maturity by not blaming your partner for your disappointments, but also not denying your feelings.
40.meaning.upright.thematic_love.3: In the «What to Avoid» position, the Five of Cups warns against dwelling on the negative aspects of a relationship. Avoid constantly dwelling on past hurts, mistakes, or disappointments—this will only exacerbate feelings of loss and prevent you from moving forward. Don't compare your current relationship to an idealized image of how it «should be». Be careful not to project your past disappointments onto your current relationship and partner. Also, avoid emotional detachment as a defense mechanism — this can lead to even greater alienation and deepen problems in the relationship.
40.meaning.upright.thematic_love.4: In the «Where is the relationship going?» position, the Five of Cups indicates a period of trials associated with disappointment and the need to accept the reality of the relationship. Your relationship is moving through a phase that requires emotional healing and a reassessment of expectations. Ahead lies a period when you will have to take an honest look at what has been lost or unfulfilled in the relationship and decide whether you are ready to accept it and move on. This card predicts the possibility of a profound transformation in your relationship if you can both shift your focus from what has been lost to what is still valuable and build a new reality together.
40.meaning.upright.thematic_love.5: In the «Outcome, Relationship Advice» position, the Five of Cups indicates that your relationship is going through a necessary phase of disappointment and reevaluation. This is not the end, but an important part of the process of developing and deepening your connection. By experiencing loss and disappointment, you can come to a more mature and realistic relationship based not on idealization but on accepting each other as you are. The card advises both of you to find a balance between acknowledging what is not working or has been lost and appreciating what remains strong and important. If you can turn together from the spilled cups to those that remain standing and move toward the bridge, your relationship can be reborn in a new, more authentic form.
40.advice.upright.thematic_love.0: The Five of Cups advises you to be emotionally honest in your relationship, but not to let disappointments determine its future. Find a way to openly but constructively discuss your expectations and how reality differs from them. Practice gratitude for what works in your relationship by making a mental or written list of positive aspects. Give yourself and your partner permission to be imperfect, recognizing that no relationship is perfect. Work on developing emotional resilience that will allow you to cope with disappointment without sinking into despair. Remember that overcoming difficulties together can make your relationship deeper and stronger if you are both willing to learn and grow through the experience.
40.meaning.upright.thematic_careerFinanc: In the «Current situation at work» position, the Five of Cups indicates a period of disappointment and loss in your professional life. You may feel dissatisfied with your current job or a project that has not lived up to your expectations. Perhaps you have recently experienced a setback or rejection that has undermined your confidence. Despite this, it is important to note that all is not lost — two cups remain standing, symbolizing opportunities that you are not yet noticing because you are focused on your losses. Your current work situation requires reassessment and a fresh look at your available resources.

In the «Obstacles» position, the Five of Cups shows that the main obstacle to financial well-being and career growth is your own emotional state. Excessive fixation on past failures and disappointments is preventing you from moving forward. You are wasting energy regretting missed opportunities instead of looking for new prospects. Emotional exhaustion reduces your productivity and prevents you from making informed decisions. While you continue to mourn what could have been, new opportunities pass you by unnoticed, exacerbating your sense of stagnation and hopelessness.

In the «Influence of the Past» position, the Five of Cups indicates that previous negative experiences still have a strong influence on your attitude toward work and finances. Perhaps you have experienced job loss, bankruptcy, the failure of an important project, or investments that did not live up to your expectations. These disappointments have made you cautious, bordering on pessimistic, and now you tend to see potential problems rather than opportunities. Traumatic experiences from the past cause you to avoid risks even when they are justified, which limits your financial and career growth in the present.

In the «Likely outcome if no action is taken» position, the Five of Cups warns of a prolonged period of stagnation and missed opportunities. If you continue to focus on past disappointments and failures without taking any action to change the situation, you risk sinking into an even deeper state of professional melancholy. Your financial situation may deteriorate due to your inability to see and seize new opportunities. Moreover, prolonged regret can lead to professional burnout and loss of motivation, making it even more difficult to recover from the crisis.

In the «Ways to Act» position, the Five of Cups advises you to start with emotional healing and a change of perspective. Instead of continuing to mourn financial losses or career setbacks, focus on what remains intact—your skills, experience, contacts, and opportunities that are still available. A practical approach includes analyzing past mistakes to learn lessons, but without emotional attachment to the outcome. Develop a plan for gradual recovery, starting with small, achievable goals that will help restore your confidence. It may be worth seeking professional support or a mentor who can help you see opportunities that are hidden from your current perspective.

In the «Possible consequences of your actions» position, the Five of Cups indicates that the recovery process after financial or career losses will be gradual and require emotional work. Initially, you may encounter internal resistance to change and difficulties in letting go of the past. However, as you learn to focus on the cups that remain rather than those that have been spilled, your ability to notice new opportunities will grow. This may lead to unexpected offers of collaboration or projects that initially seem less attractive but ultimately open up new professional horizons and stabilize your financial situation.

In the «Potential of the Situation» position, the Five of Cups reveals an unobvious but important truth: your current disappointments in your career or finances contain the seeds of transformation and growth. A situation that now seems like a loss may be a catalyst for reevaluating your true professional goals and values. This could potentially lead to a more fulfilling career path that better aligns with your inner aspirations rather than just external expectations. Financial difficulties can teach you to manage your resources more effectively and lead to new, more sustainable models of earning. This card reminds us that sometimes we need to lose something to make room for something better.

In the «Recommendations» position, the Five of Cups advises practicing conscious acceptance of losses, but not dwelling on them. Draw a clear line between constructive analysis of past mistakes and unproductive self-flagellation. Allow yourself time to grieve over a failed project or missed opportunity, but set a time limit for this process. Then consciously redirect your attention to your remaining resources and opportunities. Make a list of your professional achievements and skills to strengthen your self-confidence. Start gradually rebuilding your financial reserves, even if it's just small amounts — this will create a sense of control and progress.

In the «Outcome» position, the Five of Cups heralds a period of transformation through acceptance of loss and disappointment. Ultimately, your current career or financial challenges will lead you to a more mature and balanced attitude toward work and money. You will learn not only to appreciate your successes, but also to draw valuable lessons from your failures, which will make you more resilient to future challenges. The emotional work you do to overcome your current disappointments will lay the foundation for more conscious career decisions in the future. Although full recovery may take time, you will emerge from this experience with a renewed understanding of your professional values and priorities.
40.advice.upright.thematic_careerFinance: The Five of Cups urges you to rethink your attitude toward professional setbacks and financial losses. Right now, it is critical not to wallow in regret and self-blame, but to learn from what has happened. Practice consciously shifting your attention from what you have lost to what is still available to you. Make a concrete recovery plan, breaking it down into small, achievable steps to gradually regain a sense of control over the situation. Don't isolate yourself in your disappointment — seek support from colleagues or a mentor who can help you see the opportunities that are hidden from your view. Remember that periods of professional melancholy are temporary, and it is your ability to refocus your attention that will determine how soon your revival will come.
40.meaning.upright.universal_celticCross: In the «Situation» position, the Five of Cups indicates that you are in a period of grief and disappointment. The current situation is characterized by a sense of loss and regret about what could have been. You tend to focus on the negative aspects of what is happening, overlooking the opportunities and resources available to you. The figure in a cloak standing over the spilled cups symbolizes your current emotional state—being immersed in experiences from the past, which prevents you from noticing the two untouched cups behind you. This card position indicates emotional stagnation and difficulty accepting changes or losses that have already occurred.

In the «Situation Development» position, the Five of Cups warns that if you continue to dwell on negative emotions and regrets, the situation will spiral downward. There is a risk that temporary melancholy will develop into deeper depression or apathy if steps are not taken to accept what has happened. Fixating on losses can lead to missing new opportunities that are already beginning to appear on the horizon. At the same time, the card hints that in the process of experiencing loss, you are gaining important experience and wisdom that will help you become more resilient to life's trials and more sensitive to the needs of others.

In the «Hint» position, the Five of Cups advises you to pay attention to the part of the situation that you are ignoring — the two cups that remain standing. This is a hint that you need to shift your focus from what you have lost to what is still available to you. Perhaps you are so consumed by grief over the past that you do not notice the opportunities in the present. This card reminds you that life goes on even after significant disappointments and invites you to lift your head, turn around, and see what you have to be grateful for. Your ability to overcome your current difficulties depends largely on your willingness to admit that all is not lost and your ability to appreciate what remains.

In the «Origins» position, the Five of Cups indicates that the roots of your current problems lie in past disappointments or losses that you have not fully experienced and accepted. Perhaps at some point you experienced a shattering of hopes or betrayal from which you have not yet recovered emotionally. This unresolved grief or disappointment has formed a certain pattern of perception that causes you to expect the worst and overlook the positive aspects of a situation. The roots of your current problem are linked to your inability in the past to accept the inevitability of certain losses and learn constructive lessons from them.

In the «Past» position, the Five of Cups indicates a recent period of loss and disappointment that still influences your perception of the present. In the recent past, you have probably experienced a situation that did not meet your expectations or led to the loss of something meaningful to you. This could have been the collapse of important plans, a breakup, the loss of a job, or another event that undermined your belief in a favorable outcome. This experience has left an emotional mark that now manifests itself as a tendency to see the glass as half empty rather than half full, and to expect disappointment even where there is potential for positive change.

In the «Future» position, the Five of Cups heralds a period of emotional healing and reconciliation with the past, although this process will not be quick or easy. In the near future, you may find it necessary to finally let go of old grudges, disappointments, or unfulfilled dreams in order to make room for new opportunities. You may have to go through another small disappointment, which, however, will be a catalyst for a deeper acceptance of life in all its manifestations. The card suggests that through a process of grief and acceptance of loss, you will come to a more authentic and balanced attitude toward life's ups and downs.

In the «What awaits you» position, the Five of Cups indicates that you are about to undergo a process of emotional healing related to accepting losses and disappointments. You will have to learn to live with the fact that some opportunities are irretrievably lost and redirect your attention to new horizons. This card position often indicates the need to go through all the stages of grief — denial, anger, bargaining, depression — in order to finally achieve acceptance. In this process, you will discover deep resources of resilience and wisdom within yourself that you never knew you had. Although the road may not be easy, each step will bring you closer to a more holistic and conscious interaction with life.

In the «External Influence» position, the Five of Cups reflects the impact of your environment, which may be amplifying your feelings of loss or disappointment. Perhaps the people around you are prone to pessimism or often remind you of past failures, making emotional healing difficult. Alternatively, this card may indicate that someone in your environment is also going through a period of loss, and their emotional state is affecting you. In some cases, the Five of Cups in this position indicates collective trauma or disappointment experienced by your family, work team, or community, creating an atmosphere of gloom and pessimism.

In the Hope position, the Five of Cups reveals the paradoxical nature of your hopes and fears. On a deep level, you hope for healing of emotional wounds and the opportunity to start over, but at the same time you are afraid to let go of the past completely and open yourself up to new experiences for fear of being disappointed again. This card in the Hope position may also indicate a desire to find meaning in past losses, to find a valuable lesson or spiritual significance in them. Perhaps you secretly hope that your current difficulties are a kind of test that will ultimately lead to a deeper understanding of life and your own nature.

In the «Outcome» position, the Five of Cups indicates that the current process will end with the acceptance of the inevitability of certain losses in life and the attainment of a more mature view of reality. You will learn not only to see the cups that have been spilled, but also to appreciate those that remain untouched. This experience of disappointment, although painful, will become an important part of your personal growth, giving you a deeper understanding of the nature of suffering and joy. The Five of Cups in the final position indicates that through the process of accepting loss, you will gain greater emotional stability and the ability to find meaning even in the most difficult circumstances.
The Five of Cups urges you to gather the courage to fully experience your disappointment or grief, but not to remain in that state forever. Give yourself permission to grieve, but set a time limit for it. Practice consciously shifting your attention from what is lost to what is still present in your life. Start keeping a gratitude journal, noting at least three positive things each day. This simple ritual will help reprogram your brain to look for opportunities rather than fixate on problems. Remember that accepting reality as it is is not the same as resigning yourself to an unsatisfactory situation. Rather, it is a foundation for constructive action and new beginnings, unburdened by the weight of past disappointments.
40.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.0: In the «Past» position, the Five of Cups indicates a period of deep disappointment that you have recently experienced. Perhaps you have lost something valuable, and this loss still echoes with pain in your heart. The card shows that you have been focusing too much on what has gone out of your life and not noticing what remains. You have been immersed in feelings of loss and self-pity, which have prevented you from moving forward. Your thoughts were focused on past mistakes, unfulfilled hopes, or broken relationships. This state of grief and mourning was a necessary stage that you had to go through in order to realize the value of what remains.
40.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.1: In the «What is happening now» position, the Five of Cups reflects your current emotional state of regret and sadness. You are standing in front of spilled cups, symbolizing missed opportunities, and you cannot see the two cups that remain intact. You are currently going through a period of grief, when it is difficult to see the light at the end of the tunnel. Thoughts of what could have been haunt you, preventing you from being fully present in the moment. Emotional exhaustion prevents you from seeing the opportunities that are right in front of you. Despite the depth of your feelings, remember that all is not lost — some of your resources remain, and it is these that you should focus on.
40.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.2: In the «How will events unfold» position, the Five of Cups warns of an approaching period of disappointment, but also points to the possibility of learning important lessons. Events will unfold in such a way that you will face inevitable loss or disappointment. However, the card predicts that after the initial shock and sadness, you will begin to notice what remains untouched—the two cups. This symbolizes your gradual shift in focus from what you have lost to what you still have. This process will not be easy and will require inner strength, but it is a necessary step on the path to regaining emotional balance.
40.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.3: In the «Hint» position, the Five of Cups advises you to stop focusing on past losses and start noticing what you still have. Notice the two untouched cups behind the figure in the black cloak — they symbolize the untapped opportunities and resources you are overlooking. Your fixation on the spilled cups (past failures or losses) is preventing you from moving forward. The card's message is that grief and regret are natural feelings, but they should not become your permanent state. It is time to turn your face toward the future and see the bridge leading to new opportunities.
40.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.4: In the «External Influences» position, the Five of Cups indicates that the atmosphere around you is filled with feelings of disappointment and loss. People around you may be going through difficult times, experiencing loss or regret about the past. Their pessimistic attitude and fixation on the negative may affect you, intensifying your own feelings or making you feel guilty for your successes. Perhaps someone close to you constantly reminds you of past mistakes or missed opportunities, preventing you from moving forward. This energy of grief and disappointment coming from outside requires you to make a conscious choice: to give in to collective despondency or to focus on your remaining resources.
40.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.5: In the «Obstacles» position, the Five of Cups reveals that the main obstacle in your path is your inability to let go of the past and accept your losses. Your fixation on what has been destroyed or lost prevents you from seeing new opportunities. Like a figure on a map, you stand with your back to what remains untouched and valuable. Feelings of regret and constantly replaying «what if» scenarios in your head drain your emotional energy, which is necessary to move forward. You are stuck in a pattern of thinking dominated by sadness and disappointment, which creates an energy block. This emotional stagnation prevents you from seeing the bridge that leads to new horizons and opportunities.
40.meaning.upright.universal_horseshoe.6: In the «What's ahead» position, the Five of Cups predicts a period when you will go through a deep emotional cleansing and transformation. At first, you may experience disappointment or loss that will make you feel the bitterness of loss. However, as you live through these feelings, an important shift in perception will occur—you will learn to see not only what has been lost, but also what has been preserved. This experience will be a valuable lesson for you, helping you develop emotional maturity and the ability to find value even in adverse circumstances. A new understanding of the balance between accepting loss and being grateful for what you have awaits you.
40.advice.upright.universal_horseshoe.0: The Five of Cups advises you to allow yourself to fully experience the feeling of loss, but not to dwell on it for too long. Allow yourself to mourn what has been lost, acknowledge your pain and disappointment. This is a natural part of the healing process. However, after that, gradually redirect your attention to what remains untouched—the two cups that are still standing. Look around you and make a list of things you can be grateful for even now. Practice mindfulness so that you don't get stuck in the past, but are present in the moment. Remember that the bridge on the map symbolizes the path to new opportunities, but to see it, you need to take your eyes off the spilled wine. Look for lessons in your losses and use them as stepping stones for personal growth.
40.meaning.upright.selfDevelopment_shado: In the position «What qualities of mine remain in the shadows», the Five of Cups reveals your hidden tendency toward self-sabotage through excessive focus on losses and disappointments. Your habit of focusing exclusively on negative experiences while ignoring the positive aspects of a situation remains in the shadows. This card indicates an unconscious desire to remain a victim of circumstances, where you prefer to mourn the past instead of actively building a future. Deep down, you cling to painful experiences, turning them into part of your identity. This behavior can manifest as silent protest against life changes or unconscious resistance to healing emotional wounds.

In the «What makes me hide them» position, the Five of Cups shows that you are afraid to acknowledge your role in creating your own disappointments. Your subconscious resists the realization that prolonged grief may be a way to avoid responsibility for your own happiness. You hide these qualities because deep down you understand that admitting your fixation on loss will deprive you of the comfortable position of someone who has been hurt. The fear of having to let go of the past and face the uncertainty of the future forces you to maintain the image of a «suffering righteous person». You also fear judgment from those around you, who may consider your grief excessive or inappropriate.

In the position «Where will this lead?», the Five of Cups predicts that recognizing and accepting your tendency to get stuck in negative emotions will lead to a profound transformation in your attitude toward loss. When you acknowledge your subconscious desire to cultivate suffering, an important shift in perception will occur—you will begin to see not only the cups that have been spilled, but also those that remain standing. Bringing these shadow qualities into your conscious field will allow you to recognize when you are sinking into self-pity and choose a more constructive response. This will lead to emotional maturity and the ability to learn valuable lessons from every loss, transforming the bitterness of disappointment into wisdom and depth of character.

In the position «What will help me make friends with my shadow», the Five of Cups points to the need to practice conscious gratitude as the key to reconciliation with shadow aspects. It is important to start noticing not only your losses but also what you have every day. Regular meditation on the image of two standing cups will help reprogram your mind to look for remaining resources. Keeping an emotion journal with a focus on the dynamics of your experiences will show that even the deepest feelings of sadness are not eternal. A ritual of symbolic farewell to the past will be especially helpful — write a letter to your losses, expressing gratitude for the lessons learned, and then let it go (burn it, bury it, or float it on water). Such practices will help you integrate your shadow side without self-judgment.

In the position «What resources can my shadow side open up for me», the Five of Cups reveals that your tendency to experience sadness and disappointment deeply can be a source of remarkable empathy and deep understanding of human nature. Your ability to see loss and feel its fullness can transform into a gift for noticing beauty and value even in the imperfect aspects of life. A well-developed shadow side of the Five of Cups gives you the rare ability to find meaning in suffering and transform bitterness into wisdom. It can also open up access to the deep resilience of your spirit and your ability to bounce back after emotional upheavals. This card points to the potential for developing existential maturity—the understanding that acceptance of loss and gratitude for what remains can coexist.
40.advice.upright.selfDevelopment_shadow: The Five of Cups advises you to acknowledge your habit of dwelling on the negative and dare to look at what remains intact in your life. Start practicing the «three cups» — every evening, write down three losses or disappointments you experienced during the day, and then five blessings you retained or gained. Gradually, you will notice how your focus shifts. Don't be afraid to look your sadness in the eye — it can teach you a lot, but don't let it become a constant companion. Treat your shadow side with compassion, understanding that your fixation on loss is a defense mechanism that helps you cope with the pain of change. Remember: to see the bridge that leads to new opportunities, sometimes you need to muster the courage to turn your back on the past.
40.meaning.upright.selfDevelopment_mirro: In the 'How I see myself' position, the Five of Cups reflects your perception of yourself as someone experiencing loss or disappointment. You tend to focus on your failures, missed opportunities, and past mistakes. Your self-perception is dominated by feelings of regret and melancholy. You see yourself as someone who is stuck in the past, unable to let go of painful memories and move on. This self-perception may be temporary, related to recent events, but it significantly affects your daily life and decision-making, creating a filter through which you interpret your opportunities and relationships.

In the «How others see me» position, the Five of Cups shows that those around you perceive you as a person immersed in negative emotions and regret. They notice your tendency to dwell on losses instead of appreciating what you have. Others may see sadness and disappointment in you, even when you try to hide it. Your melancholy may repel some people, while others may seek to pull you out of this emotional state. Those around you may feel that you focus too much on past mistakes, which prevents you from seeing the positive aspects of the present and future opportunities.

In the «My Hidden Qualities» position, the Five of Cups indicates a deep-rooted fear of loss and disappointment that you may not be fully aware of. Inside you lives unprocessed grief over missed opportunities or idealized notions of what your life could have been. This card reveals your hidden tendency to expect the worst and prepare for disappointment even in potentially positive situations. However, in this same position, the Five of Cups reveals your unconscious ability to extract wisdom from painful experiences — a skill you have not yet learned to appreciate or use effectively.

In the «My obvious qualities» position, the Five of Cups manifests itself as your obvious tendency toward melancholy and thoughtfulness. Those around you notice your sensitivity to loss and disappointment, your emotional depth, and your ability to empathize with others' pain. Your caution in making decisions and careful consideration of consequences stems from a desire to avoid repeating painful mistakes from the past. This card also indicates your open commitment to analyzing past events, which can manifest itself in productive reflection or in unproductive dwelling on things that cannot be changed. In any case, your attitude toward loss and how you experience it is a noticeable part of your personality.

In the «My Growth Potential» position, the Five of Cups represents a unique opportunity for deep emotional and spiritual growth through the acceptance of loss and disappointment. Your potential lies in your ability to transform sadness into wisdom, regret into understanding, and loss into openness to new experiences. This card indicates the possibility of developing deep compassion for yourself and others based on your personal experience of overcoming difficulties. You can become a master of emotional alchemy, turning painful experiences into a source of strength and insight. When you learn to see the two remaining cups, not just the three spilled ones, you will discover your ability to find hope in the darkest moments of life.

In the «What is holding me back» position, the Five of Cups reveals your inability to let go of the past as the main obstacle to your development. Your attachment to disappointments and losses becomes a heavy emotional burden that slows you down. You spend a significant amount of your energy thinking about what cannot be changed, instead of directing that energy toward creating a new future. Fixating on negative experiences distorts your perspective, causing you to see threats and potential disappointments where they may not exist. This card also indicates your tendency to ignore available resources and support, much like the figure on the card who does not notice the two remaining cups behind her.

In the «My Fears» position, the Five of Cups reveals a deep fear of repeating painful experiences and new disappointments. You are afraid of reliving the feelings of loss and helplessness that once hurt you deeply. This fear often manifests itself as a reluctance to fully trust or invest emotionally in new relationships and projects. You subconsciously fear that any new attachment will lead to the same pain you experienced in the past. On a deeper level, there is a fear that you will never be able to overcome your grief and will be stuck in a cycle of loss and regret forever. This card also indicates a fear of missing out on something important, which causes you to constantly look back instead of looking forward.

In the «My Strength» position, the Five of Cups paradoxically points to your ability to feel deeply and experience emotions as a source of inner strength. Your experience of disappointment and loss has developed exceptional emotional resilience and a deep understanding of human nature. You have a rare ability to see the ambiguity of life situations and accept both the light and dark sides of existence. This card also reflects your strength in your ability to learn from painful experiences and use them for personal growth. Your ability to empathize with others' pain and support them in difficult times, based on your own experience of overcoming loss, is an invaluable gift.

In the «My weakness» position, the Five of Cups indicates a tendency to get stuck in negative emotional states and focus excessively on losses. Your weakness manifests itself in a tendency to see only the «spilled cups» — missed opportunities, mistakes, and disappointments — while ignoring the «remaining cups» — the resources and opportunities that are still available to you. This card also reflects your vulnerability to regret, which can paralyze your ability to make decisions out of fear of making new mistakes. You tend to mourn what cannot be recovered for too long, which depletes your emotional energy and prevents you from directing it toward new endeavors. Your emotional sensitivity, while a source of depth, can become a weakness when it turns into an inability to let go of the past.

In the «My Path of Development» position, the Five of Cups indicates the need to learn to integrate experiences of loss and disappointment into a broader perspective of your life path. Your development lies in gradually shifting your focus from what has been lost to what remains and what can be recreated. This card offers you a path of transformation through conscious acceptance and letting go of past disappointments to free up emotional space for new opportunities. You are called to develop the ability to see valuable lessons and gifts in every painful experience. By gradually turning from spilled cups to standing ones, you learn to find gratitude even in imperfect circumstances and form a more holistic, balanced view of life.
40.advice.upright.selfDevelopment_mirror: The Five of Cups advises you to acknowledge your losses and disappointments, but not to let them define your future. Yes, some cups have been spilled, and their contents cannot be recovered—whether they are missed opportunities, unfulfilled dreams, or broken relationships. However, not all cups have been overturned, and therein lies the most important lesson. Learn to turn away from what is lost and toward what remains in your life. Notice the two cups still standing behind the figure in the card — they symbolize unexplored opportunities and resources that you may not notice because of your focus on your losses. The grieving process is important for healing, but don't let it become a permanent state. Remember that every loss frees up space for something new. Time spent reflecting on the past is valuable only when it leads to wisdom and understanding, not an endless cycle of regret.
40.meaning.upright.universal_pyramid.0: Position 'Current situation': The Five of Cups in this position indicates a period of disappointment and loss that you are currently experiencing. You tend to focus on what you have lost, not noticing what you still have. Your attention is fixed on the three overturned cups, symbolizing failure and disappointment, while the two full cups behind you remain unnoticed. The present moment is colored by feelings of regret and melancholy that prevent you from moving forward. Perhaps a recent event has caused you to sink into a state of sadness and grief, preventing you from seeing the positive aspects of your life.
40.meaning.upright.universal_pyramid.1: Obstacle or Help Position: The Five of Cups in this position indicates that your main obstacle is an excessive focus on past failures and losses. Your tendency to constantly return to painful memories prevents you from seeing new opportunities. The irony is that recognizing this loss can be a catalyst for profound inner change. By overcoming the initial pain of disappointment, you will gain wisdom and compassion that are unavailable to those who have not experienced such feelings. Your obstacle can be transformed into help if you can learn from your experience.
40.meaning.upright.universal_pyramid.2: The Unconscious Influence Position: The Five of Cups in the unconscious influence position indicates a deep-rooted fear of loss and disappointment that unconsciously influences your decisions. Perhaps you have experienced a traumatic loss in the past that causes you to subconsciously expect the worst even in favorable situations. This unconscious influence manifests itself in a tendency to protect yourself from possible disappointment through emotional detachment or excessive caution. This card shows that on a deep level, you are still grieving for something you have lost, even if on a conscious level you believe you have already come to terms with this loss.
40.meaning.upright.universal_pyramid.3: The Past Position: The Five of Cups in the Past position indicates a significant loss or disappointment that has shaped your current perception of the world. This experience may have included the loss of a loved one, the collapse of important plans, or the shattering of illusions about a situation or relationship. You have gone through a period of grief and may still be carrying the emotional weight of this event. However, this past experience has also laid the foundation for your emotional growth and the development of your capacity for compassion. By going through the pain of loss, you have gained a depth of understanding of human emotions that is only available through personal experience of loss.
40.meaning.upright.universal_pyramid.4: Future Possibilities Position: The Five of Cups in the Future Possibilities position warns of potential disappointment that may lie ahead. However, this is not a fatal prediction, but rather a reminder to be prepared for the possibility that not all of your hopes will be fulfilled. You may need to let go of some expectations or illusions in order to open yourself up to more realistic prospects. This process holds a valuable opportunity for spiritual growth and wisdom. The disappointment that may follow will not be the end of the road, but an important stage of transformation that will allow you to reevaluate your values and discover new, more authentic opportunities for self-fulfillment and happiness.
40.meaning.upright.universal_pyramid.5: Attitude toward the situation: The Five of Cups in the attitude position indicates that you tend to view the current situation through the lens of disappointment and regret. Your attention is overly focused on the negative aspects and missed opportunities, which creates a distorted picture of reality. You are like the figure on the card, looking at the spilled cups and ignoring the ones that are still intact. This pessimistic attitude prevents you from seeing the positive aspects of the situation and constructive ways to solve problems. This card indicates that your own perception is part of the problem, and redirecting your focus can significantly change your assessment of what is happening.
40.meaning.upright.universal_pyramid.6: Position «Influence of the environment»: The Five of Cups in the position of influence of the environment indicates that you are surrounded by an atmosphere of disappointment, sadness, or loss. Perhaps people close to you are going through a difficult period, and their emotional state is affecting you. The collective energy of grief or regret may come from your family, work colleagues, or social circle. In some cases, this card may indicate a toxic environment where failures and mistakes are constantly emphasized, contributing to the formation of a negative worldview. People around you may be stuck in past hurts and mistakes, preventing themselves and others from moving forward. This influence creates an additional emotional burden that you have to deal with.
40.meaning.upright.universal_pyramid.7: Position «Hopes and Fears»: The Five of Cups in the hopes and fears position indicates a deep fear of loss and disappointment that influences your expectations for the future. You fear a repeat of painful experiences from the past and are afraid of experiencing feelings of loss again. This anxiety can manifest itself in conscious fears or in a subconscious defensive reaction of emotional detachment or risk avoidance. Paradoxically, you simultaneously hope for healing from past disappointments and the opportunity to finally let go of painful memories. This duality creates internal tension between the desire to move forward and the fear of being hurt again. The card reflects your desire for emotional liberation from the burden of past losses.
40.meaning.upright.universal_pyramid.8: The «Result» position: The Five of Cups in the result position indicates that the current situation will result in a certain loss or disappointment, but at the same time, you will gain important life experience. Like the figure on the card, you will find yourself at a crossroads where you will have to admit that some hopes have not been fulfilled and learn to appreciate what remains. This ending is not entirely negative — rather, it is a necessary part of your emotional and spiritual development. Through the experience of loss, you will come to a deeper understanding of your true values and priorities. The outcome of the current situation will bring freedom from illusions and the opportunity to start a new phase with a more mature and wise perception of reality.
40.meaning.upright.universal_pyramid.9: The «Key to the Solution» position: The Five of Cups in the key to the solution position indicates that the path to overcoming current difficulties lies in accepting losses and disappointments as an inevitable part of life experience. Solving the problem requires you to have the courage to turn your back on the overturned cups and focus on those that remain intact — symbolically, this means focusing on the resources and opportunities you still have. The key is to reframe your attitude toward loss: instead of perceiving it as an irreparable tragedy, try to see it as an opportunity for transformation and growth. The grieving process is necessary, but don't get stuck in it; allow yourself to feel the pain of loss, and then let it go to make room for new possibilities.
40.advice.upright.universal_pyramid.0: The Five of Cups advises you to shift your attention from what you have lost to what you have left. Like the figure in the card, you are standing over the spilled cups, unaware of the two full ones behind you. It is time to acknowledge your losses and disappointments, but do not dwell on them. Allow yourself to grieve fully, and then consciously shift your focus to gratitude for what you still have. Remember that even the most painful losses contain the seeds of new opportunities. The art of living is not about avoiding disappointment, but about extracting wisdom and strength from it. Like a river flowing around obstacles, learn to accept change and use the energy of loss to move toward new shores in your life.
40.meaning.upright.universal_flame.0: Position «Current Situation»: The Five of Cups in this position indicates a period of emotional turmoil that you are currently going through. You are experiencing disappointment, loss, or the loss of hopes that seemed important to you. Like the figure on the card leaning over the spilled cups, your attention is fixed on what has not come to pass or has been lost. This fixation on loss obscures the opportunities that are still available to you. The current situation requires you to work through your emotions and accept that some things cannot be recovered or changed. Feeling sad and grieving is a natural reaction, but there is a risk of getting stuck in these emotions and not noticing what you still have.
40.meaning.upright.universal_flame.1: Past Influences Position: The Five of Cups in the Past Influences position indicates significant disappointment or loss that has shaped your current worldview. In the recent past, you have probably experienced the shattering of hopes, the loss of a loved one, or the collapse of important plans, which has left a deep emotional mark. This experience may have damaged your trust in people or in life in general, creating defense mechanisms that now influence your behavior and decisions. The figure in the cloak on the card symbolizes how you may have closed yourself off from the world after experiencing pain. However, it is also important to note that it is precisely this experience of loss that has allowed you to develop emotional depth and compassion, which are now part of your personality.
40.meaning.upright.universal_flame.2: Hidden Influences Position: The Five of Cups in the hidden influences position indicates unconscious emotional patterns related to past disappointments that secretly control your reactions in the present. On a deeper level, you may fear a repeat of painful experiences, which manifests itself in unconscious sabotage of your own potential or excessive emotional defensiveness. Hidden influences may also include unresolved grief or unexpressed sadness that, finding no outlet, poisons your perception of the situation. Like a dark figure on a map, part of your psyche remains shrouded in regret and sorrow, even if you appear calm and rational on the outside. This hidden melancholy influences your decisions and choices more than you may realize.
40.meaning.upright.universal_flame.3: Position «Obstacles and Challenges»: The Five of Cups in the position of obstacles and challenges indicates that the main obstacle in your path is a tendency to focus on losses and failures instead of the opportunities available to you. Like the figure on the card, you are looking at three overturned cups, not noticing the two full ones behind you. This fixation on the negative aspect of the situation prevents you from seeing alternative paths and solutions. The challenge is to go through the grieving process without getting stuck in it forever. You must learn to integrate the experience of loss into your life without allowing it to define your entire future. This requires emotional courage and a willingness to rethink your attitude toward disappointment as an integral part of life experience rather than a final sentence.
40.meaning.upright.universal_flame.4: Position «Attitude toward the situation»: The Five of Cups in the position of attitude toward the situation reflects your tendency toward pessimistic perception and focus on the negative aspects of what is happening. Your inner state is characterized by melancholy and disappointment, which colors your entire perception in dark tones. Like the figure on the card, you may be so absorbed in contemplating what has gone wrong that you fail to notice your remaining resources and opportunities. This emotional fixation creates a distorted picture of reality, where losses seem more significant than they really are. Your current attitude may include elements of self-blame or regret about decisions you have made, which exacerbates your inner discomfort. This mindset prevents you from seeing constructive ways out of the situation and hinders emotional healing.
40.meaning.upright.universal_flame.5: What you should do: The Five of Cups in the action position indicates the need to go through a grieving process in order to finally let go of the past. You should acknowledge your feelings of disappointment and loss without trying to suppress them or pretend that everything is fine. Allow yourself to fully experience the pain of loss, but don't get stuck there. The next step should be a conscious shift toward what remains intact in your life—the two full cups that symbolize your remaining resources and opportunities. Practice gratitude for what you have and learn to see the seeds of new beginnings in every loss. It is also important to analyze the lessons that can be learned from what has happened in order to transform the experience of disappointment into wisdom.
40.meaning.upright.universal_flame.6: Position «External influences»: The Five of Cups in the position of external influences indicates an atmosphere of sadness, disappointment, or loss that surrounds you at this time. Perhaps people close to you are going through difficult times and their emotional state is affecting you, creating additional stress. In some cases, this card may indicate collective trauma or loss affecting the entire community, whether it be your family, work colleagues, or social circle. The energy of grief and regret from the outside world is entering your personal space, intensifying your own feelings of melancholy. Those around you may, without realizing it, be drawing you into negative emotional patterns by focusing on what has been lost rather than on opportunities for recovery and growth.
40.meaning.upright.universal_flame.7: The Hope and Fears position: The Five of Cups in the Hope and Fears position reveals a deep fear of disappointment and loss that influences your expectations for the future. You fear that past painful experiences will repeat themselves, causing you to emotionally distance yourself or avoid risks. This defensive reaction can manifest itself in conscious fears or subconscious sabotage of your own opportunities. Paradoxically, deep down you also hope for healing from past disappointments and the opportunity to free yourself from the burden of sadness. The figure on the card, standing between the spilled and intact cups, symbolizes your inner struggle between the fear of new losses and the hope for emotional renewal. This ambivalent state creates internal tension between the desire to protect yourself from pain and the desire for a fulfilling life.
40.meaning.upright.universal_flame.8: The «Result» position: The Five of Cups in the result position indicates that the outcome of the situation will involve a certain amount of disappointment and loss, but at the same time will be an important stage in your emotional growth. Like the figure on the card, you will find yourself at a crossroads where you will need to acknowledge that some hopes have not been fulfilled and learn to appreciate what remains intact. This outcome is not entirely negative—rather, it is a necessary part of your spiritual journey. Through the experience of loss, you will come to a deeper understanding of the true values of life and gain emotional maturity. Paradoxically, it is loss that will be the catalyst for an inner transformation that will bring you greater wisdom and compassion in the long run.
40.meaning.upright.universal_flame.9: Short-term prospects: The Five of Cups in the short-term prospects position heralds a period of emotional discomfort and disappointment in the near future. You are likely to encounter a situation that will not meet your expectations or will bring a sense of loss. This may be related to external circumstances or to the realization that some of your hopes are illusory. In the short term, you may experience melancholy, regret, or sadness, which is a natural reaction to loss. This period will require emotional work on your part to accept and integrate the experience of disappointment. However, even in this situation, there is hidden potential for growth — like young shoots breaking through the ashes after a fire, new opportunities will begin to appear when you are ready to notice them.
40.meaning.upright.universal_flame.10: Long-term prospects: The Five of Cups in the long-term prospects position indicates that your current experience of disappointment or loss will become the foundation for a profound transformation of your personality in the future. What is now perceived as a painful loss will eventually be reinterpreted as a necessary stage in your life journey. In the long run, this experience will enrich your emotional palette and develop your capacity for compassion and empathy. Just as a pearl forms around a grain of sand that causes pain to an oyster, your personality will form new qualities around the experience of loss. Over time, you will learn to find a balance between accepting the inevitability of disappointment and the ability to see new opportunities. This emotional maturity will become a valuable asset and help you support others going through similar trials.
40.meaning.upright.universal_flame.11: Spiritual Lessons Position: The Five of Cups in the Spiritual Lessons position indicates a profound lesson about the nature of attachment and letting go that you have yet to learn. This card brings the understanding that loss and disappointment are an integral part of the human experience and serve as catalysts for spiritual growth. The spiritual lesson is to realize the impermanence of all phenomena and develop inner freedom from excessive attachment to outcomes. Just as a river cannot flow if it does not let go of every drop of water, your soul cannot grow if it does not learn to let go of what is leaving. Through the experience of loss, you come to a deeper understanding of true values and learn to find meaning even in suffering. The card calls for the development of wise acceptance of life in all its fullness, including the pain of loss as a necessary part of a holistic spiritual experience.
40.advice.upright.universal_flame.0: The Five of Cups advises you to acknowledge your feelings of grief and disappointment without trying to suppress or avoid them. Allow yourself to fully experience these emotions, but don't get stuck in them forever. Remember that your attention is like a beam of light—whatever you focus on becomes visible and meaningful. Right now, you are focused on the cups that have been spilled, but it is time to turn around and see the ones that are still full. Practice conscious gratitude for what you have, even if it seems insignificant compared to what you have lost. Learn to see each loss not as the end of the road, but as a turning point that opens up new perspectives. Like an alchemist turning lead into gold, transform the energy of disappointment into wisdom and compassion that will enrich your life experience and help others in similar situations.
40.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.0: The Five of Cups in the «Present Position» indicates a period of deep disappointment and emotional loss in your life. You may feel depressed due to recent failures or lost opportunities. The card shows that you are focused on the three overturned cups — symbols of loss — while ignoring the two remaining cups, which are still full. This suggests that your attention is fixed on the negative aspects of the situation, while you fail to notice what you still have. You are currently in a state of grief, and this emotional burden colors your entire perception of reality, preventing you from seeing potential opportunities.
40.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.1: The Five of Cups in the «Possible Cause of the Situation» position reveals that the root of your current difficulties is unresolved emotional turmoil from the past. You may have experienced betrayal, the breakdown of a meaningful relationship, or the collapse of important hopes, which left a deep emotional scar. The figure on the card, standing in a black cloak, symbolizes your unwillingness to let go of past hurts and disappointments. This emotional fixation on what has been lost becomes a barrier to moving forward. You may be afraid of becoming vulnerable again or making a mistake, so you subconsciously create situations that confirm your fears.
40.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.2: The Five of Cups in the «First Path» position foretells a journey through grief and acceptance of loss. This path requires you to have the courage to face your pain and fully acknowledge what has happened. The symbolism of the overturned cups indicates the need to allow yourself to experience the feeling of loss without trying to suppress or avoid it. This is a path of deep emotional cleansing and transformation through suffering. You will have to go through all the stages of grief: denial, anger, bargaining, depression, and finally acceptance. This process will be painful, but it is precisely this process that will allow you to truly heal and gain a new understanding of yourself and your values.
40.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.3: The Five of Cups in the «Second Path» position indicates the possibility of denying or suppressing your true feelings. This path represents an attempt to bypass pain by not acknowledging it or masking it with other emotions. The person on the card, turning away from the standing cups, symbolizes a refusal to look at what is still valuable in your life. By choosing this path, you risk plunging into a prolonged state of grief that will affect all areas of your life. Outwardly, it may seem that you are coping, but inside, emotional tension will build up, which may later manifest itself in the form of depression, anxiety, or psychosomatic symptoms.
40.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.4: The Five of Cups in the «Result of the First Path» position opens up the prospect of deep emotional renewal and inner wisdom. By going through the process of fully accepting your losses and pain, you will gain a new understanding of life and its cycles. The river on the map, flowing toward a distant castle, symbolizes the path to new horizons that will open up after a period of mourning. This outcome does not mean that memories of the past will disappear completely, but they will cease to cause acute pain. Instead, they will transform into valuable lessons and a source of inner strength. You will learn to appreciate what remains and gain the ability to see opportunities even in the most difficult situations.
40.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.5: The Five of Cups in the «Result of the Second Path» position warns of getting stuck in a cycle of regret and unresolved grief. Refusal to acknowledge and experience your pain will lead to the formation of a chronic state of melancholy and pessimism. The black clothing of the figure on the card reflects the emotional armor you will create around yourself to avoid new disappointments. This defensive behavior will gradually spread to all areas of your life, causing you to expect the worst and miss new opportunities for fear of repeating past experiences. Your relationships with those around you will become superficial, as you will be afraid of real intimacy, which makes you vulnerable.
40.meaning.upright.choice_twoPaths.6: The Five of Cups in the «Final Outcome» position indicates an important life lesson you need to learn: how to balance acknowledging losses with the ability to see the blessings that remain. Regardless of the path you choose, you will come to understand that life is a constant movement between gains and losses. The card in this position shows that the predominant force in your life will not be the event of loss itself, but how you interpret it and what meaning you give it. The bridge in the background of the card symbolizes the connection between the past and the future that you are about to realize. You will understand that every loss opens up space for something new, even if it is difficult to accept at the moment of loss.
40.advice.upright.choice_twoPaths.0: The Five of Cups advises you to allow yourself to feel grief and disappointment without trying to escape them, but at the same time, don't forget to pay attention to what is still valuable in your life. Like the figure in the card, you may be so absorbed in contemplating the overturned cups (symbols of loss) that you don't notice the two cups standing behind you. Take time for your emotions, allow yourself to mourn what has been lost, but don't let those feelings define your entire reality. Set boundaries for your grief—allow yourself a specific amount of time to feel sad, but then consciously shift your focus to what is still present in your life. The bridge in the background of the card is a reminder that there is a way forward, even if you can't see it right now.
40.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.0: The Five of Cups in the «Past Influence» position indicates that recent disappointments or losses are having a significant impact on your current situation. The overturned cups on the card symbolize emotional investments that have not yielded the expected results — broken relationships, unrealized projects, or lost opportunities. These experiences have created a state of melancholy and regret in your soul that continues to color your perception of the present. Your tendency to focus on what has been lost (three overturned cups) rather than what remains (two upright cups) is rooted in these past events. This experience has formed certain defense mechanisms that may now hinder your ability to fully open yourself up to new opportunities.
40.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.1: The Five of Cups in the «Current Situation» position reflects a period of emotional crisis and disappointment that you are currently going through. You are in a state of awareness of loss, perhaps feeling a sense of missed opportunities or unfulfilled expectations. The figure in dark clothing on the card symbolizes your current position—immersed in sadness and regret, with emotional pain obscuring your broader perspective. The three spilled cups in front of you represent specific situations or relationships that have not turned out as you had hoped. At the moment, it is difficult for you to shift your attention to the two full cups behind you — the resources and opportunities that are still available to you. Your current situation is characterized by the need to experience and integrate this experience of loss.
40.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.2: The Five of Cups in the Hidden Influences position reveals a subconscious fear of new disappointments that acts as an invisible brake in your life. This hidden pattern is associated with unresolved grief or a sense of loss that you may not be fully aware of or acknowledge. The river on the map, separating the figure from the castle in the distance, symbolizes the emotional distance you unconsciously maintain between yourself and potential new attachments or opportunities. This defensive strategy works quietly and unnoticed, causing you to prematurely give up on prospects or sabotage relationships out of fear of repeating past painful scenarios. The hidden influence of the Five of Cups also manifests itself in your selective memory, which may exaggerate the negative aspects of past experiences.
40.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.3: The Five of Cups in the «First Path» position offers a path through emotional transformation and reevaluation of losses. This path invites you to fully immerse yourself in the grieving process, acknowledging your feelings of disappointment and loss without trying to overcome them prematurely. The mourning figure's clothing on the card indicates the need for temporary solitude and inner work. By choosing this path, you agree to go through all the stages of emotional acceptance of loss, which will require significant emotional resources and the courage to face your own vulnerability. This will not be a quick process, but it offers deep healing and the opportunity to rediscover meaning in what remains. This path leads to a more authentic and conscious interaction with life, where losses are integrated as part of your experience rather than defining your identity.
40.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.4: The Five of Cups in the «Second Path» position represents an opportunity for practical rethinking and reorganization of life after loss. Unlike the first path, which focuses on the emotional process, this path offers a more active, action-oriented approach. Here, the symbolism of the two remaining cups becomes central—it is an invitation to recognize and develop resources that have been at your disposal but have gone unnoticed due to your focus on loss. This path will require a conscious effort on your part to shift your attention from what has been lost to what can be created or restored. It includes practical steps to restore lost balance: establishing new connections, finding new sources of satisfaction, and creating structures that support emotional well-being. This is a path of reconstruction and renewal through meaningful action.
40.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.5: The Five of Cups in the Third Path position reveals the possibility of transforming the experience of loss into a source of wisdom and help for others. This path is an alchemical process through which personal suffering becomes the basis for deeper understanding and compassion. The river on the card, symbolizing the flow of emotions, becomes a path to new horizons of service and creativity. By choosing this path, you do not deny your disappointment or grief, but actively transform their energy into something constructive and meaningful. This can manifest itself in various forms of expression—art, supporting others who are experiencing similar losses, or creating initiatives aimed at preventing similar situations in the future. This path takes time and is not linear, but it offers the most complete resolution of the energy of the Five of Cups.
40.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.6: The Five of Cups in the «Obstacles and Fears» position indicates a deep fear of being abandoned and left alone with your pain. The dark figure on the card, leaning over the spilled cups, represents your fear of fully experiencing the feeling of loss, the fear that if you allow yourself to fully immerse yourself in grief, you may drown in it. The river on the card symbolizes emotional depth that seems dangerous and insurmountable. The main obstacle here is your inner resistance to the grieving process and your unwillingness to see that loss can be followed by renewal. You may be afraid that acknowledging the loss will make it even more real and painful. There is also a fear that focusing on what remains (the two cups standing upright) may seem like a betrayal of what has been lost or a belittlement of the significance of your loss.
40.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.7: The Five of Cups in the «Advice from Higher Powers» position conveys a deep wisdom about the nature of grief and transformation. Through this card, the higher powers advise you not to resist the natural process of grieving, but also not to allow it to become a permanent state. The figure on the card, standing between the spilled and remaining cups, indicates the need to find a balance between acknowledging your loss and being able to see what is still present in your life. The bridge in the background is a spiritual symbol of transition and connection between different states of being. The higher powers remind you that temporarily immersing yourself in sadness is not the end point, but a necessary part of the journey. They urge you to practice a special form of mindfulness in which you can simultaneously honor what has been lost and remain open to what may still come into your life.
40.meaning.upright.choice_crossroad.8: The Five of Cups in the «Possible Outcome» position indicates that through the process of accepting and integrating your losses, you will reach a new depth of emotional wisdom. This does not mean that the pain will disappear completely, but it will transform into a more mature understanding of life, where joy and sorrow coexist as integral parts of the human experience. The castle on the horizon of the card symbolizes a new emotional and spiritual space that will open up for you after you pass through the valley of sorrow. The end result of this journey is the ability to hold the paradox: you will learn to remember and honor what has been lost while fully participating in the present and remaining open to the future. This transformation will lead to greater emotional stability and authenticity in all areas of your life, especially in your relationships with others, which will become deeper thanks to your expanded understanding of the fragility and value of human connections.
40.advice.upright.choice_crossroad.0: The Five of Cups advises you to find a healthy balance between acknowledging your losses and seeing what is still present in your life. Don't try to suppress your feelings of grief or disappointment—they need your attention and respect. Set aside some time and space to truly feel and express your sadness, perhaps through writing, talking to a trusted friend, or another form of emotional expression. However, be careful not to get stuck in this state forever. Practice mindful shifting: when you find yourself dwelling on what has been lost, make a conscious effort to also acknowledge what you still have. The river and bridge on the map remind us of the need to move forward—don't remain stuck in the place of loss, but use it as a starting point for a new journey.
43.name: Eight of Cups
43.meaning.upright.simple_YesNo.0: The Eight of Cups in a Yes/No spread often indicates the need to let go of a situation and move on. This card suggests that you may have invested a lot of emotional energy in a particular issue, but now it is time to acknowledge that some paths do not lead to the desired outcome. Despite your achievements, something significant remains unfulfilled, and you should listen to your inner voice, which is calling you to seek deeper satisfaction elsewhere.
43.meaning.upright.simple_YesNo.1: In the context of a Yes/No question, the Eight of Cups suggests that you need to be prepared to give up your current circumstances for a better future. The card symbolizes a moment of realization that the material or emotional abundance you currently have does not actually bring you complete satisfaction. Your inner voice is urging you to seek more, even if it means temporary discomfort or uncertainty. This is not simply running away from problems, but a conscious choice in favor of personal growth.
43.advice.upright.simple_YesNo.0: The Eight of Cups advises you to gather your courage and honestly assess the situation. Perhaps it is time to admit that you have achieved all you can and that continuing in the same direction will not bring the desired results. Don't be afraid to leave behind what once seemed valuable but no longer meets your deepest needs. Use this moment as an opportunity for self-discovery and reevaluation of your true desires. Remember that sometimes walking away is not a sign of weakness, but a sign of wisdom and self-care.
43.meaning.upright.simple_daySuggest.0: In the Day's Advice spread, the Eight of Cups suggests that today you may encounter a situation that requires you to emotionally detach yourself from something that no longer serves your highest good. The day may bring the realization that certain relationships, projects, or beliefs have exhausted their potential, and continuing to cling to them means hindering your own growth. This is a day when your inner voice becomes particularly clear, showing the difference between what you have and what your soul truly desires.
43.meaning.upright.simple_daySuggest.1: Today, with the energy of the Eight of Cups, you are called upon to reevaluate your emotional investments. You may realize that you have been investing time and energy in relationships or situations that cannot satisfy your deepest needs. This is a good day for inner work, when you can listen to the quiet voice of your intuition, telling you that there are more meaningful paths and opportunities waiting for you beyond the horizon of your current circumstances.
